-------------------

Requisition ID: 1755060

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Scala Developer (Senior) – Job Description**

EY’s GDS Tax Technology team’s mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our clients and engagement teams. As a member of EY’s core Tax practice, you’ll develop a deep tax technical knowledge and outstanding database, data analytics and programming skills.

Ever-increasing regulations require tax departments to gather, organize and analyse more data than ever before. Often the data necessary to satisfy these ever-increasing and complex regulations must be collected from a variety of systems and departments throughout an organization. Effectively and efficiently handling the variety and volume of data is often extremely challenging and time consuming for a company.

EY's GDS Tax Technology team members work side-by-side with the firm's partners, clients and tax technical subject matter experts to develop and incorporate technology solutions that enhance value-add, improve efficiencies and enable our clients with disruptive and market leading tools supporting Tax.

GDS Tax Technology works closely with clients and professionals in the following areas: Federal Business Tax Services, Partnership Compliance, Corporate Compliance, Indirect Tax Services, Human Capital, and Internal Tax Services. GDS Tax Technology provides solution architecture, application development, testing and maintenance support to the global TAX service line both on a pro-active basis and in response to specific requests.

EY is currently seeking an Scala Developer (Senior) – Job Description to join our Tax Technology practice in Bangalore, India.

  

**The opportunity**

We’re looking for a Tax Senior with expertise in Scala Developer (Senior) to join the TTT team in Tax SL. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a pioneer firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Work Experience – 3 to 5 years of hands-on development experience specifically in Scala (Spark).
* Development experience with RDDs, writing code for performing actions, transformations using in-memory processing using Scala.
* Development experience in data frames and data sets and preparing notebooks in Scala for running jobs in spark.
* Experience with optimizing existing code for better performance and efficiency.
* Exposure on the database side (understanding of read / write queries, handling data volume) and basic understanding of NoSQL databases like Cassandra and Astra.
* Understanding of distributed computing and related technologies (Databricks).
* Hands on experience with development tools like IntelliJ.
* Knowledge on working with high data volume projects (reading and writing up to a million records per transaction).
* Basic debugging skills and Information Security knowledge.
* Be able to perform developer testing for the components written / modified by self.
* Be able to perform Performance and load testing from a development perspective.
* Be able to prepare development documents such as design notes, development test cases, WBS (work break down structure) and effort estimation.
* Knowledge and exposure to GitHub, Azure DevOps, code maintenance and CI/CD release processes.
* Exposure to Software development life cycle and agile methodologies.
* Degree in software engineering, computer science or similar.
* Good communication skills (verbal and written).

  

**Responsibilities**

* Developing and maintaining software applications using the Scala. Writing clean, efficient, and reusable code with Scala best practices.
* Working on integrating third-party libraries and APIs with Scala.
* Work with the dev team closely and provide guidance to improve their skillset and help them complete the deliverables within the planned time frame.
* Review the code written by the team members and suggest changes in terms of coding standards, best practices, performance optimization and security considerations.
* Implementing test-driven development and automated testing for Scala applications
* Provide multiple alternatives for resolving a problem explaining the pros and cons of each approach.
* Ability to have an overall understanding of the code to be able to connect to topics discussed during design, development or issue debugging sessions.
* Work on code optimization activities periodically and ensure quality of work delivered.
* Participate meaningfully in design and architecture sessions, requirements understanding meetings by asking questions, confirming understanding, and summarizing the discussion.
* Send daily / weekly status reports and summaries of the work completed for the day / week.
* Participate in scrum calls and other technical discussion calls with the team.
* Train and provide guidance for team members on technologies and development concepts.
* Work with the team on providing estimates, creating WBS (work breakdown structure) for the development tasks assigned.
* Staying updated with the latest Scala developments and framework.
* Be self - organizing and plan the day based on the priorities communicated.

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success, as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Equifax is where you can power your possible. If you want to achieve your true potential, chart new paths, develop new skills, collaborate with bright minds, and make a meaningful impact, we want to hear from you.

**Synopsis of the role**

Equifax is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our world-class Entity Resolution/Keying & Linking team within India Data & Analytics. The ideal candidate is an analytical engineer who bridges the gap between software development and data science—possessing the programming skills to scrape, merge, and manage diverse data streams, alongside the statistical mindset to extract meaningful insights. You will combine technical execution with creative problem-solving to build reliable data prototypes and uncover patterns within complex data. If you have a solid foundation in mathematics or statistics and a passion for data mining and machine learning, we want to hear from you.

  
  

**What you’ll do**

* Pipeline Engineering: Build and manage reliable data pipelines to aggregate, ingest, and process data from diverse source systems.
* Data Integration & Quality: Integrate, cleanse, and structure large datasets for analytical consumption and client solutions, implementing automated checks to troubleshoot data anomalies.
* Model Support: Apply an understanding of data characteristics to develop tracking processes that support data quality and entity resolution models.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Leverage and implement Google Cloud Platform (GCP) technologies, keeping up with cloud advancements to propose optimization improvements.
* Data Governance: Implement data management, security, and maintenance best practices directly into pipeline workflows.
* Global Teamwork: Collaborate actively with regional and global Equifax teams to share insights, standardize workflows, and adopt best practices.
  

  

**What experience you need**

* Education: BS in a STEM major or equivalent discipline (Mathematics, Statistics, or Computer Science preferred).
* Experience: 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in a data engineering or highly quantitative technical role.
* Core Tech Stack: Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with practical experience writing utility scripts.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Competent understanding of cloud computing concepts, with practical experience working in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or a similar cloud environment.
* Data Modeling: Experience transforming unstructured/structured data into optimized data models, troubleshooting pipeline bottlenecks, and ensuring data readiness.
* DevOps Basics: Solid experience with version control (Git) and exposure to CI/CD integration workflows.
  

  

**What could set you apart**

* Big Data & Cloud Tooling: Hands-on experience with Google BigQuery, BigTable, Dataflow, or big data processing frameworks like PySpark/Scala.
* Data Formats: Familiarity with managing modern schemas and file formats such as JSON, AVRO, and PARQUET.
* Domain & Concept Knowledge: Exposure to credit/financial data products or prior project/academic experience with Entity Resolution and identity matching concepts.
* Certification: Any active cloud certifications (e.g., GCP Associate Cloud Engineer).

#India

We offer a hybrid work setting, comprehensive compensation and healthcare packages, attractive paid time off, and organizational growth potential through our online learning platform with guided career tracks.

Are you ready to power your possible? Apply today, and get started on a path toward an exciting new career at Equifax, where you can make a difference!

**Who is Equifax?**

At Equifax, we believe knowledge drives progress. As a global data, analytics and technology company, we play an essential role in the global economy by helping employers, employees, financial institutions and government agencies make critical decisions with greater confidence.

We work to help create seamless and positive experiences during life’s pivotal moments: applying for jobs or a mortgage, financing an education or buying a car. Our impact is real and to accomplish our goals we focus on nurturing our people for career advancement and their learning and development, supporting our next generation of leaders, maintaining an inclusive and diverse work environment, and regularly engaging and recognizing our employees. Regardless of location or role, the individual and collective work of our employees makes a difference and we are looking for talented team players to join us as we help people live their financial best.

Equifax is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

title: Senior Systems Development Engineer
description:
**Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

**Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology.**

**Senior Systems Development Engineer**

**What You’ll Achieve**

Our customers operate highly complex, mission-critical environments that demand deep technical expertise across hardware, software, and full-system architecture. As part of the Customer Engineering team, you will work at the intersection of system design, advanced diagnostics, and performance engineering. This includes analyzing integrated electronic and electro-mechanical systems, conducting feasibility and architecture evaluations, and developing specifications that ensure robust, predictable system behavior.

The Customer Engineering Team focuses on advanced root-cause analysis, performance optimization, configuration tuning, and long-term stability improvements. You will tackle the toughest technical challenges in enterprise environments—driving solutions that improve reliability, scalability, and overall system efficiency for global customers.

Join us as a **Senior Systems Development Engineer** on our **Customer Engineering Team** in **Bangalore IN**.

**You will:**

**As a Senior Systems Development Engineer:**

* Collaborate with core engineering teams, Customer Support, Incident Management, and customers to stabilize and optimize enterprise environments.
* Perform root cause analysis and kernel-level debugging on supported enterprise operating systems running on Dell hardware.
* Apply your expertise in computer architecture and OS internals to resolve complex issues and improve system resilience.
* Drive impact beyond technical problem-solving by shaping strategic initiatives that improve efficiency, resilience, and operational excellence.

**Essential Requirements:**

* Work Model: Onsite, 5 days a week (remote/hybrid not eligible).
* Schedule: Weekend work on a rotational basis (comp days provided), occasional early/late shifts, and overtime as needed.
* Experience: 5-8+ years in software/hardware engineering (or equivalent) with deep expertise in one or more of the following: Object storage, NAS (Network Attached Storage), Linux/BSD operating systems, Networking and protocol stacks (SMB, NFS, etc.), Filesystems, Analytics, observability, and data science
* **Technical Skills:**

  Proficiency in Java, C, Python, and scripting  
  Proven experience in developing automation frameworks and applying AI/agentic tools to drive operational efficiency and scalability

**Who we are:**

Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives.

* Utilize AI-assisted tools to improve developer productivity, automate repetitive tasks, generate documentation, optimize report development, and improve overall delivery efficiency.
* Identify opportunities where AI-enabled capabilities can improve reporting, analytics, business insights, and solution delivery.
* Identify patterns, trends, anomalies, and meaningful insights from data through analysis and visualization.
* Find opportunities for automation and performance optimization to improve business processes and reporting efficiency.
* Document technical solutions and design approaches to address defined business requirements.
* Work with other team members to define effort estimates, timelines, project plans, and delivery milestones.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 4 or more years of experience as a Reports Developer, BI Developer, or Data Visualization Developer.

* 2 or more years of strong understanding of charts, tables, filters, parameters, sets, calculated fields, DAX, blending, LOD expressions, and visualization best practices.
* 1 or more years of hands-on experience with AI-related capabilities within Power BI, including Q&A, Smart Narratives, Key Influencers, Decomposition Tree, Copilot, and other AI-assisted analytics features.

* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to analyze business needs and translate them into reporting and analytics solutions.
* Experience working with Business Analysts and business stakeholders to define requirements and recommend development approaches.
* Ability to interpret business requirements and define technical alternatives, tools, and implementation approaches.
* Strong knowledge of databases and proficiency in SQL.
* Ability to build medium to highly complex reports and dashboards using multiple enterprise data sources.
* Strong experience identifying trends, anomalies, patterns, risks, and opportunities through data analysis.
* Experience applying AI-assisted development tools and AI-DLC practices to improve development productivity, testing, documentation, solution quality, and delivery timelines.
* Familiarity with Generative AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar AI-assisted development platforms.

description:

Become part of the Converse Team

Converse is a place to explore potential, break barriers and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At Converse, it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving world to make things better as a team.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

  
  

The Global Supply Chain Technology Team enables the warehouse systems, integrations, reporting, and operational capabilities that support Converse distribution across North America and the Converse European Logistics Centerin Belgium.The team partners with Distribution Center Operations, Supply Chain and Logistics, SAP and integration teams, infrastructure providers, enterprise technology, and external solution partners to deliver reliable warehouse capabilities. The team supports Manhattan WMi (IBMi Platform), Manhattan SCI (IBM Cognos) reporting, inventory synchronization, fulfillment, shipping, returns, value-added services, warehouse automation, and connected suppy chain integrations. The team is strengthening internal support capability, operational resilience, documentation, and continuous improvement across these business-critical platforms.

  
  

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

  
  

The Senior Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) Engineer is a Bangalore-based, hybrid, hands-on senior individual contributor responsible for supporting, maintaining, configuring, and enhancing warehouse management capabilities across North America Distribution Centers and Converse ELC in Belgium. Working under the direction of the WMS Lead, this role provides advanced L2/L3 technical support for Manhattan WMi (IBMi Platform) and related applications. The engineer independently diagnoses production issues, implements approved configuration and reporting changes, supports integrations and deployments, and contributes technical analysis and recommendations to the Lead and broader solution teams. The role focuses on reliable execution and deep technical support. Accountability for technology strategy, solution ownership, roadmap decisions, cross-team governance, and overall delivery leadership remains with the WMS Lead or Technology Manager.

  
  

**WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON**

  
  

* Provide L3 technical support for Manhattan WMi (IBMi Platform) and related supply chain applications, following established support and escalation processes.

* Troubleshoot complex incidents affecting receiving, putaway, inventory management, replenishment, wave planning, picking, packing, shipping, returns, and value-added services.

* Analyze system logs, IBM i job logs, database records, interface messages, batch jobs, and transaction history to identify faults and restore service.

* Perform root-cause analysis for assigned incidents, document findings, and implement approved corrective and preventive actions in partnership with the WMS Lead.

* Use approved AI and automation capabilities to improve incident troubleshooting, technical analysis, documentation, testing, and operational support while adhering to enterprise security and responsible AI standards.

* Work with L1/L2 support, business teams, integration teams, infrastructure teams, vendors, and software providers to resolve assigned incidents and service requests.

* Participate in the on-call support rotation and provide escalation support during critical operational events, peak periods, planned changes, and major deployments.

* Configure, test, document, and implement approved Manhattan WMi (IBMi Platform) enhancements and operational process changes.

* Support requirement clarification and provide technical input, effort estimates, constraints, and impact findings to the WMS Lead and solution owners.

* Execute impact assessments for assigned changes and raise risks, dependencies, or design concerns for Lead review and decision.

* Support warehouse initiatives, customer or process onboarding, automation changes, and omnichannel capabilities

through configuration, testing, deployment, and hypercare activities.

* Maintain WMS configuration records, technical documentation, process flows, support runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.

* Monitor and support integrations between WMS, SAP, order management, transportation systems, automation platforms, carrier solutions, and reporting services.

* Investigate interface failures, inventory synchronization issues, transaction errors, data mismatches, and batch- processing exceptions, escalating design or ownership decisions when needed.

* Perform operational validation and data reconciliation to help protect inventory accuracy and process continuity across connected systems.

* Work with integration and infrastructure specialists on assigned reliability, monitoring, performance, and recovery improvements.

* Support Manhattan SCI (IBM Cognos) reporting capabilities used by warehouse operations.

* Create, modify, validate, and troubleshoot approved operational reports, queries, and data extracts.

* Investigate reporting discrepancies and data-quality issues and document the identified cause and resolution.

* Work with stakeholders and the WMS Lead to clarify reporting needs and translate approved requirements into reliable reports.

* Participate in process reviews, requirements sessions, technical walkthroughs, and solution design discussions as the WMi subject-matter expert.

* Prepare and execute SIT and UAT support, deployment checklists, production validation, go-live support, hypercare, and stabilization activities.

* Provide technical guidance to L1/L2 support analysts and share knowledge that improves first-contact diagnosis and resolution.

* Create and maintain vendor support cases, provide required diagnostic evidence, track progress, and escalate blockers through the WMS Lead.

* Contribute technical findings and improvement recommendations to incident reviews, problem management, service improvement, and modernization initiatives.

  
  

Role Requirements

* Deep hands-on experience supporting Manhattan WMi (IBMi Platform) in a large-scale distribution environment.

* Strong L2/L3 application support expertise, including incident triage, technical diagnosis, production recovery, root- cause analysis, and problem management.

* Working knowledge of IBM i operations relevant to application support, such as job logs, job queues, output queues, scheduled jobs, libraries, files, and batch processing.

* Explore future opportunities to responsibly apply AI and intelligent automation to improve WMS reliability, proactive issue detection, operational efficiency, and warehouse decision-making.

* Strong SQL and database analysis skills for investigating operational issues, validating transactions, and supporting data reconciliation.

* Experience troubleshooting integrations and data synchronization across WMS, SAP, order management, transportation, automation, carrier, and reporting platforms.

* Strong understanding of warehouse processes, including receiving, putaway, inventory management, cycle counting, replenishment, wave planning, picking, packing, shipping, returns, VAS, and omnichannel fulfillment.

* Ability to execute approved technical changes independently while escalating architecture, priority, scope, and risk decisions to the WMS Lead.

* Experience supporting testing, deployment, production validation, hypercare, and operational handover activities.

* Experience working directly with Distribution Center Operations in a high-priority production support environment.

* Clear technical documentation, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.

* Ability to manage multiple assigned priorities across regions and time zones while maintaining reliable delivery and support.

* Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and planned production activities outside standard business hours when required.

* Experience using ServiceNow for incident, problem, change, and service request management within a production support environment.

* Experience using Jira to manage technical work, defects, enhancements, and delivery activities, with Confluence used for technical documentation, runbooks, knowledge articles, and solution documentation.

  
  

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Supply Chain Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, experience, and training.

* 6+ years of experience supporting Warehouse Management Systems, including 4+ years of hands-on experience with Manhattan WMi (IBMi Platform).

* Strong working knowledge of the IBM i (IBMi/AS400) platform, including RPG/RPGLE, CL, DB2 for i (SQL), batch processing, job logs, libraries, queues, and application-level troubleshooting in a production support environment.

* Proven experience providing advanced L2/L3 production support for business-critical warehouse or supply chain applications.

* Hands-on experience with Manhattan WMi (IBMi Platform) configuration, IBM i application support, SQL and database troubleshooting, integrations, and batch processing.

* Ability to Read

* Experience with Manhattan SCI (IBM Cognos) report development and support preferred.

* Experience supporting SAP integrations and inventory, order, or fulfillment flows preferred.

* Experience supporting multi-site or global supply chain and logistics operations preferred.

* Exposure to warehouse automation, robotics, sortation, conveyor, WCS, transportation, order management, or carrier platforms preferred.

* Retail, footwear, apparel, consumer products, or omnichannel distribution experience preferred.

* Exposure to Manhattan SCALE, Manhattan Active WM, Databricks, or modern reporting and integration platforms is a plus.

* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence in an enterprise application support or engineering environment.

* Experience using AI tools and intelligent automation to automate support workflows, improve self-service capabilities, accelerate troubleshooting, and reduce operational dependency on technology support teams is a plus.

------------------------

***Sr Engineer Salesforce*** **, Salesforce Sales Cloud**

As a *Sr Engineer Salesforce* , specializing in Salesforce Sales Cloud, you'll play a pivotal role within the Marketing Campaign Delivery team by designing, building, and delivering innovative technology solutions that drive Sales enablement as well as Book of business growth for Relationship Managers across all B2B Workplace Segment. Total current user base is 1k+. You'll develop Salesforce solutions that help Sales and RM teams identify, prioritize, engage, qualify, and convert prospects and clients into leads while improving productivity, pipeline visibility, and over business goal attainment via goal-oriented dashboards, as well as coordinate with B2B campaign delivery teams, with an emphasis on driving efficiency, automation and integrations between Sales Cloud and Marketing Cloud.

**PLATFORM FOCUS: SALESFORCE SALES CLOUD**
  
This is a Salesforce Sales Cloud role. The position owns Sales Cloud configuration, development, automation, Distributed Marketing configuration and Agentforce capabilities.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Design and deliver Sales Cloud solutions.** Configure (GenDev to UAT to Prod), develop, test, deploy, and support scalable, secure, resilient Salesforce Sales Cloud capabilities aligned with Empower's business and architectural strategies. Build and configure ‘web to lead’ infrastructure across various Empower products and key Sales Channels.
* **Own the core sales data model and experience.** Build solutions across Leads, Accounts, Contacts, Campaigns, Opportunities, Activities, and relevant custom objects, including fields, validation rules, Lightning pages, permissions, sharing, and user experience. Data load as needed for the business including Equilar, Brightscope, UpLead, National Account Firm and TPA lists.
* **Configure the end-to-end lead lifecycle.** Implement lead capture, enrichment, scoring and prioritization, assignment and routing, queues, status management, response-time workflows, duplicate controls, conversion, and handoff to Sales and Relationship Management.
* **Create Sales Cloud prospecting journeys.** Build Sales engagement cadences, work queues, guided tasks, email and call steps, and automated follow-up using Flow to support prioritized seller outreach.
* **Build seller and book of business enablement capabilities.** Deliver guided selling, Sales Path, in-app guidance, next-step recommendations, opportunity-stage governance, pipeline inspection, forecasting, and manager coaching insights via sales dashboards.
* **Implement and manage ongoing Agentforce for Sales.** Design AI use cases for prospecting, lead engagement, seller assistance, account and opportunity research, record updates, meeting preparation, pipeline insights, and sales coaching. Configure agent actions, prompt templates, grounding, guardrails, access controls, monitoring, and human handoffs. Leverage continuous learning to improve sales assistant functionality and drive efficiency for sales and Relationship Managers.
* **Enable Distributed Marketing in Sales Cloud.** Configure the CRM-side managed package, components, permissions, page layouts, campaign and Quick Send experiences, audience selection, personalization inputs, activity/engagement tracking, and data mappings for B2B users. Partner with Marketing Cloud delivery teams to support effective end-to-end integration, data flow, journey/campaign execution, personalization, and engagement tracking across Sales Cloud and Marketing Cloud Engagement.
* **Automate and extend sales processes.** Use declarative tools first, including Flow and approvals, and apply Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, platform events, and APIs when custom development is warranted.
* **Integrate the sales technology ecosystem.** Connect Sales Cloud with approved lead sources, data-enrichment services, email and calendar tools, telephony, sales intelligence, analytics, and downstream enterprise platforms while maintaining reliable synchronization and auditability.
* **Deliver actionable sales analytics.** Build reports and dashboards for lead response and conversion, prospect engagement, cadence effectiveness, seller activity, pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and solution adoption.
* **Partner across the revenue organization.** Collaborate with Sales, Relationship Management, Data Science, Marketing, Product, Architecture/IT CRM team, Data, Security, Compliance, and other stakeholders to translate business needs into pragmatic, scalable technical solutions.
* **Drive seller productivity and adoption.** Create intuitive Lightning experiences across both desktop and mobile and support UAT, documentation, release communications, administrator enablement, and business-user readiness.
* **Engineer for quality and reliability.** Write automated and unit/functional tests, maintain strong code quality and test coverage, troubleshoot production issues, and deliver releases through source control, and Copado.
* **security and platform governance.** Incorporate Empower's security controls, data privacy requirements, disaster recovery principles into Sales Cloude processes and capabilities. Contribute to Salesforce governance within the monthly all segment meeting. Manage Case intake from all B2B users, create reporting for Case requests as well as execute Case requests.

### **What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years of professional software development experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and delivering enterprise Salesforce solutions, with direct experience in Salesforce Sales Cloud.
* **Deep Sales Cloud expertise** across Leads, Accounts, Contacts, Campaigns, Opportunities, Activities, assignment, conversion, pipeline, and forecasting.
* **Hands-on Salesforce engineering skills** with Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, APIs, testing, Extract Transform Load (ETL) data from internal and external turnkey & homegrown applications (Seismic), databases (EASy), other internal systems (Salesforce to Salesforce), line of sight between EPW and B2B, and deployment practices.
* **Sales enablement delivery experience** building seller-facing and RM prospecting, lead-management, workflow-automation, and productivity capabilities in Sales Cloud.
* **Hands-on experience implementing or supporting Salesforce Distributed Marketing**, including CRM-side configuration, permissions, campaign and Quick Send experiences, personalization inputs, data mappings, and integration with Marketing Cloud Engagement.
* **Working knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement and Marketing Cloud Connect**, including Sales Cloud integration patterns, synchronized CRM data, campaign/contact/lead data flows, and their use in Marketing Cloud audiences, journeys, and triggered communications.
* **Secure solution design experience** using roles, profiles and permission sets, sharing, field-level security, validation, auditability, and data-quality controls.
* **Enterprise delivery experience** deploying updates, diagnosing production issues, and evaluating or implementing Salesforce AppExchange solutions.
* **Strong communication and collaboration skills** with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to business and technical audiences and thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
* **Familiarity with Agile methodologies** and iterative delivery.
* **Continuous learning mindset** with a passion for Salesforce platform innovation and responsible AI adoption and use.

### **What Will Set You Apart**

* **Agentforce for Sales experience** including agent actions, prompt templates, grounded generative AI, testing, or monitoring.
* **Sales Engagement experience** with cadences, work queues, prospecting, pipeline management, forecasting, guided selling, or related seller productivity features.
* **Salesforce certifications** in Platform Development, Sales Cloud Consulting, Administration, Architecture, or Agentforce.

description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

We are looking for a visionary, hands-on software leader to head our CT Software Engineering organization in Bangalore. In this role, you will shape how our CT software turns clinical and operational challenges into innovative, reliable solutions that help radiologists and technologists scan faster, see more clearly, reduce patient dose, and deliver better patient outcomes.  
You will lead a team of approximately 120 engineers, setting the technical vision, building world-class software engineering practices, and accelerating the speed at which we move from idea to validated product, all within the rigor required of a regulated medical device environment. As a key part of the global CT Software organization, you will bring a global mindset, working seamlessly with CT teams and partners around the world while establishing Bangalore as a center of excellence for CT software innovation.  
GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

**Job Description**
===================

**Senior Director of Software Engineering – Computed Tomography (CT)**

**Location:** Bangalore, India

**Reports to:** VP of Software Engineering - CT

**Team size:** ~120 software engineers

**Travel:** ~20–25% international travel to global CT R&D sites, customer sites, and leadership forums

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a visionary, hands-on software leader to head our CT Software Engineering organization in Bangalore. In this role, you will shape how our CT software turns clinical and operational challenges into innovative, reliable solutions that help radiologists and technologists scan faster, see more clearly, reduce patient dose, and deliver better patient outcomes.

You will lead a team of approximately 120 engineers, setting the technical vision, building world-class software engineering practices, and accelerating the speed at which we move from idea to validated product, all within the rigor required of a regulated medical device environment. As a key part of the global CT Software organization, you will bring a global mindset, working seamlessly with CT teams and partners around the world while establishing Bangalore as a center of excellence for CT software innovation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Leadership and Vision**

* Define and communicate a multi-year software vision and strategy for the Bangalore CT organization, aligned with global CT business priorities, product roadmaps, and customer needs.
* Translate business objectives into clear engineering goals, measurable outcomes, and investment priorities.
* Develop and drive strategic initiatives that improve engineering productivity, product quality, and time-to-market.
* Anticipate technology and industry trends in CT and position the organization to take advantage of them.

**2. Customer-Centric Innovation**

* Champion a deep understanding of customer pain points by engaging directly with radiologists, CT technologists, service teams, and hospital IT and operations stakeholders.
* Partner with Product Management, Clinical, Applications, and UX teams to turn unmet customer needs into differentiated software solutions, for example simpler scan workflows, faster and more consistent exams, lower dose, better image quality, higher system uptime, and smarter automation.
* Build an innovation pipeline that balances near-term customer improvements with longer-term breakthrough capabilities.
* Encourage rapid experimentation through prototypes, proofs of concept, hackathons, and customer pilots to validate ideas early and often.

**3. Innovation Speed and R&D Execution**

* Oversee end-to-end delivery of CT software programs, including innovation projects, new product introductions (NPIs), design changes, sustaining engineering, and field actions.
* Ensure programs are delivered with high quality, on schedule, and within budget, with predictable and transparent execution.
* Increase innovation velocity by shortening feedback loops, reducing cycle time, and removing organizational and technical bottlenecks, without compromising safety or compliance.
* Use metrics such as DORA metrics, lead time, defect escape rate, and customer-reported issues to drive data-informed decisions and continuous improvement.
* Identify and manage key delivery risks and cross-site dependencies proactively.

**4. World-Class Software Engineering Practices**

* Establish and continuously raise the bar on engineering excellence, including code quality, design reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, DevSecOps, and release management.
* Lead the adoption of modern engineering practices and tools, including test automation, simulation and virtual scanner environments, infrastructure as code, observability, and AI-assisted development, adapted for a regulated environment.
* Provide leadership on Lean and Agile principles at scale; coach teams on estimation, work sizing, backlog health, and flow efficiency.
* Benchmark the organization against industry leaders and drive a roadmap toward best-in-class engineering maturity.

**5. Quality, Safety, and Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure all software activities comply with applicable medical device regulations and standards, and relevant cybersecurity requirements.
* Build quality and compliance into everyday engineering workflows so that they support speed rather than slow it down.
* Partner with Quality, Regulatory, and Systems Engineering leaders to ensure CT products meet compliance, controllership, radiation safety, and patient safety standards.
* Ensure audit readiness and lead the organization's response to software-related CAPAs, field issues, and regulatory inquiries.

**6. Technical Standards, Architecture, and Platforms**

* Partner with global system architects and cross-functional leaders to define future CT technology platforms that are scalable, secure, interoperable, and reusable across product lines.
* Drive platform thinking and modular design to reduce duplication, speed up new feature delivery, and lower total cost of ownership.

**7. Global Leadership and Collaboration**

* Lead the Bangalore CT software organization as an integral part of the global CT software team, with a "one team" mindset built on trust, shared goals, and seamless collaboration across geographies, cultures, and time zones.
* Represent the Bangalore CT organization in global leadership forums and strengthen its visibility and impact across the business.
* Work closely with global partners in Product Management, Systems Engineering, Hardware, Detector and Physics, Clinical, Service, Manufacturing, Quality, and Regulatory.

**8. Talent Management and Culture**

* Attract, develop, and retain top engineering talent in a highly competitive market.
* Build strong technical and functional leadership benches, organizational models, and succession plans.
* Create an inclusive, high-performance culture built on ownership, curiosity, psychological safety, and continuous learning.
* Develop clear technical and managerial career paths, and mentor emerging leaders and senior technical experts.

**9. Engineering Operations and Finances**

* Own and manage the Bangalore CT software engineering budget, headcount, and resource allocation.
* Explore and implement alternative resourcing models, such as partners, vendors, and centers of excellence, to scale capacity and accelerate innovation.
* Use portfolio and project management tools to track progress, report status, and highlight key risks.
* Drive cost efficiency and productivity improvements while protecting investment in innovation.

**10. Stakeholder Engagement and Communication**

* Present regular updates on strategy, progress, and risks to executive sponsors, global CT leadership, and customers.
* Align stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and trade-offs; resolve conflicting priorities through proactive and transparent communication.
* Ensure data, process, and system changes are implemented in line with project objectives and timelines.

**11. Thought Leadership and Knowledge Sharing**

* Act as a recognized technical and leadership voice inside the company and in the wider industry, including conferences, publications, and industry and academic partnerships.
* Share technical, procedural, and business knowledge to raise the capability of the broader organization.
* Encourage the creation of learning content, internal tech talks, communities of practice, and patents and invention disclosures.

**Education Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. A Master's degree or other advanced degree is preferred.

**Required Skills:**

* 15+ years of experience in software engineering, including the design and development of complex, scalable software systems.
* 5+ years leading large software organizations (100+ engineers), including leaders of leaders.
* Proven experience working in and with globally distributed teams across multiple countries and cultures.
* Demonstrated track record of delivering innovative products that solved real customer problems and created measurable business impact.
* Experience working with regulatory compliance in the medical devices industry or another highly regulated industry.

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Strategic thinking with the ability to connect technology choices to customer value and business outcomes.
* Customer focus, with a habit of grounding decisions in direct customer insight.
* Global mindset, with cultural agility and a proven ability to build cohesive teams across borders.
* Bias for speed and action, balanced with sound judgment on quality, safety, and risk.
* Deep knowledge of modern software development methodologies, architecture, and tools.
* Strong program and portfolio management, organizational, and financial skills.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and executive presence, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to diverse audiences.

title: Engineering Manager
Data Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.**

At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.  
Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute and grow together.  
Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.

**All about the role:**  
  
As a Data Engineer at Electrolux Global Data & AI (GDAI) Team, you are the backbone of our digital supply chain for information - the person who turns raw, scattered data into reliable and trusted data and AI products. You will work across the full lifecycle of data, from ingestion through transformation to delivery, on our modern Lakehouse stack built on Azure Databricks. Like the Data Engineering teams at the world's largest tech companies, we hold a high bar: we hire builders who think like owners, dive deep into ambiguous problems, and are equally comfortable architecting a pipeline as they are explaining a metric to a business stakeholder. You will have broad exposure across ingestion, platform, modeling, and delivery, and you will help define the boundary between our Platform and Product Data Engineering functions as our data organization scales.

**What you’ll do:**

* **Data Ingestion & Integration:** Design and build pipelines that reliably move data from a wide variety of source systems – relational databases, external sources and operational datastores - into our Lakehouse, merging disparate sources into a single, trustworthy picture for the business.
* **Transformation & Modeling:** Build and maintain ELT pipelines using dbt to transform raw data into clean, well-modeled, business-ready assets, applying dimensional modeling and consistent KPI definitions so the same metric never means two different things in two different dashboards.
* **Platform Contribution:** Operate and extend our Azure Databricks Lakehouse, contributing to schema design, query optimization, and scalable data processing so the platform scales reliably as data volume and complexity grow.
* **Orchestration & Reliability:** Own end-to-end pipeline orchestration in Airflow, building workflows that run in the right order, recover automatically from failure, and are observable through monitoring, alerting, and audit trails.
* **Data Quality & Trust:** Implement automated data quality checks and testing so that accuracy, completeness, and timeliness are verified continuously, not discovered by a business user staring at a broken dashboard.
* **Data Mesh & Domain Ownership:** Apply data mesh principles to design data products with clear ownership, discoverability, and contracts across domains, reducing tight coupling between teams and enabling other domains to self-serve trusted data.
* **Automation & Engineering Rigor:** Bring a software engineering mindset to Data Engineering - version-controlled code, CI/CD, code review, and Infrastructure as Code - so pipelines are tested, repeatable, and maintainable rather than one-off scripts.
* **Cross-Functional Partnership:** Work directly with business stakeholders to translate ambiguous requirements into scalable data solutions and collaborate closely with the Platform and AI teams to align on shared infrastructure, standards, and roadmap, communicating trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* **Cost & Performance Ownership:** Monitor and optimize computing and storage costs on Azure, treating cost efficiency as a first-class engineering concern rather than an afterthought.
* **AI-Assisted Engineering:** Use AI pair-programming tools such as GitHub Copilot to accelerate development and build agentic CI/CD workflows in GitHub Actions that automate testing, review, and deployment with minimal manual intervention.

**Who are you**

* Proven Track Record: 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer building and operating production data pipelines at scale, ideally in a fast-paced, high-growth environment like those found at leading tech companies.
* SQL & Python: Strong hands-on skills in SQL (query optimization, schema design) and Python for pipeline development and automation.
* Cloud & Lakehouse Experience: Practical experience with a cloud data platform (Azure strongly preferred) and modern Lakehouse or data warehouse architecture.
* Pipeline & Transformation Tooling: Experience building ELT/ETL pipelines, ideally with dbt, and orchestrating them with a workflow manager such as Airflow.
* Ownership Mindset: A track record of taking ambiguous problems from first principles to a working, reliable solution, and a comfort level moving across ingestion, modeling, and delivery as the situation demands.
* Communication: Ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and translate business requirements into scalable, well-modeled data assets.
* AI-Assisted Engineering: Hands-on experience using GitHub Copilot or similar AI coding assistants in daily development, and building CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.

**Technical Qualifications:**

Our data platform is built around a modern Lakehouse architecture. You will work with:

* Core Platform: Azure Databricks Lakehouse on Microsoft Azure.
* Transformation & Modeling: dbt (data build tool) for version-controlled, testable data modeling.
* Orchestration: Apache Airflow for workflow scheduling, dependency management, and recovery.
* Ingestion: Azure Data Factory and batch/streaming integration patterns.
* Languages: Python and SQL at a professional, production-grade level.
* Architecture: Data Mesh principles applied to domain-oriented data ownership and data products.
* Engineering Practices: GitHub and GitHub Actions for version control and CI/CD, agentic CI/CD workflows, and Infrastructure as Code.
* AI-Assisted Development: GitHub Copilot and similar AI pair-programming tools embedded in the daily workflow.

**This is a full-time position, based in Bangalore, India.**

**Why work for Electrolux?**

* **Build at scale**: Lead the development of mission-critical digital commerce experiences used by thousands of customers daily.
* **Own the architecture**: Influence core technical decisions and help evolve our platform for high scalability, resiliency, and flexibility.
* **Modern tech stack**: Work with cutting-edge tools in cloud, commerce, and full-stack engineering.
* **Empowered leadership**: Drive strategy and execution while mentoring a world-class engineering team.
* **Growth and impact**: Join a high-growth company with a culture that values engineering excellence, innovation, and transparent leadership.

**As part of the Electrolux Group, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you!**

title: One Identity Manager Engineer
description:
Qualifications  
Must have  

* 3–5+ years of hands-on experience with One Identity Manager in a support, implementation, or managed

services capacity. Experience should show independent handling of escalations, root cause analysis and  
P1/P2 incidents, not only routine access requests.  

* Deep working knowledge of the One Identity Manager data model: Person objects, account definitions, Unified

Namespace, UNSAccount, PersonInBaseTree, business roles, dynamic roles, and inheritance.  

* Experience diagnosing Job Queue and DBQueue Processor issues, process step failures, and Job Service

performance problems.  

* Hands-on experience with Synchronisation Editor: sync projects, schema classes, object matching rules,

property mapping rules, variable sets, revision filtering, and start-up configurations.  

* T-SQL / SQL Server: proficient in querying the Identity Manager database for diagnostics, job history analysis,

and orphan account identification.  

* Solid understanding of identity lifecycle (joiner-mover-leaver), authoritative source vs. target system concepts,

provisioning, deprovisioning, and reconciliation.  

* Working experience with IT Shop configuration, approval workflows, RBAC, ABAC, SoD rule management,

and access certification campaigns.  

* Active Directory, LDAP, and Entra ID integration and troubleshooting.
* Experience raising and working cases with One Identity (OEM) support, and supporting version upgrades and

patch cycles.  

* Basic scripting knowledge for automation, such as PowerShell, REST APIs and bulk uploads.
* Proficiency with ServiceNow for incident, change, and problem management, and working knowledge of ITIL

processes.  

* Strong understanding of Windows Server.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to work under escalation pressure, manage complex

multi-system failures, and diagnose from logs before engaging the OEM

  

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work with technical and non-technical

stakeholders, document RCA findings and write structured knowledge base articles.

Debugger.

certification.

* Exposure to AWS EC2 or Azure hosted Identity Manager deployments, and Linux familiarity.

equivalent frameworks.  

* Prior managed services or multi-tenant support experience, and experience working with global or

cross-cultural teams

title: Director Cloud Delivery Assurance
description:
At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold **“what if.”**

**What if** your ideas could ignite global innovation?

**What if** your curiosity could redefine the future?

We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of **your** career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it’s like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our cloud-first networking and security solutions already protect **70% of the Fortune 500** , and we’re looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold “what if” can take the world, your community, and your career.

How we empower our people is extraordinary: we’re recognized as a **Glassdoor Best Place to Work 2025, Great Place to Work-Certified in five countries, and honored by Cigna as a Healthy Workforce honors for three consecutive years; and what we build is world class: named CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024** — clear evidence that when first-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, what if the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? **Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next.”**

In a world where you can be anything, **Be Infoblox.**

**Director, Cloud Delivery Assurance**

**The Opportunity**

We have an opportunity for a **Director, Cloud Delivery Assurance** to build and lead our new Cloud Delivery Assurance team within SaaS Platform Engineering in Pune or Bangalore, India, reporting to the VP, Engineering.

In this pivotal role, you will make release readiness a defensible, engineering-owned decision. You will establish a team of automation and delivery-assurance engineers, define the roadmap from manual and inconsistent release checks to an automated artifact-promotion pipeline, and own the quality gates that govern promotion of SaaS software from development clusters through integration and staging environments into production.

Collaborating closely with Solutions QA, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, CloudOps, application, and platform teams, you will create the integration-quality, automation, and production-readiness operating model that validates the combined system before customers experience it. You will establish trusted environments, shared tooling, and evidence-based release-readiness gates while complementing—not duplicating—the charters of Solutions QA, DevOps, and SRE.

You are the ideal candidate if you have built quality or delivery-assurance organizations from the ground up, are fluent in Kubernetes-based cloud platforms and CI/CD, and are comfortable making clear, data-backed decisions when the evidence does not support a release.

**Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do**

* Build the CDA strategy, roadmap, operating model, and staffing plan; align scope, milestones, investment, and success measures with the SVP, Platform Engineering and peer engineering leaders
* Hire, lead, coach, and develop a team of one technical project manager and eight software development engineers in test; establish the team charter, operating cadence, engineering standards, and inclusive culture
* Own the automated artifact-promotion pipeline from CI build and security-scan validation through development-cluster smoke testing, integration and certification runs, staging certification, and production promotion
* Define, implement, and enforce quality gates for each promotion decision, including entry and exit criteria, required evidence, hold-and-return behavior, risk acceptance, and rollback expectations
* Serve as the accountable approver for promotion of SaaS software across development, integration, staging, and production environments; make go/no-go recommendations defensible with data
* Establish a common test-automation framework, shared libraries, and fit-for-purpose test environments for API, integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, and deployment-verification testing
* Apply AI-assisted engineering tools, including code assistants, test-generation capabilities, and intelligent analytics, to improve productivity, expand meaningful test coverage, identify risk patterns, and support—not replace—engineering judgment
* Govern responsible use of AI-generated code and test assets through human review, security and privacy controls, traceability, and measurable quality outcomes
* Deliver readiness scorecards, quality and risk heatmaps, coverage and escape-rate metrics, defect trends, mean-time-to-detect measures, and environment and release status for engineering leadership
* Partner with Solutions QA on end-to-end functional coverage and release sign-off, and with SRE on stress, scale, high availability, disaster recovery, and chaos testing

**Be Prepared — What You Bring**

* Fifteen or more years of experience in software engineering, quality engineering, test automation, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or delivery assurance, including five or more years leading and growing engineering or QA teams
* Proven success defining and delivering quality, automation, and release-readiness strategies for cloud-native SaaS platforms
* Deep understanding of Kubernetes, Linux, containers, public cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, distributed systems, and microservices
* Strong command of CI/CD practices, including pipeline design, artifact promotion, progressive delivery, canary releases, deployment verification, and automated quality gates using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Argo, or Spinnaker
* Expertise in test-automation architecture across API, integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, and production-readiness testing, with the technical depth to review designs and code
* Experience building metrics-driven programs using measures such as coverage, escape rate, defect trends, mean time to detect, release risk, and environment stability
* Practical experience using AI-assisted development, test-generation, analytics, automation, content-generation, or decision-support tools, with an understanding of responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority across QA, SRE, DevOps, product, application, and platform teams while maintaining a consistent quality bar under delivery pressure
* Experience hiring and scaling engineering teams in India, preferably across distributed or multi-site environments, and building an inclusive, high-accountability culture
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related technical field; a master’s degree is a plus

**Be Successful — Your Path**

**First 90 Days:** Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors through Blox Buddies, and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long-term goals.

**Six Months:**

* Operate automated build and development-cluster validation gates for every release candidate, with promotion decisions recorded and evidence collected automatically
* Establish the common test-automation framework and shared libraries, with regression suites running on a predictable schedule against a protected certification baseline
* Launch readiness scorecards and quality-risk reporting, including AI-assisted aggregation and analysis of release evidence with human review and clear auditability
* Complete staffing and onboarding for the CDA team, with the technical project manager driving milestones, dependencies, and stakeholder communications
* Define baseline measures for coverage, escape rate, defect trends, environment stability, and release-cycle efficiency; use the data to prioritize improvements

**One Year:**

* Establish CDA as the mandatory release-readiness gate for the SaaS platform, with staging certification and production-promotion decisions consistently supported by objective evidence
* Automate critical regression coverage for release candidates and demonstrate measurable improvement in customer-found defects and release-time Sev 1 and Sev 2 incidents
* Validate Tier 1 services for high availability, scale, performance, recovery, and deployment safety in partnership with SRE
* Integrate AI-assisted test development and release analytics into the operating model with appropriate security, privacy, governance, and human-review controls
* Establish a smooth interlock among CDA, Solutions QA, SRE, DevOps, CloudOps, application, and platform teams, with remediation routed and closed through a single visible workflow

**Belong —** **Your Community**

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.

**Be Rewarded —** **Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong**

* Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
* Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops
* Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy
* Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks, plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations
* Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match

**Ready to Be the Difference?**

**About the team:**  
Eightfold offers a suite of AI-powered products, including Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Workforce Exchange, and AI Interviewer. The Analytics team builds the customer-facing solutions that show how Eightfold delivers value across these products. Our work helps customers’ leadership teams make strategic workforce decisions and helps their recruiting teams operate more effectively day to day.
  
  
**Our analytics portfolio includes:**  
**Native reporting platform:** a reporting experience built directly into the Eightfold product.
  
  
**Agentic Dashboard Authoring:** AI-assisted dashboard creation, so users can go from question to insight without building reports by hand.
  
  
**Conversational Analytics:** natural-language access to data, letting users ask questions and get answers in plain English.
  
  
**Secure Talent Lake connectivity:** secure pipelines that let customers ETL their Eightfold data into their own data warehouses.
  
  
We’re in the middle of a major revamp of our analytics stack. Today we run on Redshift and Databricks, and we’re migrating to StarRocks across 8+ regions distributed globally on AWS, Azure, and Oracle Cloud. As Lead Platform / Data Engineer, you’ll play a central role in shaping this migration and the multi-cloud platform that comes out of it.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**  
Architect and manage the lakehouse. Design and maintain Apache Iceberg tables, including schema evolution, partitioning strategies, snapshot management, compaction, and metadata optimization.
  
  
Own the analytical query layer. Deploy, operate, and performance-tune open-source datawarehouse clusters, covering FE/BE sizing, materialized views, query profiling, caching, and resource isolation.
  
  
Optimize storage formats. Make deliberate choices about Parquet file layout, including row group sizing, compression codecs, encoding, and predicate pushdown, so data stays cheap to store and fast to query.
  
  
Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines. Develop robust batch and streaming pipelines with strong guarantees around data quality, idempotency, backfills, and observability.
  
  
Run event-driven autoscaling on Kubernetes. Design and implement KEDA-based scaling for data workloads, triggered by queue depth, Kafka lag, or custom metrics, so you balance cost against latency.
  
  
Manage infrastructure as code. Provision and maintain cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure using tools like Terraform, Helm, and GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Flux).
  
  
Tune self-hosted open-source warehouses. Diagnose bottlenecks across CPU, memory, I/O, and network. Tune configurations, run benchmarks, and drive measurable gains in query latency and cost efficiency.
  
  
Champion reliability. Define SLOs, build monitoring and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, or similar), participate in on-call, and lead incident retrospectives.
  
  
Mentor and influence. Review designs and code, mentor engineers, and help set technical direction for the data platform.
  
  
**What We Need:**  
5+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale data platforms, lakehouse architectures, and distributed analytical systems
  
Hands-on expertise with Apache Iceberg / Hudi and Parquet, including partitioning, schema evolution, compaction, snapshot management, and storage optimization.
  
Experience operating and performance-tuning analytical query engines such as StarRocks, ClickHouse, Trino, or similar distributed data warehouses.
  
Proficiency in building reliable batch and streaming pipelines using Apache Spark and Flink, with strong fundamentals in data quality, idempotency, fault tolerance, and observability.
  
Experience operating production-grade, multi-region cloud platforms across AWS, Azure, or OCI, with a focus on scalability, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.
  
Prior experience in mentoring engineers and leading projects while driving platform initiatives end-to-end.

Eightfold is a global leader in an AI-native enterprise talent platform, trusted by the world’s largest & most respected Fortune 500 organizations. Our platform is built from the ground up, operating at scale across Azure and AWS, deployed in multiple regions globally, including IL4-compliant environments for US Government, supporting users in 100+ countries and 30+ languages. Today, Eightfold is at the forefront of agentic AI, delivering intelligent agents that actively drive outcomes across hiring and talent workflows, while much of the industry is still experimenting with prototypes. Backed by over $410M in funding and valued at $2B+, we are defining the next era of agentic talent systems.
  
  
What sets Eightfold apart is not just the technology & our mission, but the team behind it. We are a deeply technical, execution-driven organization that values ownership, collaboration, and high standards. Our engineers, product leaders, and go-to-market teams work closely together in person and across functions to build systems that scale in the real world. If you’re excited to work on hard problems, move with urgency, raise the bar every day, and help build agentic systems that transform how the world works, Eightfold is the place to do it.
  
  
Our customers

Varun Kacholia (https://www.linkedin.com/in/varunkacholia/ ) &

title: Senior Director, Technology Operations
description:
Job Description:

  

Ready to lead the operations center that stops watching alerts and starts supervising autonomous systems at Thomson Reuters™?

  

At Thomson Reuters, we are transforming Service Management from a reactive, process-bound group into a proactive, intelligence-driven organization, one in which data flows into intelligence, intelligence into orchestration, and orchestration into execution. The Global Command Center (GCC) is where that model is realized: the 24×7 function that sees what is happening across our services, decides what needs to happen next, and makes it happen, increasingly with automation acting first and people handling the exceptions.

We are seeking a Senior Director of Service Operations, based in Bangalore, to lead this transformation. The majority of our operations population already sits in India, and this role puts senior leadership where that scale is. It is a run-side leadership role with a build-side partnership: our AI Operations (AIOps) and Workflow Engineering functions design the intelligence and the workflows, while you own turning those into daily operational practice. Your central mandate is to make L0 real, the tier in which AI and automation resolve issues ahead of human responders, with the GCC operating as L1 for exceptions and L2 reserved for genuine major incidents. Success looks like less toil, fewer escalations, fewer people with “eyes on glass,” and an operation that moves at the speed of the business.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

In this opportunity as Senior Director, Service Operations, you will:

  

* Lead the GCC as a single, consistent 24×7 function covering event triage, service health, operational communications, and real-time response, working through a distributed, multi-shift organization based primarily in India.
* Own the operational adoption of L0, defining the readiness criteria and decision gates under which the GCC allows automation to act ahead of human responders, and expanding that coverage service by service.
* Set and deliver the operational measures that matter, from alert-to-incident ratio and first-touch resolution at L1 to escalation rate, MTTD, MTTR, and auto-resolution rate, with reporting that makes operational posture clear to senior leadership at any moment.
* Move the operation from reactive to proactive, and over time from eyes on glass to on demand, reshaping the shift model, staffing, and skills profile around an exception-driven way of working, so that our engineers spend their time on judgment rather than triage.
* Extend GCC coverage across our products and services with consistent monitoring standards, runbook coverage, and communications, and extend the definition of operational health beyond infrastructure availability to application and customer journey experience.
* Grow the capability of an operations workforce whose role is changing from monitoring alerts to supervising automated systems, and build the leadership bench that will carry that change forward.
Feed operational reality back to AIOps, Workflow Engineering, and Problem Management under a clear build versus run separation, partnering closely with our separately led major incident management and automation engineering functions.  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

  

You’re a fit for the role of Senior Director, Service Operations if your background includes running operations at enterprise scale and changing how they run, not simply keeping them stable. Specifically:

  

* A minimum of 15 years of experience in technology operations, including at least 5 years leading a 24×7 command center, NOC, or global service operations function at enterprise scale. A bachelor’s degree in a technical field is required, with a master’s and relevant certifications (ITIL, ServiceNow, SRE, cloud) preferred.
* Proven experience leading large, distributed operations organizations in India, including leaders of leaders and multi-shift, follow-the-sun models, with a track record of raising consistency and quality across sites and shifts.
* Demonstrated operational adoption of AI and automation, having taken capability built by others and put it into safe, live production use with the guardrails, approval gates, readiness criteria, and rollback discipline that make it trustworthy, with measurable outcomes to point to.
* A track record of reducing toil and escalations by shifting resolution left into first-line teams and cutting alert noise, with the analytical habit of interrogating an escalation trend rather than accepting it.
* Experience taking a monitoring-led operation to an exception-led one, reducing the share of capacity spent on eyes-on-glass surveillance and redesigning shift and staffing models around on-demand engagement, without losing coverage or confidence along the way.
* Strong command of the event and incident lifecycle and the tooling behind it, including ServiceNow ITSM and Event Management, modern observability platforms, and the CMDB and tagging discipline that correlation depends on.
* The rigor to set, instrument, and defend operational targets across availability and SLOs, MTTD and MTTR, auto-resolution rate, and escalation rate, and to use them to change behavior rather than to report on it.
* Credibility and calm with senior stakeholders during major incidents, together with the change-leadership skill to take an established operations organization through a significant shift in how it works, including the people and morale dimensions of that change.
Clarity about the boundary between building and running, so that you are energized by partnering with engineering and AI functions on capability you do not own, and hold your side of that line without needing to widen it.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* A master’s degree in a technical field, or an equivalent advanced qualification.
Certifications such as ITIL, ServiceNow, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or cloud (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).  

#LI-VN1

  
  

**What’s in it For You?**

* **Hybrid Work Model:** We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* **Flexibility & Work-Life Balance:** Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* **Career Development and Growth:** By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
