**Role Purpose**
================

Wipro Technologies invites applications for the position of Snowflake Data Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in shaping robust, scalable cloud data infrastructure. As a key technical leader within the Applied AI & Data service line, you will collaborate cross-functionally with analytics, engineering, architecture, governance, and business teams to architect and maintain data ecosystems that promote data reliability, security, and governance. Your expertise will drive the transformation of disparate data sources into highly optimized, accessible data products tailored for advanced analytics and business intelligence.

We value innovation, efficiency, and a collaborative approach to solve complex data challenges. This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute significantly to enterprise-scale data solutions while working within an energized team focused on digital transformation and sustainable data excellence.

**͏**
-----

**Key Responsibilities & Qualifications**
=========================================

* Design, develop, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines and ELT processes using Snowflake's platform capabilities to enable seamless ingestion, transformation, and consumption of data.
* Build and maintain robust data models including dimensional, normalized, and Data Vault models that support diverse analytical needs, ensuring flexibility and scalability.
* Leverage SQL, Python, and orchestration tools such as dbt, Airflow, or equivalent to create efficient data workflows, while implementing comprehensive automated testing and monitoring frameworks.
* Configure Snowflake virtual warehouses, clustering keys, resource monitors, and query profiles to maximize performance and cost-effectiveness.
* Implement and maintain strict data security measures including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), masking policies, secure views, and data-sharing protocols to safeguard sensitive information in compliance with governance standards.
* Troubleshoot complex pipeline issues, data quality inconsistencies, and performance bottlenecks through detailed root-cause analyses and proactive resolution strategies.
* Collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams and stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into practical, scalable data solutions while adhering to Agile methodologies and participating in code reviews and continuous improvement cycles.
* Document technical designs, data lineage, operational procedures, and architecture decisions to support knowledge sharing and ongoing platform governance.
* Monitor usage metrics and provide actionable recommendations to enhance platform reliability, scalability, and cost optimization in dynamic cloud environments.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Minimum of 5 years’ direct experience in data engineering roles with demonstrated capabilities in cloud-based data platforms, especially Snowflake.
* Proven expertise with Snowflake features including data ingestion with Snowpipe, Streams & Tasks for continuous data operations, Time Travel, zero-copy cloning, and semi-structured data handling (such as JSON, Avro, Parquet).
* Proficiency in SQL and Python scripting for complex data manipulation, automation, and workflow orchestration.
* Experience deploying ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools like dbt, Apache Airflow, or Azure Data Factory.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices including version control with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment automation.
* Strong understanding of data modeling techniques, metadata management, data quality and governance frameworks.
* Exceptional problem-solving skills combined with the ability to manage diverse stakeholder relationships effectively.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Certifications such as SnowPro Core & Advanced or relevant cloud/platform certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Experience with additional data technologies and platforms including Kafka, Fivetran, Power BI, Tableau, or Snowpark development.
* Knowledge of emerging architectural paradigms like data mesh, lakehouse, and experience with infrastructure as code and DevOps methodologies.
* Prior exposure to managing enterprise-grade, globally distributed data operations with regulated data requirements.

**͏**
-----

**Solution Design**
===================

As a Snowflake Data Engineer at Wipro Technologies, you will spearhead the design of scalable cloud data solutions tailored to client-specific business scenarios. You will facilitate technical design workshops and collaborate closely with project managers and technical architects to ensure solution alignment with enterprise architecture roadmaps and business objectives. Your role includes analyzing complex data integration challenges and architecting modular, reusable components that balance performance and maintainability.

**͏**
-----

**Coding, Configuration & Implementation**
==========================================

You will ensure high-quality code delivery by reviewing implementations thoroughly, resolving technical challenges within the engineering team, and establishing consistent data replication and transformation patterns compliant with project standards. Throughout the software development lifecycle, you will work with project managers and agile teams to ensure seamless integration, staging, and deployment of data solutions. Your role extends to implementing automated pipelines, validating configurations, and driving adoption through comprehensive user documentation and training materials designed to minimize operational risks and facilitate smooth transitions during deployments.

Additionally, you will proactively conduct root-cause analysis for recurring issues, optimize system performance, and recommend refinements to accelerate response times and enhance data reliability.

**͏**
-----

**Competencies and Skills**
===========================

* **Technical Expertise:** Advanced proficiency in Snowflake data engineering, including architecture, ELT design, query optimization, and cloud integration.
* **Communication:** Clear, effective communication skills to engage diverse stakeholders, articulate complex technical concepts, and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
* **Collaborative Working:** Ability to foster a cooperative environment, working inclusively with peers, product owners, and business units.

**Data Engineer in Global IT at Novo Nordisk Engineering**  
  
Do you want to help Novo Nordisk Engineering (NNE) to become more data driven and work with the latest data technologies? Then we have an exciting opportunity for you as Data Engineer in NNE!!
  
  
What do we do at NNE? We are experts in end-to-end pharma engineering, and we design and build pharma facilities that are essential for millions of patients all over the world. Our success is built on our relationships, both with our colleagues and our customers. If you are passionate about working for a noble cause on projects shaping the future of sustainable and intelligent pharma facilities, NNE is the place to be.
  
  
**About The Role**  
  
As Data Engineer you will work on highly important data projects that will transform how engineering data is used on pharma projects. A few years ago, NNE embarked on a new data journey to build Azure-based data platform. As the dependency on data is only growing across NNE, we are looking for a new data engineer to support the efforts. You will become part of a strong team within NNE Global IT of 50+ employees and work in a cross-department data platform team data engineers, data analysts and subject-matter experts).
  
  
**Location**: Bengaluru
  
**Department**: Global IT
  
**Experience Min.** 3-5 years Employment Type Full Time

**How You Might Spend Your Days**  
  
**As a Data Engineer, you’ll:**
  
  
Maintain NNE’s data platform infrastructure in Microsoft Fabric
  
Help with data storage, processing and data modelling.
  
Design ETL/ELT processes & build data pipelines
  
Collaborate with business stakeholders to help them get the most of their data
  
Communicate how data can be used in new ways within NNE
  
Prioritize support for operational tasks
  
Spend remaining time on development tasks.
  
  
**Who You Are**  
  
**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy, is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:**
  
  
Encourage teamwork and collaboration across skillsets
  
Understand how technology can empower business, and can articulate the value of data solutions
  
Are well-organized, can plan your work, and can communicate progress on activities
  
Have analytical skills combined with technical understanding
  
Have good cross-cultural understanding, and fluency in written and spoken English are essential – the IT team is international, and department meetings are conducted in English
  
  
**The miles you’ve walked**  
  
**In all positions there are some things that are needed, and others a bonus. We believe these qualifications are needed for you to do well in this role:**
  
  
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in relevant field
  
2+ years of experience within data engineering
  
Experience with SQL and Python
  
Experience with ETL/ELT processes
  
Hands-on experience with Azure services such as Azure Synapse Analytics and/or in Microsoft Fabric will be considered a plus.
  
Knowledge of Kimball’s data modelling principles will be considered a plus

If you do not check all the boxes, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role.
  
  
Why choose NNE?
  
  
We provide a range of perks and benefits tailored to enhance your overall experience. Some highlights include:
  
  
Vibrant and project-based work environment
  
Collaboration and innovation-based culture
  
True empowerment and flexible working conditions
  
  
**Unleash your potential**  
  
NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more. We do not expect you to know it all, and we recognize that a great onboarding experience is key. We therefore greet new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding program, and in-house talent programs designed to keep our biggest asset – you - developed for the long-run.
  
  
Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

**What you'll be doing**

Develop and optimize production-grade predictive ML models and generative AI capabilities, constructing MLOps training pipelines and advanced LLM interaction logic while providing technical guidance to other engineers.

* Develop and optimize predictive ML models for use cases such as demand forecasting and inventory optimization, and the Layla advisor.
* Construct and maintain MLOps training pipelines across cloud AI platforms (e.g. Azure AI, Google Vertex AI, AWS SageMaker), including experiment tracking, model versioning, and reproducible training.
* Write and optimize advanced LLM prompt interaction logic for the company's enterprise GenAI platform (Alia), including retrieval-augmented generation and vector database integration.
* Build and implement generative AI and agentic solutions using LLM APIs and orchestration frameworks and help evaluate and adopt new AI tools within the squad.
* Engineer features and build feature stores using SQL and Python , working with structured, semi-structured, and time-series data to improve model performance, precision, and recall. Data and AI Reports to Senior Manager, Data Intelligence Bengaluru.
* Deploy and integrate model inference endpoints, both real-time and batch, via REST and GraphQL APIs into production systems.
* Establish model performance metrics (accuracy, F1, AUC) and LLM evaluation metrics (e.g. relevance, groundedness, hallucination rate), and monitor for model drift, defining retraining strategies and triggers.
* Apply fairness and bias-mitigation techniques and support responsible AI and model governance practices.
* Link model outputs to business KPIs and value creation, and document models, experiments, and assumptions for reproducibility and reuse.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to AI/ML engineers, and collaborate with data engineering, MLOps, and product teams to integrate models into production.

**What you’ll need to succeed**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in applied machine learning or AI engineering.
* Strong proficiency in Python and machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn), with feature engineering and experiment tracking (MLflow).
* Strong SQL skills for data exploration, feature engineering, and working with cloud data warehouses (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake).
* Hands-on experience constructing MLOps training pipelines across Azure AI and GCP, with model versioning and monitoring.
* Experience with generative AI and large language models, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and vector databases.
* Hands-on experience implementing AI solutions with LLM APIs and models (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, open-source models), orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex), and tools for evaluation, guardrails, and LLM observability (e.g. LangSmith, Langfuse).
* Solid grasp of the model development lifecycle: training, hyperparameter tuning, evaluation, deployment, drift detection, and retraining.
* Experience deploying model inference endpoints via REST and GraphQL APIs, with fairness, bias mitigation, and responsible AI practices.
* Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) for AI-assisted development.

**What we can offer you**

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.

**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

title: Collaboration Platforms Administrator
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the Team and Role**

  
  

We’re excited to bring on a Collaboration Platforms Administrator based in Bangalore, India. As part of eBay’s Global Collaboration Services organization, this support-focused role will provide day-to-day operational support for our enterprise collaboration ecosystem, with primary responsibility for email services, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Slack, in addition to other services managed by the Collaboration Platforms team. The position will work as part of a global team of 10 direct peers supporting collaboration services at enterprise scale. We rely on this person to help keep these platforms operating securely, reliably, and efficiently, serving as a key point of ownership for L3 requests, troubleshooting, and escalations. This role will partner closely with IAM, Helpdesk Support, Security, Procurement, Collaboration Platforms Engineering, and business stakeholders to support service reliability, user needs, and ongoing platform operations.

  
  

Experience supporting collaboration and messaging platforms in a large global enterprise environment (20,000+ users).
  
Experience administering Slack Enterprise Grid in a large enterprise environment.

Experience with Microsoft Graph, Exchange Online PowerShell, Google Apps Script, Google Workspace Admin APIs, or similar administrative automation tools.
  
Experience implementing or supporting AI governance, enterprise AI capabilities, AI-powered automation, and collaboration platform integrations.

  
  

The ITSS Collaboration Platforms team enables eBay employees to communicate, collaborate, and work securely across the globe.

We administer and support enterprise messaging and collaboration technologies including Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Slack Enterprise Grid, Google Workspace, Cisco Cloud Email Security, and a portfolio of SaaS collaboration applications. Our team focuses on delivering secure, reliable, and scalable messaging and collaboration services while driving operational excellence, automation, and continuous improvement.

As a Collaboration Platform Administrator, you will provide operational support and administration for our collaboration ecosystem. You'll work closely with engineers, security teams, service owners, business partners, and vendors to troubleshoot issues, implement platform improvements, support integrations, and ensure our messaging and collaboration services remain highly available, secure, and scalable.

  
  

**What You'll Accomplish**

  
  

* Administer and support enterprise messaging and collaboration platforms including Exchange Online, Microsoft 365, Slack Enterprise Grid, Google Workspace, Cisco Cloud Email Security, and other SaaS collaboration services.
* Manage and troubleshoot enterprise email services, including mail flow, message hygiene, transport rules, mail routing, connectors, shared mailboxes, distribution lists, and email authentication technologies such as SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
* Support enterprise email security by administering Cisco Cloud Email Security policies, investigating phishing and spoofing incidents, analyzing message traces, and partnering with Information Security on email-related threats and escalations.
* Perform day-to-day platform administration, configuration, troubleshooting, incident response, and service restoration while meeting established service level objectives.
* Support platform security through identity management, access controls, data protection policies, and security best practices.
    
  Configure and support collaboration applications such as Monday.com, Figma, Lucid Software, Smartsheet, Calendly, Zoom, and related productivity platforms.
* Implement and maintain integrations between collaboration platforms using APIs, automation tools, and third-party applications.
* Support AI-enabled capabilities across collaboration platforms, including AI assistants, workflow automation, MCP servers, approved third-party AI integrations, and emerging AI technologies.
* Create and maintain automation using PowerShell, Google Apps Script, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, or similar technologies to improve operational efficiency.
* Develop operational reporting, dashboards, and metrics to improve service health, platform adoption, email deliverability, and operational efficiency.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, and standard operating procedures.
* Participate in change management activities, platform upgrades, testing, and production deployments.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Security, Identity, Infrastructure, Compliance, Legal, Vendor Support, and business stakeholders to resolve complex technical issues.
* Partner with service owners and vendors to evaluate new features, validate platform changes, and support the rollout of enhancements that improve security, reliability, and the employee collaboration experience.
* Participate in a global follow-the-sun weekday operational support rotation, providing on-call coverage during assigned regional business hours and ensuring seamless support through coordinated handoffs across global teams.
  

  

**What You'll Bring**

  
  

* 5+ years of experience administering enterprise messaging and collaboration platforms in large-scale environments.
* Strong hands-on experience supporting Exchange Online, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Slack Enterprise Grid, and enterprise email infrastructure.
* Experience administering enterprise email security platforms such as Cisco Cloud Email Security (IronPort), Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Proofpoint, Mimecast, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of enterprise mail flow, SMTP, message routing, connectors, transport rules, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and email security best practices.
* Experience troubleshooting complex email delivery issues, message trace analysis, phishing investigations, and mail routing problems.
* Experience supporting SaaS collaboration platforms such as Monday.com, Figma, Lucid Software, Smartsheet, Calendly, Zoom, or similar technologies.
* Experience supporting identity and access management technologies, including SSO, SAML, SCIM provisioning, OAuth, and enterprise authentication.
* Experience working with REST APIs, Microsoft Graph API, Google Workspace APIs, Slack APIs, automation platforms, or scripting languages such as PowerShell or Google Apps Script.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity tools, AI agents, MCP servers, workflow automation, and enterprise governance of AI capabilities.
* Experience using monitoring, reporting, or log analysis tools such as Splunk or similar platforms.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across multiple cloud platforms.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams and support both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment while maintaining a strong customer service focus.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  
  

* Experience supporting collaboration and messaging platforms in a large global enterprise environment (20,000+ users).
* Experience administering Slack Enterprise Grid in a large enterprise environment.
* Experience with Microsoft Graph, Exchange Online PowerShell, Google Apps Script, Google Workspace Admin APIs, or similar administrative automation tools.
* Experience implementing or supporting AI governance, enterprise AI capabilities, AI-powered automation, and collaboration platform integrations.

**Additional Details**

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

title: Quantitative Engineer - Associate
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Summary**:

The Tax-Advantaged Equity (TAE) team is seeking to enhance its investment platform, analytics, and portfolio management capabilities by adding a partner focused on developing scalable technology and data-driven solutions that support portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, and investment professionals.

This role will focus on building and modernizing investment applications, analytics platforms, workflow tools, and data pipelines that support tax-managed equity strategies, portfolio construction, tax-loss harvesting, investment analytics, and portfolio management processes.

The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering and cloud development expertise with an understanding of investment management workflows. This individual will work closely with portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, and analytics teams to design and deliver modern applications and scalable platforms that improve investment decision-making, operational efficiency, and client outcomes.

This role is central to advancing the TAE technology platform by embedding modern engineering practices, cloud-native solutions, and data analytics capabilities into the investment process.

**Major Responsibilities:**

* Partner with the Tax-Advantaged Equity team to design, develop, and maintain investment technology platforms supporting portfolio management, tax optimization, investment analytics, and research workflows.
* Build modern web applications and dashboards using .NET, C#, and cloud-native technologies to provide portfolio managers and researchers with intuitive access to investment insights and workflow tools.
* Develop scalable APIs, services, and application frameworks that support portfolio construction, tax-loss harvesting, portfolio monitoring, and investment reporting capabilities.
* Design and maintain cloud-based data pipelines that aggregate, normalize, and distribute investment, benchmark, portfolio, holdings, transaction, and market data for research and production use cases.
* Leverage Azure Cloud technologies to build resilient, secure, and scalable solutions that support the investment lifecycle.
* Develop Python-based analytics and automation tools that improve research productivity, portfolio analytics, and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with quantitative researchers and portfolio managers to implement new investment models, portfolio optimization techniques, and analytical capabilities.
* Improve application performance, scalability, and reliability by applying software engineering best practices, testing frameworks, and CI/CD processes.
* Work with cross-functional teams across Investments, Technology, Data Engineering, and Analytics to ensure technology solutions align with business objectives.
* Identify innovative solutions to complex business and technical challenges and advocate for their implementation through effective communication and stakeholder engagement.
* Engage with business stakeholders to gather requirements, provide updates, and ensure successful delivery of technology solutions.
* Work within established development, security, governance, and risk management standards.

**Knowledge/Skills:**

* Strong software engineering and application development experience, preferably within financial services or investment management.
* Experience building enterprise applications using.NET and C#.
* Understanding of Azure Cloud, cloud-native architectures, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Experience developing data-driven solutions and analytics platforms using Python.
* Familiarity with investment management concepts including Equities, Portfolio Construction, Tax-managed investing, Portfolio analytics, Risk management and Investment workflows.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, DevOps practices, and modern engineering principles.
* Ability to connect technology solutions with business outcomes in an investment management environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, investment analysts, and technology partners.
* Experience with relational databases, SQL, and data modeling.
* Familiarity with modern web application architectures and API development.

**Experience Required:**

* 1-4 years of experience in software engineering, quantitative engineering, investment technology, or data engineering.
* Strong proficiency in C# .NET, React, Python and SQL.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure DevOps, Azure Storage, Azure SQL or equivalent cloud services.
* Experience building APIs, enterprise applications, dashboards, and cloud-based solutions.
* Exposure to investment management, asset management, or financial services is preferred.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative discipline.

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. title: Software Development Manager
description:
**About the role**  

Software Development Managers (SDMs) establish and sustain the environment for development to exist and success. They drive continuous improvement of engineering practises and improve the efficiency of the development in Tesco. They are responsible for the entire development process for a software programme and are hands-on, contributing to the end solution.

SDE Technology coaching and development

Software Development Managers (SDMs) establish and sustain the environment for development to exist and succeed. Their primary focus is to hire, retain and develop our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) through creating and aligning individual’s short- and long-term objectives and development plan alongside the goals of the wider team and business. They evolve the right tailored approaches to manage and develop their SDEs including regular 1-2-1 meetings, identifying mentors or mentees and providing impromptu coaching inputs. SDMs help split the scope of work across one or more SDEs depending on their strengths and areas of improvement. They actively work to set the SDEs up for success, providing course corrections as necessary. SDMs also help SDEs get the right mentorship to ensure they grow more expertise and to address any weaknesses hindering their effectiveness.

Team structure and technology processes

SDMs build effective, performing teams that consistently deliver quality software whilst balancing the demands of timeframes and needs. They put in place the ingredients for teams to succeed, including the right level of process, practices and data gathering to help the team constantly improve. SDMs default to granting teams autonomy but recognise when stronger guidance and help from them is needed. When the team is performing, an SDM offers a light-touch to assist in unblocking progress. When a team is struggling the SDM identifies and actions a plan to help. They build an effective customer engagement process to ensure their teams have awareness of the importance of good customer experience and show responsiveness to customer experience during development as well as in operational issues. They drive continuous improvement of engineering practises and efficiency of development within their team and foster innovation. They empower their engineers to own technical decisions whilst providing guidance and enforcing best practices. They are hands-on when required but are always aware of their primary focus when doing so.

Delivery and stakeholder management

SDMs deliver the right outcomes and collaborate with the appropriate stakeholders and customers, whether directly responsible for the functional delivery of a team or working across multiple teams. They build healthy empathetic relationships to arrive at consensus and overcome any conflicts. Within their operating domain, they demonstrate ownership over the relevant areas of work and can also reach out to, and execute effectively with, peers and other stakeholders when needed to ensure the success of broader, more complex outcomes. SDMs are accountable for the slices they own in a program and proactively identify risks, propose mitigations and get them reviewed with their manager, stakeholders and customers. They also know when to ask for help or escalate. SDMs are great at spoken and written communication.

Technical strategy

SDM is responsible for the development and oversight of the technical roadmap and strategy in order to support growth objectives while strengthening the business core to develop and maintain a competitive advantage. The SDM plays a key role in formulation of the technical roadmap and strategy, collaborates with both internal and external stakeholders, and leads cross-functional teams in the development of the roadmap. There are three outcome expected from SDM as part of Technical Strategy. o Understand technology landscape and its implication to retail Industry -[White paper or Blog] o Evaluate, prototype and present implementation use cases. [Demos] o Induce Tesco approved technology change to their respective domains. [Produce compliance reports] SDM participates in various meet-ups, seminars and events to understand technology advancements in the industry and collaborates with the team to develop prototypes. SDM interacts continuously with end users and product managers to keep them current with new possibilities of technology applications and value it brings for our customers. SDM drives architecture, design, implementation, adoption and re-usability of such new technology by sharing their work with peer SDMs and create culture of innovation and technical excellence within the team and at Tesco at broader level.

  
**You will be responsible for**  

Technology Skills :

1. Backend Skills and API development knowledge in Java Spring Boot

2. UI Skills on Mobile Devices (Android, iOS, Hybrid)

3. Knowledge of Mobile Devices used in enterprises (Ex. Zebra TC53, Honeywell CT45XP, Urovo DT50, Samsung handhelds, Mobile label Printers from Toshiba and Zebra)

4. Cloud Technologies (Preferably Azure, VMware)

5. Knowledge of TDD, CI,CD, Automation on Cloud and onPremise

6. Large Scale Applications Development, Operations and migration in enterprise environments

7. Knowledge of Security, Networking, Architecture, infrastructure

8. Knowledge of Operations, Oncall, Observability and tools involved like Newrelic

 **You will need**  

Team Management :

Should have managed 6-8 member team as a Lead or Manager to deliver business value with required engineering practices and excellence

  
  
**Whats in it for you?**  

At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you.

As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day.

Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.

Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable.

**Salary** - Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment.

**Leave & Time-off** - Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy.

**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary** - In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF.

**Health is Wealth** - Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws.

**Mental Wellbeing** - We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.

**Financial Wellbeing** - Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.

**Save As You Earn (SAYE)** - Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan.

**Physical Wellbeing** - Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle.

**About Us**  

At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve.

At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed.

We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

When you join Tesco Bengaluru in this role, you'll be employed by Tesco Bengaluru Private Limited, the Tesco legal entity responsible for your employment.

==================================================

Req ID: 127086

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

  

Within our technology team we are

  

Our community of over 5,000 engineers is key to making this happen, because technology underpins every part of our business - from delivering tools, apps and services for our customers, to building a bank for the future.

**About the Role**
------------------

The GM – Data and AI Engineering, Delivery is responsible for leading the engineering and delivery capability that underpins the organisation’s data and AI ambitions. This role ensures the reuse of enterprise-wide secure, scalable, and high-quality data pipelines, transformations, and build out of the data products to support business use-cases/ outputs, business applications, advanced analytics and AI/ ML outcomes.

  

Reporting to the Chief Data & AI Officer, this role bridges strategy and execution, translating data and AI priorities into reliable, production-ready data products and engineering practices. You will drive reuse, automation and embrace cross-divisional ways of working, and standardised delivery models that support efficient, high-quality outcomes across the enterprise.

As a senior leader, you will partner closely with architecture, governance, AI portfolio teams, and business stakeholders to ensure that data is accessible, trustworthy, and ready to power everything including, AI models and decision-making at scale.

  

**Role Type: Permanent**  
**Role Location: Bengaluru**  
**Work Hours: Full Time**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

* Lead the Data and AI engineering function, including capability development, standards, and ways of working
* Establish and embed modern engineering practices (Agile, DevOps, DataOps) across teams
* Design, build, and reuse secure, scalable data pipelines and transformations
* Deliver reusable, high-quality data products that enable business use-cases/ outputs, business applications, advanced analytics and AI/ ML outcomes
* Provide high-quality, production-ready data outputs to support AI and ML model development
* Define and enforce engineering standards, frameworks, and best practices
* Ensure high standards of data quality, lineage, and observability
* Oversee end-to-end delivery of data and AI engineering initiatives
* Manage prioritisation, backlog, and execution across multiple teams and delivery streams
* Partner with architecture, governance, AI Portfolio, platform teams, and business stakeholders
* Align engineering delivery to enterprise architecture, data governance, and AI strategy
* Ensure data pipelines and products meet security, privacy, and regulatory requirements
* Drive improvements in engineering efficiency, automation, and delivery performance
* Foster a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and quality improvement

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

* Deep expertise in data engineering, data pipelines, and large-scale data processing
* Strong experience in AI/ML data enablement and integration with engineering workflows
* Proven ability to build and scale data products and reusable engineering assets
* Strong understanding of modern data architectures (data lakes, warehouses, streaming, data mesh)
* Experience with cloud-based data platforms and engineering tools
* Knowledge of DataOps, DevOps, and agile delivery practices
* Strong understanding of data governance, quality, lineage, and security requirements
* Proven leadership of large engineering and delivery teams at scale
* Excellent stakeholder engagement and ability to translate business needs into technical delivery
* Execution excellence at scale, delivering complex data engineering initiatives reliably across multiple teams
* Bridging strategy to delivery, translating data and AI priorities into engineered solutions and assets
* Engineering quality and discipline, driving standards, reusability, and sustainable practices
* Master’s degree or PhD degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Actuarial Studies, Data Science or AI with proven, hands on enterprise deployment experience in financial services
* Architecture: deep understanding of modern data lakehouse architecture, data fabric and AI model architecture
* Banking domain: deep understanding of financial data, fraud detection, credit score

**So why join us?**
-------------------

ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 8,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.

  

We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.

description:
The Application Vulnerability Management Specialist is a security-focused individual contributor responsible for identifying, prioritising and coordinating the remediation of vulnerabilities across WSP’s COTS and Microsoft 365 application portfolio. The estate includes:

* Collaboration — tools that connect people and teams (e.g. Zoom, Teams).
* Productivity — applications that support day-to-day business output (e.g. Microsoft 365 Apps, Adobe Acrobat, Google Workspace, Smartsheet).
* Utilities — general end-user desktop utilities that support the estate (e.g. WinZip / 7-Zip, TeamViewer, Notepad++, Snagit).

Using Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow, you will turn vulnerability data into clear priorities, coordinate remediation with technical teams and suppliers, and report progress to stakeholders. You will apply risk factors such as CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, asset criticality and business impact to reduce exposure while maintaining operational stability across a global environment.

  

Identify and Prioritise Risk

* Maintain an accurate view of application vulnerabilities, affected devices and remediation status using Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow.
* Assess and prioritise findings using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, exploit intelligence, asset criticality and business context.
Monitor vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and security-baseline gaps across COTS and Microsoft 365 applications.  

Coordinate Remediation

* Coordinate patching, configuration changes and other mitigations with End User Device, deployment, engineering and supplier teams.
* Manage findings from validation through remediation, verification and closure, with clear ownership and agreed service levels.
Manage time-bound exceptions and risk acceptances, documenting compensating controls and reviewing them at expiry.

Contribute security and vulnerability requirements to the onboarding and review of business applications.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**  
We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to design, develop, and optimize scalable data ingestion and processing pipelines. The candidate will work across batch and real-time data processing, object storage, analytical data layers, and reusable data transformation frameworks. The role requires strong hands-on engineering skills and the ability to build reliable, configurable, and maintainable data solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**  
· Design, develop, and maintain batch and real-time data ingestion pipelines.

· Build data processing workflows using Python, SQL, Apache Spark, and PySpark.

· Implement streaming pipelines using Apache Kafka, including buffering, replay, and failure recovery.

· Develop layered data architectures covering raw, cleansed, transformed, and curated datasets.

· Build reusable components for data cleansing, joins, aggregations, validation, and transformations.

· Integrate object storage with analytical table formats and processing engines.

· Implement schema discovery, schema evolution, data quality checks, and metadata management.

· Work with structured and semi-structured formats, including Parquet, CSV, and JSON.

· Develop data decoding and transformation workflows based on provided data dictionaries, format specifications, scaling rules, and engineering units.

· Optimize Spark jobs, data partitioning, incremental processing, and analytical workloads.

· Implement logging, monitoring, error handling, and recovery mechanisms for data pipelines.

· Collaborate with backend and frontend engineers to integrate data services with application APIs and user interfaces.

· Containerize services using Docker and support development and deployment in Linux-based, on-premises environments.

· Write test cases, troubleshoot pipeline failures, and maintain technical documentation.

Required Skills

· 5–6 years of hands-on experience in data engineering and pipeline development.

· Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, Apache Spark, and PySpark.

· Practical experience with Apache Kafka and real-time or near-real-time data processing.

· Experience designing batch and streaming pipelines, including retries, checkpointing, replay, and fault handling.

· Hands-on experience with object storage such as SeaweedFS, MinIO, or S3-compatible storage.

· Experience with Apache Iceberg or comparable lakehouse table formats, including schema evolution, partitioning, and metadata management.

· Strong understanding of Parquet, CSV, JSON, schema management, and data validation.

· Experience building layered data architectures and reusable transformation frameworks.

· Experience implementing joins, aggregations, incremental processing, and data quality rules.

· Experience optimizing Spark jobs and handling large datasets efficiently.

· Familiarity with PostgreSQL or equivalent relational databases.

· Experience with REST APIs, Docker, Linux, Git, and software debugging.

· Ability to develop configurable pipelines that can be extended to new datasets and processing requirements.

Pay: ₹1,010,000.00 - ₹1,880,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bangalore City, Bengaluru, Karnataka

title: Software Principal Engineer
description:
**Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

**Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.**

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

**Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology.**

**Principal DevOps / Software Engineer (Cloud Orchestration & Platform Engineering)**

The Software Engineering team delivers next-generation application enhancements and new products for a changing world. Working at the cutting edge, we design and develop software for platforms, peripherals, applications and diagnostics — all with the most advanced technologies, tools, software engineering methodologies and the collaboration of internal and external partners.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Software Principal Engineer on our Software Engineering Team in **Bangalore, India**.

**What you’ll achieve**

As a Principal DevOps / Software Engineer, you will architect, build, and evolve the cloud automation, orchestration, and platform capabilities that power our global development ecosystem. You will work deeply within our VMware‑based infrastructure stack, spanning Aria Automation, Aria Operations, VCF, ESXi, and vCenter, while driving modernization toward next‑generation VCF Operations and AI‑enabled orchestration frameworks.

You will partner closely with our software engineering Scrum teams to deliver resilient, intelligent, and scalable automation services that enhance developer productivity, streamline reservation and deployment workflows, and maintain the reliability of critical DevOps tool chains. Your leadership will influence both technology strategy and hands‑on implementation across complex hybrid‑cloud environments.

**You will:**

* Design, implement, and evolve cloud automation and orchestration workflows for VMware‑based platforms, including Aria Automation/Operations and emerging VCF Operations
* Architect and maintain integrations with ServiceNow, reservation systems, deployment services, and asset management platforms supporting global engineering teams

* Lead modernization initiatives as Aria is modernized, transitioning orchestration capabilities into new VCF‑based platforms and intelligent automation ecosystems
* Create automation frameworks, APIs, and services enabling self‑service provisioning, developer tooling, and global platform operations
* Collaborate closely within Agile/SCRUM teams to design high‑quality automation, observability, and platform capabilities aligned with product engineering needs
* Drive architectural discussions, document solutions, and mentor engineering peers in DevOps engineering, platform automation, and VMware‑centered cloud technologies
* Champion secure-by-design engineering practices, reliable CI/CD methodologies, and scalable operational patterns across the stack

  

**Take the first step towards your dream career**  
Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:  
  
**Essential Requirements**

* **8–12 years of professional experience** in DevOps engineering, cloud automation, or software engineering, with senior‑level ownership of infrastructure orchestration and developer‑focused services
* Expert-level proficiency with **VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), vCenter, ESXi**, and enterprise‑scale virtualization management
* Extensive hands-on experience with **VMware Aria Automation (vRA/vRealize), Aria Operations, and orchestration tooling**, including lifecycle management, blueprints, policies, and extensibility
* Demonstrated experience architecting and developing **complex automation pipelines**, including API-driven workflows, infrastructure-as-code, and multi‑platform integrations
* Strong programming or scripting expertise (Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or equivalent) for automation, platform integration, and orchestration logic
* Experience integrating DevOps automation with **ServiceNow**, including CMDB synchronization, workflow automation, and custom orchestration triggers
* Deep understanding of **cloud automation frameworks**, CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, and enterprise DevOps practices
* Strong knowledge of **platform observability**, operational analytics, and distributed system diagnostics
* Ability to lead architectural initiatives, produce clear technical documentation, and mentor cross-functional engineering teams
* Experience operating within Agile/SCRUM teams, influencing strategy across multiple software and infrastructure groups
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with global engineering, operations, and platform teams

  

**Desirable Requirements**

* Experience with **ServiceNow development**, including scripting, custom integrations, API development, and platform configuration
* Exposure to **IPAM solutions** or network services automation (e.g., Infoblox or equivalent)
* Strong familiarity with **Agile/SCRUM methodologies** and enterprise SDLC practices
* Experience with **GitOps** and container‑oriented tooling such as Kubernetes, Helm, Kustomize, or related platforms
* Exposure to **Agentic AI / GenAI** as applied to workflow automation, intelligent orchestration, or advanced developer tooling
* Experience developing automation for hybrid cloud or multi‑cloud environments
* Understanding of infrastructure security, RBAC models, and enterprise compliance frameworks

  

**Who we are**

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.  
Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

**Informa** is a leading academic publishing, business intelligence, knowledge and events business, creating unique content and connectivity for customers all over the world. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a member of the FTSE 100.

**Taylor & Francis** is one of the world’s largest publishers of high-quality, peer reviewed scholarly journals, books, e-books and reference works. We empower learners, thinkers and doers with trusted knowledge that advances research and enriches lives. We bring together diverse people, ideas and opinions to validate and publish the experts, theories and truths that matter. And we’ve been doing this in an unbroken arc since 1798.

Our purpose is to foster human progress through knowledge. We strongly believe that this requires us to encourage and examine different ideas and voices, so that any work that meets our exacting levels of quality deserves to be included in our publications. This requires open minds, the opportunity for robust debate, and the courage to defend perspectives that stand up to scrutiny, even if they conflict with our personal beliefs or values. Because that’s the only way to find the best obtainable version of the truth and, ultimately, foster human progress. If you agree, then we’d love to hear from you.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Quality Engineer with strong expertise in automation and modern Quality Engineering practices. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience on creating automated data validation scripts to test ETL data pipelines and report bugs or glitches. This position requires hands-on experience in ETL Testing and Automated Test Development. You will also be responsible for UI, API, backend, and performance testing, with a passion for engineering scalable automation solutions, driving quality throughout the SDLC, and leveraging AI-powered tools to improve software quality and delivery.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and manage the data quality framework across production data pipelines.
* Build reusable data quality checks using tools such as Great Expectations or equivalent frameworks.
* Working with large and complex data sets (SQL and No-SQL), data lakes (S3) and data warehouses (Redshift).
* Test Automation - Build automated data validation scripts to test the quality of data in data lake (S3) and data warehouses (Redshift).
* Define checks for schema, null values, uniqueness, referential integrity, data volume, freshness, late-arriving data, and business rules.
* Integrate data quality checks at ingestion, transformation, and pre-publish stages.
* Participate in requirements analysis, test strategy, test planning, risk assessment, test estimation, and release validation activities.
* Validate REST APIs, backend services, databases, and microservices through automated and manual testing.
* Perform performance and load testing using JMeter or BlazeMeter, analyse bottlenecks, and provide recommendations for performance improvements.
* Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, ensuring quality gates, automated reporting, and continuous feedback.
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Developers, DevOps, Business Analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure high-quality software delivery.
* Perform defect analysis, root cause analysis (RCA), and support production issue investigations.
* Leverage AI-powered engineering tools (such as Claude Code) to accelerate test design, automation development, defect analysis, and framework maintenance.
* Continuously improve automation coverage, framework stability, execution efficiency, and engineering best practices.
* Mentor junior Quality Engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Experience:**

* 3–4 years of experience in Quality Engineering, with strong expertise in Data Engineering, Data Quality, or Data Reliability Engineering.
* Hands-on experience with data quality frameworks such as Great Expectations, Soda, dbt Tests, Deequ, or equivalent tools.
* Strong SQL skills, including window functions, complex joins, and queries on large partitioned datasets.
* Minimum 2 year of hands-on coding experience in Python.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in ETL testing of Data Pipelines and Data Warehouse.
* Experience with cloud data lake technologies, including S3, Glue, Athena, Spark on EMR, and Apache Iceberg.
* Experience in API automation (REST APIs, Postman, API testing frameworks).
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, and modern Quality Engineering practices.
* Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Strong understanding of functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing.
* Experience with test strategy, risk-based testing, test planning, and quality metrics.
* Experience in defect management, root cause analysis, and release quality validation.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience using AI-assisted testing tools to improve test design, automation development, execution, and maintenance (Claude Code preferred).

**Preferred Skills**

  

* Mastery of specialized data quality tools (e.g., Great Expectations, Informatica DQ).
* Proficiency with cloud platforms and data warehouses (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake).
* Knowledge of global data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and best practices for data governance.
* Experience testing microservices-based and distributed architectures.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools.
* Experience working on enterprise SaaS or publishing/content management platforms.

**Nice to Have**

* ISTQB Certification.
* Data Quality tool certified eg Informatica, Right Data etc
* AWS or Azure Fundamentals Certification.
* Familiarity with A/B testing frameworks and the nuances of experimentation
* Experience with AI-driven Quality Engineering practices.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong ownership mindset with a quality-first approach.
* Strong ownership of data quality and reliability.
* Ability to identify and resolve the root cause of data quality issues.
* Good judgement on when a quality check should block, quarantine, or generate an alert.
* Ability to identify risks early and drive preventive quality practices.
* Quick learner with enthusiasm for adopting emerging technologies and AI-powered engineering solutions.
* Ability to mentor and coach team members while fostering a culture of quality.
* Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders.
* Self-driven, proactive, and capable of working in a fast-paced Agile environment.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

  
**Additional Information**

You must have the right to work and live in India.

**Location:** The successful candidate will be able to utilise our balanced working model. We ask that candidates live within a commutable distance of our Bengaluru office to ensure that as a balanced worker they can make it to our office location to collaborate as required. There is an expectation for a minimum of 3 days per week in-person time.

We believe that great things happen when people connect face-to-face. That's why we work in-person with each other, or with customers and partners, three days a week or more. When you’re not spending time together in one of our offices or other workplaces – like at conference – you get the flexibility and support to work from home or remotely.

**What we offer in return:**

* A competitive salary + bonus
* 24 days annual leave
* 4 volunteering days annually
* Day off for your birthday
* Pension contributions
* Medical insurance for self and dependants; life cover and personal accident cover for self
* Seasonal social and charitable events
* Training and development
* Tools and equipment for remote working

We want all our candidates to shine in our recruitment process. Please let us know if there is anything we can do to ensure you are able to show us your best self. This could include having the application form in a different format, more time for questions, or anything else – please ask us, we are happy to be flexible! Please contact recruitment@tandf.co.uk

**Being Yourself at Taylor & Francis:**

If you’re excited about working with Taylor & Francis to foster human progress through knowledge, we invite you to apply even if your existing skills and experience don’t fit every item listed above. At Taylor & Francis, we are at our best and most successful when colleagues can be themselves and make a contribution regardless of their identity or background. As a colleague, you will have the opportunity to further innovate and develop in areas that you are passionate about. Our goal is to empower you with the resources, incentives, and flexibility you need to enjoy success at work and to live a healthy, balanced life.

Taylor & Francis is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe in and value diversity of people and thought, fostering a supportive and inclusive environment where all colleagues can learn and succeed as their true selves. Taylor & Francis recruits, develops, and retains colleagues without regard to any protected personal characteristics or other non-merit based factor.

*If you have a disability, or face another barrier, and would like to request an adjustment to assist your participation in the hiring process and/or in the advertised position, please contact* recruitment@tandf.co.uk. *Your request will be reviewed and considered in the strictest confidence.*

We genuinely care about our colleagues, promoting work-life balance, wellbeing, and flexible working. We believe that the skills and experience you bring to Taylor & Francis are invaluable. We want you to have the opportunity to develop your abilities, and to innovate and develop in areas which you are passionate about. To find out more about our business and the great career opportunities please go to our Careers Site: http://www.taylorandfrancisgroup.com/careers

Or better yet check out our LinkedIn ‘Life’ Page, highlighting our accomplishments, employees, and company culture. It’s also a good way of meeting our recruitment team, who will be happy to advise you on your journey here at T&F.

description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 5-7 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

* End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.
* Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.
* AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.
* System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.
* Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.
* Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.
* Extensive Travel:The role is based out of Bangalore and requires extensive travel across various states in India, depending on project and business requirements.

**What We Look For**

* Core Experience: (5-7) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).
* Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.
* Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).
* Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.
* Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.
* Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).
* Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: Software Development Engineer - Tejas
description:
Enterprises want agents that can do real work on their own data. That data sits across documents, databases and business systems that were never built for agents to read, and today's agents forget most of what they learn once a session ends.

Our team builds Sarvam's context engine to solve both problems. The knowledge side brings an enterprise's data together so agents can search it, navigate it and cite where an answer came from. The memory side lets agents remember what they learn over time, about individual users, about teams, and across the organisation. We want both to keep improving as they are used.

Knowledge and memory for agents is a rapidly evolving field. We want to build at the frontier of it, and to show with measurable results that our approach does better than traditional ones.

**About Sarvam**
----------------

Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.

**What this role promises you**
-------------------------------

You will join a small team and own large parts of the platform. The work is driven by real customer deployments, so what you build gets used quickly and you see what works and what does not. You will also work closely with the teams building Sarvam's models, document AI and inference, which makes it much easier to solve problems that cut across the stack.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build and run the ingestion pipeline that parses, extracts and indexes large volumes of documents, and keep it reliable when files are messy and external services fail.
* Connect to databases and enterprise systems so agents can work with structured records as well as documents.
* Design how enterprise data is modelled, including the ontology, matching the same entity across sources, and tracing every value back to where it came from.
* Build the retrieval tools agents call, with search, filters and citations, and make them fast and cheap enough for agents to use heavily.
* Build memory for agents at the level of a user, a team and the whole organisation: how it is written, stored, retrieved and kept accurate over time.
* Run evals, find where answers go wrong, and keep iterating until quality improves.
* Work with product and forward-deployed engineers to turn what one customer needs into something the platform does for every customer.
* Write design docs and keep decisions documented.

Our production stack is Go, with Temporal, OpenSearch and Postgres.

**Who you are**
---------------

We are hiring at 3 to 5 years of experience.

* You have built and run backend or data systems in production, and you have fixed them when they broke.
* You are strong in at least one backend language. Our core is in Go, so Go experience is a plus, and you should be happy to work in it every day.
* You have good fundamentals in data modelling and PostgreSQL.
* You have worked on long-running pipelines and know how to make them safe to retry and recover.
* You have worked on search or retrieval and know how to debug why the right result did not come back.
* You use AI coding tools every day and have a good sense of where they help and where they don't.
* You care about measuring quality, and you are comfortable building the evals to do it.

**Bonus points**
----------------

* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution or structured extraction.
* Experience building memory for agents or LLM applications.
* Document processing, such as OCR, layout or table extraction.
* Connectors or change data capture for ERP, CRM or other enterprise systems.
* Building on MCP, or serving LLMs and embedding models in production.
* On-prem or air-gapped deployments.
* Experience at an early- or growth-stage startup.

title: Security Consultant
description:
Location: Bengaluru
