**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1752299

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Security Consultant**

**Job Summary:**

As an Information Security Consultant, the individual will be responsible for providing security guidance to projects and operations teams responsible for delivering, respectively maintaining, IT cloud-based solutions. The Consultant will support the entire system development lifecycle (SDLC) of business IT solutions with information security expertise and guidance. This includes performing a risk assessment of the solution and the underpinning cloud infrastructure in order to derive adequate risk treatment options, driving the security assurance activities with cloud vendors, specifying and prioritizing security requirements, directing the design of security controls, supervising the security attestation activities and effectively articulating all related findings, issues, recommendations to team members and management, assessing the security impact of change requests and providing the operations teams with related recommendations and decisions.

  

The successful candidate should have solid background in web services architecture and design, networking principles supporting hybrid cloud models, experience in applications development processes and methodologies (experience in agile application development and DevOps operations mode is strongly preferred), as well as oversight knowledge of infrastructure and hosting technologies leveraging virtualization and containerization. The successful candidate should have broad consulting or security assurance experience across all Information Security knowledge areas relevant to modern cloud-based architectures.

  

**EY Technology:**

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.

**EY Technology** supports our technology needs through three business units:

**Client Technology (CT) -** focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster, and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.

**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –** EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.

**Information Security (Info Sec) -** Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

  

**The opportunity:**

The Security Consultant reports to Deputy CISO of Enterprise Workplace Technology in a hands-on role, focused on the secure design, architecture and development for applications, which processes sensitive data and constitutes core as well as critical business services. The Security Consultant works directly with Architects, Developers, IAM engineers, Project Managers and other resources; through collaboration and mentoring, they help teams to deliver secure business solutions.

The Security Consultant’s role is a technical position which will support the global strategies and architecture vision as it relates to the development of secure design, build, deployment and operation of business applications and related infrastructure.

  

**Your key responsibilities:**

This position is an individual contributor capable of supporting multiple project teams in the design, implementation and validation of security controls across applications and services (incl. underpinning infrastructure and cloud hosting platform), as well as providing the operations teams with consultancy, reviews and decisions upon deployment of changes to existent operational services. The core responsibilities are as listed in the following.

* Directing and managing solution-specific information security assurance efforts with 3rd parties and vendors, like backend reviews, controls verification and validation, etc., oriented on standards and frameworks like ISO, COBIT, NIST, TSC, etc.
* Risk assessments (threats, vulnerabilities) of cloud services and applications
* Risk assessments of cloud hosting infrastructure underpinning the services and applications
* Security assessment of architecture and networking supporting the services and applications
* Derivation of risk treatment options from risk assessments and effectively facilitating the implementation of the optimal security-usability trade-off in interactions with project teams and management
* Identifying, specifying and prioritizing security requirements in new applications and services deployment, as well as specifying and facilitating security changes in DevOps operations mode of existent applications
* Directing the design of security controls to satisfy the approved security requirements
* Supervising and managing various types of security attestation activities (scans, pentests, audits), including the definition of scope, pass criteria, contribution to test scenarios, articulating and formalizing findings and decisions
* Assessing the security posture impact of change requests and providing the operations teams with related recommendations and decisions
* Effectively communicating the findings, recommendations and decisions from all above activities, by adapting the form and depth of statements adequately to audiences and stakeholders
* Translating technical security terms and concepts into business risk terminology to facilitate making objective and security-aware risk decisions by management
* Providing knowledge sharing and technical assistance to other team members
* Acting as an agile team member according to established agile development best practices and guidelines

  

**Skills and attributes for success:**

The position requires knowledge of various IT system architectures and technologies like cloud, virtualization, containerization, mobile, as well as expertise and experience in security subject matter areas such as IAM, network and perimeter security, web applications security, user account management, privileged access, auditing & logging, and others as outlined in ISO 27001, OWASP, NIST and related guidelines and standards. The consultant filling the position should also have experience in conduction of 3rd party security assessments, in particular within the scope of SOC1, SOC2 reports, and in vendor risk management.

  

A successful candidate should have significant security working experience and knowledge in the design, implementation and operation of security controls in any two or more of the following areas:

* Agile & DevOps Methodologies – Experience as a contributing member of a balanced team within an Agile development or DevOps environment.
* Application Security - Experience with the design of security controls for multi-tier business solutions including the design of application-level access and entitlement management, data tenancy and isolation, encryption, and logging. Working familiarity with REST API and micro services architecture.
* Cloud Security –Technical understanding of virtualization, cloud infrastructure, and public cloud offerings and experience designing security configuration and controls within cloud based solutions in Microsoft Azure and Azure PAAS services
* Infrastructure Security – Experience with the integration of common infrastructure security technologies and solutions into business solution architectures including the integration of identity & access management, intrusion detection and prevention, security monitoring, and data encryption solutions.
* Identity and Access Management - Active Directory based Identity and Access Management and Authorization design experience and integration with IDaaS and Federation technologies.

  

**To qualify for the role you must have:**

* A BSc or MSc degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience, with preference towards advanced degrees.
* Seven or more years of experience in Information Technology disciplines. Five or more years of experience in Information Security subject matter area with demonstrated experience in the following:
* Experience providing and validating security requirements related to applications and information system design and implementation
* Experience providing and validating security requirements related to cloud services and underlying networking and architectures
* Experience conducting risk assessments, vulnerability assessments, vendor and third party risk assessments and recommending risk remediation strategies
* Experience in the use of tools and methods to identify security exposures and business risks
* Knowledge of common information security standards, such as: ISO, NIST, COBIT
* Familiarity with information system attack methods and vulnerabilities and threat modelling
* Working experience with web technologies and programming languages
* Working experience with more than one of these technologies and products - Java, .NET, NodeJS, Angular, Power Apps, Kubernetes

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have:**

* A vendor-neutral security certification of DoD IAT Level II-III or DoD IAM Level II-III is strongly preferred (SSCP, Security+, CEH, CISSP, CISM)
* A vendor-specific cloud security certification would be an additional asset (Microsoft AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty, …)
* Proven experience as a standing member of an agile development team (in any agile role) or as DevOps operations mode contributor would be an additional asset,
* Proven experience with either of the Adobe cloud products would be an additional assets.

  

**What we look for:**

* Ability to team well with others to facilitate and enhance the understanding & compliance to security policies
* Ability to work effectively with customers, management, staff members, vendors, and consultants and articulate findings and recommendations
* Strong English communication and writing skills are required
* Strong judgment and analytical ability
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, organizational, and project management skills
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change

  

**What working at EY offers:**

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**About GSS**

GSS Tech Group is a technology staffing and managed workforce partner to leading banks, fintechs and telecom enterprises across the UAE and the wider region. We place senior engineers into the core technology teams of our clients and support them throughout their engagement.

**About the role**

We are hiring a Senior Technology Engineer to join the Storage & Data Protection engineering team of a leading UAE bank, working from Bangalore within the bank’s CTO Technology Chapter.

This is an engineering role, not an operations role. You will own the product engineering lifecycle for the bank’s storage and data protection platforms: design, build, standardise, automate and plan capacity for a consumable set of infrastructure products used across the bank. You will also play a key part in reducing technology sprawl and lowering total cost of ownership across the storage and backup estate.

You will report into the Technology Chapter and work day to day with the Compute Technology Platform squad, collaborating closely with the Security Chapter and the wider infrastructure teams.

**What you will do**

* Design, implement and standardise enterprise storage services across SAN, NAS, object and deduplication backup storage platforms
* Engineer and operate enterprise data protection platforms such as Veritas NetBackup, Dell Networker and Commvault, including architecture, policy frameworks, retention design, upgrades and lifecycle management
* Build and validate cyber recovery capabilities, including immutable and air gapped backup copies, isolated recovery environments and regular ransomware recovery testing
* Lead migrations and consolidation initiatives that reduce the number of platforms and tools in the estate and lower TCO
* Automate provisioning, configuration and health checks using Infrastructure as Code and scripting
* Own capacity planning, performance tuning and forecasting for storage and backup platforms
* Act as the senior escalation point for complex BAU issues and major incidents, driving root cause analysis and permanent fixes
* Ensure platforms meet the bank’s security, OS compliance and regulatory standards, working with the Security Chapter on design reviews
* Produce clear design documentation (HLD and LLD), runbooks and standards, and communicate transparently with stakeholders across teams

**What you will bring**

*Must have*

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related field
* 10+ years in infrastructure engineering or operations, with at least 3 years in a senior storage or data protection engineering role
* Strong hands on experience with enterprise SAN and NAS platforms (for example Dell PowerMax, PowerStore or Unity, NetApp ONTAP, Pure Storage, Hitachi VSP, PowerScale or Isilon), including provisioning, replication and FC zoning on Brocade or Cisco MDS
* Hands on experience with object storage (for example Dell ECS, NetApp StorageGRID, Cloudian or S3 compatible platforms)
* Hands on experience with deduplication backup storage (for example Dell Data Domain or PowerProtect DD, HPE StoreOnce)
* Deep, design level expertise in at least one of Veritas NetBackup, Dell Networker or Commvault, with working knowledge of another
* Practical experience with cyber recovery: immutability, retention lock, air gapped vaults and ransomware recovery testing
* Strong Linux administration skills, plus solid experience with VMware virtualisation
* Experience in large, complex, high availability enterprise environments, ideally in banking or financial services

*Highly desirable*

* Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, and automation with Ansible, Python or PowerShell, including storage and backup REST APIs
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and integrating infrastructure automation into them
* Data protection for container platforms such as Kubernetes or OpenShift
* Configuring storage, compute and networking services on Microsoft Azure, AWS or OCI, including cloud tiering for backup
* Understanding of DevOps and SRE principles
* Vendor certifications from Dell, NetApp, Veritas, Commvault, Pure or similar

**How you work**

* A self starter who takes ownership from inception to delivery
* Calm and methodical under pressure
* Pragmatic, focused and keen to learn new technologies
* Builds trusted, professional relationships with stakeholders

**Why join**

* Work on the core infrastructure of one of the region’s leading banks
* A genuine engineering remit: design, automation and platform ownership, not ticket handling
* Exposure to modern data protection and cyber recovery practices at enterprise scale

title: Customer Engineer
description:
### **Nexla, briefly**

Nexla is the data connectivity layer for enterprise AI. Over 1,000 bidirectional connectors give agents real-time access to data and actions over MCP. Nexla's Agentic Data Integration handles high-volume streaming ETL, CDC, and Document ETL. At the core of the platform is Helix, a context engine that continuously learns from metadata, schemas, telemetry, and documentation to give agents accurate context and keep pipelines reliable. Nexla processes over a trillion records a month for enterprises including DoorDash, LiveRamp, LinkedIn, and J&J. Honorable Mention in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Data Integration Tools, and top-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights four years running.

**Role, briefly**  
You would be the technical bridge between our customers and our engineering teams. When a customer's pipeline breaks, or our Ops team spots something before the customer does, you take it: dig through logs and connectors, find the actual cause, and see it through to a fix. This is not ticket triage. You own the resolution, including the engineering conversations it takes to get there. Python, SQL, and REST APIs are the tools you reach for daily.

**What you'll own**

* Technical resolution, end to end. Cases raised by customers and issues surfaced by our Ops and L1 team: first investigation, root cause, and the fix, including driving it with the engineering teams who own the code.
* The investigation itself. Logs, connectors, the Nexla environment, and whatever Python or shell you need to write to see what is actually happening. Written fast, often thrown away.
* What you learn, written down. Known and newly found solutions in the knowledge base so the next person does not start from zero, plus the Global Alerts and visibility updates that go to Sales and Customer Success when an issue reaches past one customer.
* The customer's experience of all of it. Clear updates across email, tickets, Slack, and calls, and support through product releases.

**The hard problem**

Most of what lands on you will not be a bug in our code. It will be a third-party API that changed without telling anyone, a file that arrived malformed, an auth token that quietly expired, or a schema that moved. Across more than a thousand external systems, each with its own quirks, the hard part is working out which side of the boundary the problem sits on, and proving it, while the customer is waiting and reasonably assumes it is ours.

**Must-haves**

* 3 to 6 years in data engineering, technical support, or a closely related role.
* Strong Python. You write scripts quickly to debug something or set up an alert, and you are comfortable throwing them away afterwards.
* Solid SQL and hands-on with databases: Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, or SQL Server.
* REST APIs and the authentication around them: OAuth2, SSO, and token-based. You have debugged an auth failure that was not documented anywhere.
* Comfortable on both Linux and Windows, and with data formats including CSV, XML, JSON, and Parquet.
* You use AI tools in your actual work and can say specifically where they help and where they mislead you.

**Bonus points**

* Apache Airflow.
* You have worked a support or on-call rotation before and know what good looks like.
* Data integration, ETL, or iPaaS background.

**You'll thrive here if**

* You can write a clear update to a frustrated customer and a clear one to a busy engineer, and you know those are different jobs.
* You like digging. Logs, traces, and the part where it finally makes sense.
* You do not handle a problem half-understood.
* You work well with people who are under pressure, without adding to it.

*One thing to be clear about: this role runs on a shift rotation with weekend coverage shared across the team. We do not run late-night shifts, but your week will not always be Monday to Friday. If that does not fit your life, this is not the right role, and it is better to know now.*

**The practical stuff**

Bengaluru preferred, and we are open to candidates working remotely elsewhere in India. The role runs on a rotational shift pattern with weekend coverage shared across the team. We do not run late-night shifts. Compensation includes base salary, bonus, and equity, set by depth and experience rather than by title.

**Worth a look before you apply**

* **What we are building now.** MCP Studio and Express, our two newest bets.
* **Who uses us, and why.** nexla.com/customers
* **The product you would be supporting.** docs.nexla.com
* **Our CEO on why we take "Remember to Relax" seriously.** Read the founder story
* **Everything else.** nexla.com · Blog · All open roles

### **Why Nexla? Why now?**

A few large companies - DoorDash, SentinelOne, Johnson & Johnson, LinkedIn, Amex, Integrity Marketing, among them use Nexla for data integration. Connectors, runtime, transformations, scheduling, the parts of the stack where data has to move between systems reliably.

The reason this is an interesting moment to join is what the agent shift is doing to the category. Data integration used to mean "land this data in that warehouse so a human can look at it." That product is mature. What it's becoming is closer to "an agent asks a business question, and the platform figures out which data and what code and which APIs add up to a real answer." That's a much bigger problem, and most of the architecture for it hasn't been built yet by anyone.

A concrete example. A revenue team wants to ask "which enterprise customers are showing renewal risk" and get a real answer through whatever agent or app they work in. Today there is no clean way to answer that question, it requires CRM, usage, support, and billing data joined in org-specific ways, and the calling agent can't just invoke a tool that returns the right answer unless someone first establishes whether the underlying data is even capable of producing one.

That is the system we are building. A probe agent investigates the data plane whether the right fields are populated, whether freshness is adequate, whether the joins exist, whether credentials cover the required scope and returns a grounded feasibility answer. Where there are gaps, Express.dev composes the pipelines to close them. The capability is then exposed as an MCP server: "renewal risk" as a curated product, with the business logic correct and the query semantics described well enough that the calling agent uses it as intended. The MCP Gateway governs which agents can call which capabilities, with the policies, audit, and observability an enterprise control plane requires.

The bet is that ten years of connector work, an enterprise customer base, and a runtime that already moves real volume are the right foundation to define this layer from.

* Activity trail. Record who accessed or changed what. Store these records securely in India, tamper-proof, for at least one year.

* Alerts. Raise alerts for unusual activity, such as viewing unmasked personal data, very large downloads, customer sensitive data downloads, changes to access rights, or access from unknown locations. (Both from BigQuery and Tableau)\_

* Incident playbook. Provide a ready process to meet CERT-In's 6-hour reporting window and DPDP notification duties.

* Data. Dynamic Data Masking based on RBAC , Data Encryption, , Key Rotations , Secure AI access , Incident Report and Regulatory Reporting

* Handover. Deliver documentation, training and runbooks so our team can run the setup independently post completion.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
**DATA PLATFORM ENGINEER**

**We are looking for a Data Platform Engineer to be part of our Nestlé Nespresso Digital and Tech Team. At Nespresso, our Digital & Tech teams are at the heart of our innovation journey, a space where we continue to invest, evolve, and grow.**

**Position Snapshot:**

  

* Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
* Type of Contract: Permanent
* Grade: Band 2
* Type of work: Hybrid
* Work Language: Fluent Business English

**The Role:**

*As a* ***Data Platform Engineer****, you will play a key role in designing, provisioning, and operating Nespresso’s enterprise Data Platform capabilities across Azure and Snowflake. You will enable the data community to deliver trusted, scalable, and reliable data products faster by building reusable platform services, automation frameworks, and operational capabilities. Working closely with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and Data teams, you will ensure platform services are secure, compliant, highly available, and aligned with Nespresso and Nestlé technology standards.*

*You will be responsible for evolving the platform beyond traditional data asset deployment by delivering self-service capabilities, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) patterns, orchestration frameworks, governance controls, and operational excellence practices. This role combines platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, data engineering, and DevOps expertise to create a robust and future-ready data ecosystem.*

**In This Role, You Will:**

  

* Design, build, and continuously improve reusable platform capabilities for data ingestion, orchestration, access management, automation, and governance across Azure and Snowflake.
* Provision and manage cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), ensuring consistency, scalability, security, and operational readiness.
* Maintain and optimize Kubernetes environments supporting Airflow orchestration, including upgrades, capacity management, monitoring, and reliability improvements.
* Develop and manage Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and CI/CD frameworks to enable secure, controlled, and automated platform delivery.
* Build and support Azure Data Factory (ADF) integration and ingestion pipelines using standardized, reusable, and production-ready patterns.
* Implement and enforce RBAC models, security controls, audit requirements, and compliance guardrails across platform services.
* Drive operational excellence through platform monitoring, incident management, root-cause analysis, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Partner with stakeholders across Data, Infrastructure, Security, Enterprise Architecture, and business teams to deliver scalable platform solutions and adoption frameworks.

**What We’re Looking For:**

  

* Proven experience in platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or data platform engineering roles within enterprise environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), including deployment automation and environment management.
* Experience managing Kubernetes environments and workflow orchestration platforms such as Apache Airflow.
* Solid expertise in Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipeline design, Git-based development practices, and release management.
* Experience building and supporting data integration and orchestration solutions using Azure Data Factory (ADF) and related Azure data services.
* Strong understanding of Snowflake platform administration, provisioning, security models, and operational best practices.
* Experience implementing RBAC frameworks, security controls, compliance requirements, and governance standards in cloud environments.
* Proficiency in Python scripting and automation for platform operations, monitoring, and workflow management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and drive sustainable solutions.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global and cross-functional teams.
* Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

**Extra Skills That Set You Apart:**

  

* Experience operating enterprise-scale data platforms serving multiple business domains and data product teams.
* Knowledge of platform observability, reliability engineering practices, and automated operational monitoring frameworks.
* Experience creating reusable platform frameworks, self-service capabilities, developer enablement tools, and adoption standards for data communities.

**We Offer You:**

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.

* Flexible work policies including core hours and options for working from home. Discuss with us during the recruitment process to understand what flexibility could look like for you!
* Genuine opportunities for career and personal development through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
* Modern "smart office" locations providing agile workspaces. Our state-of-the-art campus is equipped with areas to co-create, network, and chill!
* International, dynamic & inclusive working environment with attractive additional benefits.
* The pride to work for a B Corp certified company and one of the world’s most trusted brands.

**The Hiring Process:**

* **Your Application:** Submit your application, and we'll review it carefully (make sure your CV is in English as the hiring team is international).
* **Initial Screening:** Relevant candidates will be contacted by our Talent Acquisition team for an initial interview.
* **Hiring Manager Interview:** Selected candidates will then meet with the hiring manager to discuss the role and their experience in more detail.
* **Stakeholder Interview:** Candidates will engage with potential team members to assess fit and collaboration.
* **Leadership & HRBP Interaction:** Candidates will have a discussion with our leadership team & HRBP.
* **Feedback:** After interviews, we provide feedback to all candidates.
* **Job Offer:** Successful candidates will receive a formal offer.
* **First Working Day:** Once the offer is accepted, we’ll welcome you on your first day!

**About Nespresso:**

The Nespresso story began with a simple but revolutionary idea: enable anyone to create the perfect cup of espresso coffee.

Since 1986, Nespresso has redefined and revolutionized the way millions of people enjoy their coffee.

We are a Company committed with the Climate change and we aim to achieve carbon neutrality as soon as possible and net-zero GHG emissions by 2050 at the latest.

In 2019 we created the digital hub in Barcelona to offer the best customer experience and innovation to B2C and B2B channels.

*We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.*

People are at the heart of our success – all 14,000 of them. We actively cultivate diversity, inclusion and belonging in the workplace. We celebrate individuality, believing that your authenticity and uniqueness can help us to grow and thrive together

Step outside your comfort zone; share your ideas, way of thinking and working to make a difference to the world, every single day. You own a piece of the action – make it count.

**Join Nestlé #beaforceforgood**

* Perform peer code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback to fellow engineers.
* Troubleshoot performance issues and data discrepancies during SIT and UAT, including row-count reconciliation between source Oracle/SQL Server systems and the target warehouse.
* Contribute to technical documentation, runbooks, and handover materials.

* 5+ years of Informatica PowerCenter experience - mappings, sessions, workflows, and parameterization
* 3+ years of hands-on dbt Core experience - model layering, macros, tests, incremental materializations
* 3+ years of Airflow experience - DAG authoring, task dependencies, and incorporation with scheduling tool
* 5+ years of Python experience, including production use of parallelism and batch data processing
* 5+ years of SQL experience - complex joins, window functions, aggregations across large datasets
* Experience with Oracle Data Pump (expdp/impdp) or SQL Server BCP / BULK INSERT for high-volume data movement

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Hello Visionary!**

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.

At Siemens, we are scaling the Siemens Data Mesh to power the next generation of industrial AI, smart infrastructure, and digital excellence. Within Data Domain Operations, trusted, high-performance, and real-time data is the foundation of operational excellence. We are looking for a hands-on Data Engineer who is passionate about data in motion – transforming Kafka event streams provisioned by our central data ingestion platform into governed, consumer-ready data products using platforms such as Flink. This person will champion a "shift left" mentality, embedding quality and automation at the source rather than downstream.

Move the world with your passion for data and impactful, AI-ready technologies. Rethink how we integrate and process data, and steer the organization toward a future where event-driven insights power every decision. Be bold when others would have given up. In short, play a key role in building the real-time data foundation of Siemens!

**We are looking for: Data Engineer**

**You’ll break new ground by:**

* As a Data Engineer within Data Domain Operations, you will design, build, and automate streaming data products that transform Kafka event streams – already provisioned by our central data ingestion platform – into trusted, consumer-grade data assets. Operating at the heart of our real-time architecture, you will implement robust pipelines for data in motion using platforms such as Flink, working closely with our data architects to bridge operational source systems and the analytical platforms that depend on them.
* Build Streaming Data Products: Design, build, and operate real-time and near-real-time data products sourced from Kafka event streams, using stream-processing engines such as Flink.
* Engineer Event-Driven Pipelines: Develop and automate robust, resilient pipelines for data in motion, covering transformation, enrichment, and delivery of streaming events into our operational and analytical platforms.
* Champion Shift-Left Data Engineering: Embed data quality checks, schema validation, testing, and monitoring directly into the pipeline development lifecycle, catching issues at the source rather than downstream.
* Treat Data as a Product: Design streaming data products with clear data contracts, documentation, and SLAs, in line with data-as-a-product principles across the Siemens Data Mesh.
* Bridge Operational & Analytical Systems: Collaborate with domain architects and analytics engineers to connect Kafka-based event streams with downstream warehouses (such as Snowflake) and reporting layers, supporting real-time operational decision-making. Automate & Operate with DataOps Rigor: Apply CI/CD, automated testing, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code practices to streaming pipelines, ensuring reliable, repeatable deployments.
* Monitor & Resolve Proactively: Monitor streaming pipeline health, identify and resolve data issues proactively, and contribute to the domain’s data governance and quality framework.
* Collaborate & Mentor: Work with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions, and share streaming and event-driven engineering best practices with peers across the domain.

**You’re excited to build on your existing expertise, including:**

* Education: University degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical field.
* Professional Experience: 3+ years of experience as a data engineer, with a strong focus on data integration, ETL/ELT, and building production data pipelines.
* Streaming & Event-Driven Processing: Hands-on experience with Kafka (or Confluent Cloud) and stream-processing engines such as Flink or Camel, building event-driven data products that operate on data in motion.
* Stream Processing & Schema Management: Experience with stateful stream-processing concepts (windowing, joins, exactly-once semantics) and schema registries (e.g., Confluent Schema Registry) for managing evolving event schemas.
* Cloud & Warehouse Exposure: Hands-on experience with cloud-based data platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and modern cloud warehouses such as Snowflake.
* Programming & Engineering: Proficiency in Python and expert-level SQL skills, basic working knowledge of Java, along with data engineering best practices such as data versioning, automated testing, and CI/CD for data pipelines.
* DataOps Mindset: Familiarity with shift-left data quality practices, monitoring, and observability for streaming pipelines.
* Ways of Working: Experience with agile software development methodologies, and excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with a proven ability to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions.
* Languages: Fluency in English (verbal and written); knowledge of German, Portuguese, or other languages is a plus.

**Create a better #TomorrowWithUs!**

This role is based out in Pune or Bangalore and gives you the chance to work with international teams that shape the future of Siemens’ Operations and Data Analytics landscape.

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.

**Find out more about Siemens careers at:** **www.siemens.com/careers**

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.  
  
If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!

**Job Description**

**Role:** Senior Data Engineer - RGM Data Analyst

**Experience Level:** 3 to 7 Years

**Work location:** Bangalore, Mumbai & Trivandrum

Notice Period: 0-15 days (Looking for immediate joiners/ Serving Notic

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a data-driven, **Revenue Growth Management** function focused **Data Analyst** to optimize our Trade Promotion Optimization (TPO) product and enhance trade investment decision-making. In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical data pipelines and commercial execution, working directly with backend data pipelines, algorithmic model outputs, and front-end TPO interfaces.

Your primary mandate will be to proactively monitor and audit data inputs and system-generated recommendations, identifying anomalies, bias, data drift, data integrity issues and counter-intuitive promotional plans before recommendations reach client’s RGM and Customer Account teams. You will collaborate closely with internal technical teams , and client RGM leads, using advanced analytical skills to translate algorithmic outputs into compelling, actionable commercial stories that drive profitable revenue growth through the retailer sell-in journey.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Pre-emptive Model Diagnostics:** Routinely audit backend data pipelines and optimization engine outputs to identify ingestion errors, pricing mismatches, and data drift before recommendations are published to end-users
* **Recommendation Sanity Checks:** Stress-test TPO engine outputs (optimal frequency, discount depth, promotional mechanics) against commercial reality—identifying flawed recommendations stemming from contaminated baseline volumes, incorrect trade rates, or skewed price elasticities.
* **Root-Cause Analysis:** Partner with data engineering, Data Science and Optimization teams to diagnose and isolate issues across Data & DS pipelines and frontend reports
* Map TPO recommendations against real-world retailer trade architectures, customer calendars, and execution constraints to ensure feasibility during the retailer sell-in journey.
* Run scenario modeling and pre-/post-event evaluations to evaluate promotional ROI, cannibalization, halo effects, and trade spend efficiency across key accounts.
* Ensure data integrity by validating whether actual realized promotional plans and key metrics match with what is flowing into data and model pipelines
* Collaborate with data engineering, data science, optimization and UI/UX teams to continuously refine data feeds, system logic, and model tuning.
* Drive adoption of the tool by creating RGM focused content based on findings and data-driven insights

**Technical Skills:**

* SQL, Python and Excel for data analysis.
* Familiarity and comfort with using cloud based data and application environment like Azure and Databricks

**Domain and Functional Skills:**

* CPG industry experience and familiarity with commercial analytics, Price, Pack & Promotion planning and measurement
* Data-driven story telling and RGM functional acumen
* Familiarity with RGM workflows and KPI frameworks
* Strong understanding of **RGM levers**: Pricing, Price-Pack Architecture (PPA), Mix Management, Trade Terms, and Promotion Strategy.
* Familiarity and experience with POS, Shipment and CPG P&L data
* **Self-Directed Problem Solver:** Ability to operate effectively within ambiguous client environments and formulate solutions with minimal hand-holding.

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us**!*

About Role
  
The Associate Director - Software Engineering is a technical leader responsible for the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of software and data engineering solutions, with a solid foundation in software and data engineering concepts and a proven track record of leading engineering teams. This role combines deep hands-on technical expertise with people leadership to set direction, grow talent, and deliver scalable, high-quality systems.

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of software and data engineers, drawing on prior experience leading an engineering team; build a culture of ownership, craftsmanship, and continuous learning.

Champion the use of AI in day-to-day engineering work coding assistants, automated testing, intelligent monitoring, and AI-assisted decision-making to improve team velocity, code quality, and operational efficiency.
  

* Delivery Ownership:

Partner with product and program stakeholders to plan, estimate, and deliver engineering initiatives on time and to a high quality bar.
  

* Engineering Standards:

Establish and enforce engineering best practices code review, CI/CD, testing, observability, and security across the team.
  

* Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Work closely with product managers, architects, and other engineering leads to align technical solutions with business priorities.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* 10+ years of software experience, including 2+ years leading an engineering team
* Hands on experience in fullstack cloud application development.
* Solid grounding in software engineering concepts (data structures, algorithms, design patterns, distributed systems) and data engineering concepts (ETL/ELT, pipelines, data modelling, warehousing)

* Experience with cloud-native architectures and DevSecOps practices
* Exposure to MLOps or building AI/ML-powered product features
* Experience in regulated environments (GxP, SOX, CSV/CSA)

Technical Leadership • Software & Data Engineering Depth • Team Building & Mentorship • Forward-Thinking Strategy • AI-Driven Efficiency • Delivery Ownership • Stakeholder Collaboration • Continuous Improvement

title: Software Verification & Testing Lead
description:
Kochi, Bangalore

Full Time

5+ Years

We are seeking an experienced Software Verification & Testing Lead to lead software verification, validation, and quality assurance activities for medical device and connected healthcare applications.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in software testing methodologies, test automation, requirement traceability, defect management, and regulatory compliance. The role involves ensuring the reliability, safety, security, and performance of embedded software, mobile applications, cloud platforms, and integrated medical device systems.

‍

### **Key Competencies**

* Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).

* Hands-on experience in manual and automated software testing.

* Experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Appium, Playwright, or equivalent frameworks.

* Proficiency in Python or another scripting language for test automation.

* Strong experience in API testing using Postman, REST Assured, or similar tools.

* Experience in integration testing, system testing, regression testing, and defect management.

* Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or TestRail.

* Knowledge of Linux environments, networking fundamentals, and database testing.

* Experience preparing test plans, test cases, test execution reports, and requirement traceability matrices.

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and team management skills.

‍

### **Key Responsibilities**

Software Verification & Validation

* Lead end-to-end software verification and validation activities across the software development lifecycle.

* Develop and execute test strategies, test plans, test cases, and verification protocols based on software requirements.

* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and performance testing.

* Ensure complete requirement-to-test traceability and maintain verification documentation.

* Review software requirements and design specifications to ensure testability and compliance.

* Identify, document, track, and resolve software defects in collaboration with development teams.

Test Automation & Technical Testing

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks to improve test coverage and efficiency.

* Perform API testing, database validation, and end-to-end application testing.

* Validate data communication and integration between wearable devices, mobile applications, backend services, and cloud platforms.

* Test real-time data acquisition, transmission, processing, and visualization.

* Perform reliability testing, including connectivity interruptions, data loss, recovery, and error-handling scenarios.

* Integrate automated tests with CI/CD pipelines where applicable.

Medical Device Quality & Compliance

* Support software verification and validation activities in accordance with applicable medical device standards.

* Maintain verification evidence, test reports, defect records, and traceability matrices.

* Participate in risk-based testing and verification of safety-critical software functions.

* Support design reviews, quality audits, and regulatory documentation.

* Collaborate with quality assurance and regulatory teams to ensure compliance with applicable requirements.

Team Leadership & Coordination

* Lead and mentor software verification and testing engineers.

* Assign testing activities, monitor progress, and ensure timely completion of verification milestones.

* Coordinate with software developers, embedded engineers, system architects, and product teams.

* Review test deliverables and communicate testing status, risks, and quality metrics to stakeholders.

* Drive continuous improvements in testing processes, automation, and software quality.

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.  
  
Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

**About the position:**  
  
Chevron ENGINE has an exciting opportunity for a Digital Engineer - Eastern Hemisphere deployment to join the Facilities Engineering & Projects. This role will be based in Chevron’s office in Bengaluru.

The Digital Twin Deployment Engineer role is part of the Facilities Engineering Digital Solutions organization and supports the successful deployment, adoption, and operational integration of Digital Twin capabilities across Eastern Hemisphere assets, projects, and Businesses. This role focuses on coordinating site readiness, technical onboarding, workflow alignment, user enablement, data and system integration readiness, issue resolution, user training, user communications, and post-go-live stabilization required to make Digital Twin practical, reliable, and valuable in daily engineering, operations, maintenance, projects, and turnaround workflows. The position partners with Digital Twin product teams, deployment leads, Business stakeholders, site champions, ENGINE, IT, vendors, data owners, change management resources, and technical subject matter experts to ensure each deployment is planned, executed, and sustained with clear scope, accountable owners, measurable adoption, and visible business value. The role also captures lessons learned, deployment risks, user feedback, and repeatable implementation patterns to improve deployment consistency and scale Digital Twin adoption across the Eastern Hemisphere portfolio.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

  

* Leads and supports Digital Twin deployment activities for Eastern Hemisphere assets, projects, and business units, including deployment planning, site readiness, onboarding, go-live coordination, user training, user communications, stabilization, and ongoing sustainment.
* Works with product teams, business stakeholders, site champions, ENGINE, IT, vendors, data owners, and subject matter experts to align Digital Twin capabilities with priority workflows in engineering, operations, maintenance, projects, turnaround planning, and asset performance management.
* Assesses deployment readiness by confirming business use cases, user groups, workflow requirements, data availability, system access, integration dependencies, support models, training needs, and adoption risks.
* Coordinates technical and functional onboarding activities, including user access, environment setup, training, end user communications, workflow demonstrations, site-specific configuration inputs, issue triage, testing support, and readiness reviews.

* Provides hands-on deployment support during go-live and hypercare periods, helping users resolve issues, understand workflows, escalate technical problems, and sustain confidence in Digital Twin capabilities.
* Captures user feedback, lessons learned, reusable deployment playbooks, standard readiness checklists, issue-resolution patterns, and implementation practices to improve repeatability across Eastern Hemisphere deployments.
* Maintains strong alignment with global Digital Twin standards, product roadmaps, cybersecurity expectations, data governance requirements, operational excellence practices, and local business priorities.

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience supporting digital solution deployment in complex industrial environments.
* Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, audience-appropriate messages for leaders, site teams, technical users, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience deploying enterprise digital tools, engineering systems, operational technology solutions, data platforms, or workflow-based applications across multiple business units, assets, or locations.
* Demonstrated ability to translate technical capabilities into site-ready deployment plans, workflow requirements, user onboarding actions, readiness checklists, risk registers, and practical adoption support for technical and operational users.

**Preferred qualification**

  

* 10+ yrs of experience supporting digital solution deployment in oil and gas, facilities engineering, manufacturing, operations, maintenance, capital projects, turnaround planning, or other asset-intensive industrial environments.
* Working knowledge of Digital Twin concepts, engineering data, 3D/asset visualization, operational workflows, systems integration, product deployment, user adoption, and value realization.
* Experience using collaboration, tracking, and reporting tools such as SharePoint, Teams, Azure DevOps, product backlogs, dashboards, issue logs, deployment trackers, and readiness checklists.
* Experience working across global teams, vendors, IT organizations, engineering groups, operations stakeholders, and site representatives across multiple time zones, especially within Eastern Hemisphere operating environments.

**What we can offer you**

Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.

Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.

* Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.
* Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
* Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.
* Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well-being, and work-life balance.
* Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, supporting business requirements across the world. Accordingly, the work hours for employees will be aligned to support business requirements. The standard work week will be Monday to Friday. Working hours are 8:00am to 5:00pm or 1.30pm to 10.30pm.

title: Senior Databricks Engineer
description:
Senior Databricks Engineer

Exp-9-15 years

Work location- Bangalore

  

We are looking for a Senior Databricks Engineer to become a cornerstone of our Data & Analytics team. In this role, you will own the design and delivery of our Databricks-first data platform - building high-performance data pipelines, architecting scalable Lakehouse solutions, and championing engineering best practices across the team. You will work closely with business analysts, a data modeler and business stakeholders to turn raw data into reliable, production-grade analytics products.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Lakehouse Architecture: Design and implement scalable Lakehouse architectures using Databricks, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog as the primary platform.
* Delta Live Tables: Build and manage DLT pipelines for declarative, reliable, and maintainable data transformation workflows.
* Unity Catalog: Govern data assets - tables, volumes, and models - through Unity Catalog, enforcing fine-grained access control and lineage tracking.
* Performance Optimization: Tune Spark jobs and Delta tables using Z-ordering, liquid clustering, auto-optimize, and partition strategies to maximize query performance.
* Databricks Workflows: Orchestrate multi-task pipelines using Databricks Workflows, including job scheduling, dependency management, and alerting.
* ELT/ETL Pipelines: Design, develop, and maintain robust ELT/ETL pipelines ingesting data from APIs, databases, streaming sources, and flat files into the Lakehouse.
* Azure Integration: Integrate Databricks with Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Azure Synapse, Event Hubs, and other Azure-native services.
* Streaming: Build real-time data processing pipelines using Structured Streaming and Delta Live Tables for low-latency analytics use cases.
* Code
* Write clean,
* and
* coding standards.
* CI/CD: Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps for automated testing, deployment, and release of Databricks notebooks and jobs.
* Infrastructure as Code: Provision and manage Databricks workspaces, clusters, and supporting Azure infrastructure using Terraform or Bicep.
* Databricks Asset Bundles: Package and deploy Databricks projects using DABs for reproducible, environment-consistent deployments.
* Data Quality Frameworks: Implement automated data validation, expectation checks, and quality monitoring using Great Expectations or DLT expectations.
* Data Lineage: Maintain end-to-end data lineage visibility through Unity Catalog and Microsoft Purview integration.
* Documentation: Produce and maintain thorough technical documentation for pipelines, data models, runbooks, and architectural decisions.
* Mentorship: Coach and mentor junior and mid-level engineers, conducting code reviews and sharing best practices.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Translate business requirements into robust technical solutions; communicate trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Standards & Governance: Contribute to and enforce team engineering standards, SDLC processes, and platform governance policies.

#### **Requirements**

* 10+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering roles.
* Deep expertise in Databricks - Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Workflows, Clusters.
* Advanced PySpark and Python skills for large-scale distributed data processing.
* Strong SQL skills: query authoring, performance tuning, and data modeling.
* Experience with Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Azure Synapse Analytics.
* Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or Bicep).
* Strong understanding of Data Warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and Data Lakehouse patterns (Medallion architecture).
* Experience with Structured Streaming or other real-time data processing frameworks.
* Experience with Microsoft Purview for data cataloguing and governance.
* Familiarity with dbt (data build tool) for SQL-based transformation workflows.

title: IT Leader
description:
**About Glean:**

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry's most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean's agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry's broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World's Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC's Disruptor 50, Bloomberg's AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner's Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we're helping the world's largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you're excited to shape how the world works, you'll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

**About the Role:**

Glean is looking for a hands-on IT Leader to join our Bangalore IT Support organisation as a technical leader, people manager, and driver of AI-powered IT operations.

In this role, you will lead a team of full-time IT engineers and contractors and take ownership of our identity, endpoint, SaaS, and infrastructure ecosystem, including platforms such as Okta, Google Workspace, and Kandji. You will stay close to the technology, resolve high-stakes escalations, guide architecture decisions, and champion automation, while building a high-performing, AI-fluent team that delivers a secure, reliable, and exceptional employee experience.

You will partner closely with Security, HR, Finance, Engineering, and external vendors to architect and maintain IT services that are both secure and scalable. You will also bring a strong AI-first mindset, using AI and automation to transform how IT work gets done across the employee lifecycle.

**You will:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of IT engineers (L1-L3), including full-time employees and contractors, setting clear goals, priorities, and expectations.
* Manage contractor and vendor relationships end to end, including staffing, performance, SLAs, onboarding, renewals, and cost, and ensure consistent quality across the extended team.
* Balance workload and priorities with the other IT Leader in Bangalore, ensuring strong coverage, clear ownership, and operational continuity across IT Support.
* Remain hands-on technically and act as a senior escalation point for complex issues across identity, infrastructure, endpoints, networking, and SaaS applications.
* Own the roadmap, administration, and optimization of Okta, Google Workspace, Kandji, and related identity and endpoint-management platforms.
* Drive AI and automation initiatives across IT: identify high-value workflows, then design, build, and deploy solutions that reduce manual effort and improve employee experience.
* Apply AI to IT workflows such as ticket triage and deflection, knowledge-base creation, onboarding and offboarding, access requests, provisioning, compliance checks, and reporting.
* Lead and deliver IT projects and cross-functional programs from planning through execution, including scoping, timelines, stakeholder alignment, risk management, and outcome tracking.
* Design and implement automation for provisioning, access management, compliance, reporting, and asset lifecycle workflows using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent technologies.
* Lead root-cause analysis for major incidents and drive long-term corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor system health, endpoint compliance, patch status, alerts, and operational risks, and take proactive action.
* Lead proof-of-concept projects to evaluate new IT, security, endpoint, AI, and automation solutions.
* Partner with Security, HR, Finance, and Engineering on identity governance, employee lifecycle management, asset management, and operational workflows.
* Own ITIL-aligned Incident, Problem, Change, and Asset Management processes and continuously improve them.
* Ensure accurate SOPs, technical runbooks, knowledge-base articles, system documentation, and process workflows.
* Support ISO 27001, SOC 2, internal audit, policy implementation, and compliance-readiness activities.
* Define and track operational metrics (SLAs, CSAT, ticket trends, automation impact), and communicate risks, trends, and improvement outcomes to senior management.
* Identify opportunities to improve reliability, security, efficiency, and employee experience across IT services.

**About you:**

* 14+ years of experience in IT engineering, systems administration, IT operations, endpoint management, or a related field, including 3+ years leading IT teams.
* Strong technical foundation with a track record of staying hands-on while leading others; you are comfortable going deep when it matters.
* Proven experience managing people and contractors, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and building team culture across employees and an extended workforce.
* Experience managing vendors, MSPs, or staff-augmentation partners, including SLAs, performance reviews, and commercial discussions.
* Demonstrated AI fluency: you have worked on AI-related projects and have used AI to automate or improve IT workflows (for example, AI-assisted support, agents, workflow automation, or LLM-powered tooling).
* Strong hands-on experience administering Okta, including SSO, MFA, lifecycle automation, application integrations, and access policies.
* Strong experience administering Google Workspace, including user lifecycle management, groups, access controls, and security settings.
* Hands-on experience with Kandji, Jamf, Intune, or a similar MDM platform.
* Advanced troubleshooting experience across macOS, Windows, and Linux.
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, routing, and firewalls.
* Experience with automation and scripting using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar tools.
* Experience with ITSM platforms such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or Freshservice.
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Asset Management.
* Familiarity with endpoint security, identity governance, access control, patch compliance, and security operations.
* Experience supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2, internal audits, or similar compliance programs.
* Strong documentation, communication, prioritization, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work with global teams.
* Ability to make sound decisions under pressure and take ownership from investigation through resolution.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred but not required.

**Location:**

* This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Bangalore office)

**Compensation & Benefits:**

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We're committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

#LI-HYBRID

**AI-First Mindset at Glean:**

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. **As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.** Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

**Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:**

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our **Privacy Policy**. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our **Applicant Arbitration Agreement**.

By clicking "Submit Application," I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the **Applicant Arbitration Agreement**, and I agree to the terms.

title: Director, Software Engineering | Enterprise AI Platforms, Infrastructure & Automation
description:
Meet the Team
  
In Cisco Enterprise AI Platforms& Infrastructure (EAIPI), our vision is to architect, build, and scale world-class agentic AI platforms, foundation infrastructure, and developer ecosystems that power Cisco's next generation of intelligent products and services. We are the engineering organization behind Cisco's flagship AI initiatives, including MyAgent (Cisco's super agent) and the Circuit Enterprise AI platform.
  
Our high-velocity team operates at the intersection of frontier generative AI, distributed systems, GPU infrastructure, and modern software engineering. We build with a steadfast focus on engineering craftsmanship, high talent density, principled quality, and developer enablement—empowering thousands of engineers across Cisco to create, validate, and scale multimodal agentic experiences.
  
  
Your Impact
  
As the Director of AI Support& Automation, you will build and lead our Bangalore-based engineering pod as an elite 'player-coach' calibrated two levels below the VP. Combining direct architectural leadership with deep, hands-on systems development across MyAgent and Circuit, you will set the benchmark for AI platform reliability and quality.
  
You will enable the engineering organization to improve and optimize engineering processes and infrastructure, directing software systems development, application engineering, and software quality assurance for cloud-based and agentic AI platforms. Your directive spans across 5 core pillars:
  

* Pillar 1: Tier 3 Engineering& Escalated Platform Support: Act as the ultimate engineering escalation authority for MyAgent and Circuit. Lead hands-on debugging, root-cause forensic analysis, and kernel/runtime patch development for complex production failures, memory leaks, context bleed, and tool execution anomalies. Bridge the gap between SRE/L2 operational support and core platform architecture with zero-regression hotfix.
* Pillar 2: Premier AI Agent Test Harness& Evaluation: Architect and build an end-to-end, agent-driven test automation harness. Implement automated LLM-as-a-judge scoring frameworks, multi-agent simulation loops, deterministic task verification, and golden dataset benchmarking. Maintain uncompromising quality gates with >99% test pass rates across complex functional, regression, experimental, and safety workflows.
* Pillar 3: AI Software& GPU Performance Validation: Lead performance profiling, stress testing, and concurrency load and latency validation across dedicated on-premise GPU clusters and cloud runtimes. Optimize latency, token throughput, context cache utilization, and resource efficiency.
* Pillar 4: Modular SDK& API Developer Platform: Deliver modular, embeddable SDKs, React components, and headless APIs that empower thousands of Cisco software engineers to control, customize, and extend multimodal agentic experiences.
* Pillar 5: High-Talent-Density Team Leadership: Recruit, mentor, and lead a small, high-density pod (6–10 elite systems, AI, and test automation engineers) in Bangalore. Lead by example through daily code reviews, technical design RFCs, pair programming, and rigorous engineering craftsmanship.
* Technical Architecture& Testing Methodology:
* Deterministic Harness Layer: Unit and integration verification of MCP protocol compliance, tool schema validation, state machines, token exchange (RFC 8693), and memory storage persistence.
* LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation Framework: Automated scoring pipelines using calibrated frontier and on-premise judge models to evaluate grounding, factual accuracy, safety guardrails, hallucination rates, and task completion against versioned golden sets.
* Multi-Agent Simulation& Adversarial Red-Teaming: Automated agent swarms generating synthetic edge cases, malicious prompt injections, tool misuse attempts, and context overflow scenarios to proactively identify failure modes.
* Continuous Canary& Regression Pipeline: Automated staging deployment validation with automated rollback mechanisms, real-time latency tracing (OpenTelemetry), and semantic drift monitoring.

Minimum Qualifications
  

* Education: Bachelor's degree (B.Tech / B.E. / B.S.) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative STEM discipline from an accredited institution.
* Professional Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including 3+ years leading high-performing technical engineering teams and 2+ years of hands-on production experience with LLMs, agentic workflows, or AI platforms.
* Hands-on Coding Proficiency: Expert-level fluency in Python and modern TypeScript/JavaScript; strong working proficiency in Go, C++, or Rust for systems-level performance tuning.
* AI& Systems Architecture: Deep practical experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, LlamaIndex, vLLM, Triton Inference Server, PyTorch, and vector databases.
* Modern Test& Performance Engineering: Demonstrated track record of designing large-scale distributed test harnesses, performance testing tools (k6, Locust, JMeter), browser automation (Playwright), and AI evaluation frameworks (Ragas, DeepEval, Promptfoo, Eval Studio).

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Advanced Credentials: Master's degree (M.Tech / M.S.) or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Distributed Systems, Machine Learning, or Software Engineering from a premier tier-1 engineering institution or top global research universities).
* GPU& Infrastructure Acumen: Solid understanding of GPU compute infrastructure, CUDA memory management, high-density server configurations, and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Academic, Research, or Open Source Contributions: Demonstrated academic depth or research contributions in distributed systems, compiler optimization, GPU parallel computing (CUDA/Triton), formal software verification, major contributions to tier-1 open-source AI frameworks/benchmarks, or recognized technical patents in AI/systems engineering.
* Player-Coach Leadership Archetype: Proven ability to lead from the front, write production code, conduct deep architectural reviews, and inspire an elite engineering culture without relying on bureaucratic middle management.
* Enterprise Executive Communication: Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence, interact, and present technical architectures effectively across engineering, product, and executive leadership.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. The Pod Lead Engineer is a hands‑on software engineering specialist who leads a small, outcome‑focused delivery pod of 4–5 Pod Engineers. The role combines deep technical contribution with day‑to‑day pod leadership, enabling faster delivery through AI‑assisted / AI‑orchestrated SDLC practices.
  
Unlike a traditional team lead role, the Pod Lead Engineer operates in an AI‑native delivery model where AI tools and agents are used across the SDLC to accelerate requirements, design, code generation, testing, documentation, and release readiness. The Pod Lead Engineer contribute to technical direction, delivery execution, and engineering quality, while maintaining high standards of security, compliance, and operational excellence.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

**1) Hands‑On Delivery Leadership (Core)**  

* Lead a 4–5 engineer pod by building software alongside the team, taking ownership of design, coding, reviews, and integration while breaking work into small, deliverable increments using modern engineering practices (CI/CD, automation, code quality gates).
* Drive frequent delivery of working software by ensuring clear definitions of done, measurable progress, and strong accountability for end‑to‑end delivery outcomes.

**4)Pod Management (Small Team Leadership)**  

* Provide day‑to‑day leadership for a 4–5 engineer pod, including task allocation, pairing strategy, prioritization, and removing blockers.
* Coach engineers in AI‑native ways of working (prompting, evaluation, safe AI use) while driving continuous improvement through retrospectives, root cause analysis, and measurable cycle‑time and quality gains.
