title: Lead Solutions Architecture Engineer
description:
Overview:

**Atlassian Architect**

Job Description

**Department:**

Business Technology – Atlassian Products

**Reports To:**

Manager, Atlassian Products

**Location:**

India – Bangalore (On-site)

**Level:**

Individual Contributor – Senior/Principal

**About HealthEdge**
====================

HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Business Technology team powers the tools and platforms that keep HealthEdge running at scale. Atlassian – Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence – is the connective tissue of how work gets planned, tracked, and executed across the entire organization.

**Role Overview**
=================

The Atlassian Architect is the highest-level individual contributor on the Atlassian Products team, responsible for defining platform architecture, setting technical standards, and solving the most complex problems in HealthEdge's Atlassian environment. This is not an administration role – it is a design and engineering role. You will own the decisions that shape how the platform is built, governed, and extended, and your work will directly influence how thousands of employees across the company plan, collaborate, and deliver. As HealthEdge moves fully to Atlassian Cloud Enterprise, the Architect will also shape the platform's AI readiness — ensuring the architecture supports Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo at enterprise scale.

You will serve as the technical authority for the Atlassian Products team – providing architectural guidance, mentoring Senior and regular Administrators, leading complex solution delivery, and acting as the primary point of escalation for problems that require deep platform expertise. You will also own strategic initiatives including instance governance, automation frameworks, API integrations, and migration or consolidation efforts.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Platform Architecture & Standards**
-------------------------------------

* Own the Atlassian platform architecture across Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and Atlassian Access – defining how these tools are structured, governed, and extended at scale
* Establish and maintain technical standards for project design, workflow architecture, permission models, field configuration, and Confluence space taxonomy across the organization
* Design scalable, maintainable solutions that balance user needs with platform health – avoiding configuration sprawl and technical debt
* Evaluate new Atlassian capabilities, product roadmap changes, and Marketplace apps – assessing fit, risk, and adoption strategy
* Produce and maintain architectural documentation including design decisions, standards references, and solution blueprints

**Complex Solution Design & Delivery**
--------------------------------------

* Lead discovery and solution design for the most complex stakeholder requests – those that require cross-project thinking, advanced automation, or architectural changes
* Translate ambiguous business requirements from engineering, IT, product, and business functions into well-structured, scalable Atlassian solutions
* Deliver end-to-end implementation of high-complexity configurations, including multi-project workflow frameworks, advanced JSM service architectures, and cross-tool integrations
* Partner with the Manager, Atlassian Products to define and manage the platform improvement roadmap, sequencing initiatives by impact and feasibility

**Automation & Scripting**
--------------------------

* Design and implement advanced automation frameworks using native Jira/JSM automation and ScriptRunner (Groovy) for complex workflow logic, validators, post-functions, and listeners
* Build and maintain REST API integrations between Atlassian tools and external systems including identity platforms, ITSM tools, and business applications
* Establish automation standards and reusable patterns that the broader admin team can follow and extend
* Review and quality-assure automation and scripting work produced by Senior Administrators, providing technical guidance and improvement feedback

**Migrations & Consolidations**
-------------------------------

* Lead or architect Atlassian migration and consolidation projects, including instance-to-instance migrations, Server/Data Center to Cloud transitions, and post-merger platform integrations
* Perform pre-migration assessments including configuration audits, data mapping, and risk analysis
* Design migration runbooks and execute or oversee technical migration steps with appropriate rollback planning
* Ensure data integrity, permission continuity, and minimal disruption to end users throughout migration events

**Enterprise Governance & Security**
------------------------------------

* Own Atlassian Access configuration including SSO, SCIM provisioning, authentication policies, IP allowlisting, and audit log management
* Design and enforce the organization-wide governance model for Atlassian – covering project creation standards, permission scheme governance, license management, and app approval processes
* Lead license optimization efforts, identifying consolidation opportunities and ensuring spend is aligned with actual usage
* Support security and compliance requirements including access reviews, data residency considerations, and audit evidence related to Atlassian platforms
* Serve as the technical lead for any Atlassian-related security incidents, misconfigurations, or compliance findings

**Team Mentorship & Technical Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Serve as the informal technical lead for the Atlassian Products team – the person Senior and regular Administrators bring their hardest problems to
* Mentor Senior Administrators on advanced configuration, automation, and solution design, actively developing their technical depth
* Conduct technical design reviews for significant platform changes proposed by team members
* Contribute to hiring by participating in technical assessments for Atlassian Administrator and Senior Administrator candidates
* Represent the Atlassian Products team in cross-functional technical forums and architecture discussions

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 7+ years of deep, hands-on Atlassian platform experience with expert-level proficiency in Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Atlassian architectures for large, complex organizations (thousands of users, dozens of teams)
* Expert-level proficiency in ScriptRunner (Groovy) scripting for advanced workflow customization, automation, and platform extensions
* Strong REST API experience with Atlassian platforms — building integrations, automating administrative tasks, and extending platform capabilities
* Proven experience leading Atlassian migrations or consolidation projects, including Cloud migrations
* Deep understanding of Atlassian Cloud security and governance including Atlassian Access, SSO/SCIM, and enterprise-scale permission management
* Ability to communicate architectural decisions clearly to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

**Preferred**
-------------

* Atlassian certifications strongly preferred – ACP-120, ACP-420, ACP-620, or Atlassian Certified Expert (ACE) designation
* Familiarity with how Atlassian platform architecture affects AI indexing quality and Rovo answer relevance
* Experience with advanced Marketplace apps at architectural scale (Insight/Assets, Advanced Roadmaps, ScriptRunner, Elements Connect, Tempo)
* Exposure to enterprise ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and applying them within JSM at an architectural level
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and DevOps tooling that integrates with Atlassian (AWS, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines)
* Experience in a healthcare, SaaS, or other regulated industry environment
* Background in post-merger IT platform integration or multi-instance Atlassian consolidation

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within 90 days, you have completed a thorough assessment of the current Atlassian environment, identified the top architectural gaps and technical debt priorities, and established yourself as the go-to technical authority on the team. Within six months, you have delivered at least one significant platform improvement, established or formalized key governance standards, and are actively mentoring the admin team. Within a year, the Atlassian platform at HealthEdge reflects clear architectural ownership — well-governed, well-documented, and built to scale — and you have meaningfully elevated the technical capability of everyone around you.

**About the Team**
==================

You'll join a dedicated Atlassian Products team that is central to how HealthEdge operates at scale. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for someone who wants to be the definitive technical expert on a platform that touches every part of the business. You'll have the backing of an engaged manager, a growing team of administrators to mentor, and a real mandate to shape how the platform evolves. If you want to do the most technically interesting Atlassian work of your career, this is that role.

ThoughtSpot, Google Cloud Platform, Governance

### **Your Task**

We are seeking a **Senior AI Multi Agent Developer** for the MINDR Intelligence Stream project. The Intelligence Stream serves as the Decide and Act layer of MINDR. As a Senior AI Developer, you will not be designing isolated models or building data pipelines. Instead, you will own the agentic reasoning core, designing and implementing a production-grade Multi-Agent Runtime that orchestrates specialized diagnostic agents, performs automated Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and recommends human-in-the-loop (HITL) remediation actions.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Design and Develop the Multi-Agent Runtime:** Build, optimize, and maintain the deployable Python runtime hosting MINDR agents. You will handle agent lifecycle management, instantiation, state persistence, audit trail logging, and termination.
* **Orchestration and Agent Tooling:** Build and scale the Principal Agent that dynamically schedules tasks and aggregates results from downstream child agents (Performance, Topology, Alarm, Ticket, CX, and Event Scout) using Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* **Implement the RCA Inspector:** Program the reasoning engine that consumes multi-source incident context and compares it against structural playbooks (e.g., CDN traffic shift patterns) and historical incidents to produce ranked, explainable root cause hypotheses.
* **Construct Stream-to-Stream API Contracts:** Maintain tight integration and high API hygiene with neighboring streams including Data Stream (reacting to Anodot anomaly streams via Pub/Sub and consuming Silver layer telemetry), Knowledge Stream (issuing semantic queries to the Knowledge Graph for network topology context), and Experience Stream (exposing WebSocket/SSE streams of agent run lifecycle events for real-time operator dashboards).
* **Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Remediation:** Build safe, secure integrations for the Remediation Agent to interface with Tardis-fronted APIs (e.g., triggering reroutes, raising CASM tickets, or partner notifications) under strict human approval gates.

### **Your Profile**

* Advanced Python development with deep expertise in building scalable production-ready backend services

title: Senior Staff Security Architect
description:
### **About Us**

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

### **Reports To**

Director, AI & Information Security

**Role Summary** We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Senior Staff Cyber Security Architect to design, implement, and govern security architecture across enterprise networks, endpoints, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and AI ecosystems. This role is critical to establishing security standards, driving secure-by-design initiatives, and ensuring our technology landscape remains resilient against evolving cyber threats. You will serve as a trusted technical leader, bridging business and technology to enable innovation through secure, scalable architecture.

**What You Will Be Doing**
  
As a Senior Staff Architect, you will define and maintain the enterprise-wide security architecture, standards, and reference designs. You will lead security reviews for infrastructure, cloud, SaaS, and emerging AI initiatives while enforcing Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust principles. Success in your first 6–12 months includes developing a cohesive security roadmap, establishing robust AI and cloud security guardrails, and partnering cross-functionally across Engineering, IT, and Product teams to reduce critical risks while elevating our overall security maturity.

**What You Will Bring to ChargePoint**

* **Define and maintain** enterprise-wide security architecture, standards, and reference designs across network, endpoint, cloud, SaaS, and AI domains.
* **Architect and govern** secure cloud landing zones, security guardrails, and DevSecOps shift-left practices across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
* **Establish and enforce** Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust Architecture principles, ensuring secure connectivity, micro-segmentation, and least-privilege access.
* **Lead the development** of our enterprise AI security strategy, establishing controls for Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), model poisoning detection, and responsible AI governance.
* **Design** enterprise network and endpoint security architecture, overseeing standards for NGFW, ZTNA, EDR, MDM, and secure SD-WAN.
* **Oversee** SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) and establish comprehensive controls for enterprise platforms (e.g., M365, Salesforce, Workday).
* **Develop** robust Identity & Access Management (IAM) strategies, including SSO, MFA, Privileged Access Management (PAM), and passwordless authentication.
* **Conduct** comprehensive architecture reviews, threat modeling, and security assessments to identify risks and recommend strategic remediation to executive leadership.
* **Partner cross-functionally** with Engineering, Product, IT, and Legal teams to integrate security throughout the development lifecycle and align with regulatory frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).
* **Provide architectural guidance** during major cyber incidents, partnering with SOC and Incident Response teams to evaluate events and strengthen future security controls.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of comprehensive cybersecurity experience, with at least 5+ years in a Security Architect or Lead Security Engineering role supporting enterprise-scale global environments.
* Deep technical expertise across network, endpoint, SaaS, cloud, and emerging AI security domains.
* Proven track record of designing and implementing Zero Trust Architectures and managing enterprise risk.
* Experience developing secure cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and implementing DevSecOps practices.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the courage and ability to influence cross-functional leadership on security best practices.
* **Education Requirements:** B.Tech/B.E. in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, or GIAC.
* Cloud-specific security certifications (e.g., AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer Associate, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer).
* Experience or certifications related to AI/LLM Security (e.g., CAISP) and data privacy (CIPP).
* Master's degree in a relevant technical or engineering field.

**Location**
  
Gurgaon/Bangalore, India — Hybrid / Remote

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
**Organization:**

At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.

  

**Job Title:** Staff Engineer – Knowledge Management

  

**Location:** Bangalore

  

**Business & Team:**

The Chief AI Office (CAIO) drives the bank’s AI strategy, platforms, governance, and capabilities to accelerate the safe and scalable adoption of AI across the enterprise.

The Knowledge Management domain within CAIO creates the cognitive foundation of the bank by transforming business knowledge into trusted, governed, and reusable knowledge products.

As a Staff Engineer – Knowledge Management, you will work closely with Knowledge Governance & Framework Leads, Knowledge Platform & Engineering Teams, Business SMEs, knowledge owners, product teams, and DHP platform and DevSecOps teams.

  

**Impact & Contribution:**

You will directly support CAIO's objective of creating the bank's enterprise knowledge capability and trusted knowledge products that accelerate AI-powered transformation across the Group.

You will enable colleagues, copilots, and AI agents to access trusted, governed, and reusable enterprise knowledge, improving decision-making consistency and productivity.

You will help reduce duplication of knowledge, manual research effort, and rework by transforming fragmented information into reusable knowledge products with clear ownership, lineage, and controls.

You will build enterprise knowledge platform and retrieval capabilities that make business policies, procedures, controls, and operational knowledge AI-ready and safely consumable at scale.

You will strengthen governance, explainability, and risk management through metadata, provenance, permissions, evaluation, and auditability built into the knowledge lifecycle.

  

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Enterprise Knowledge Products:** Design and build enterprise-scale knowledge products that transform unstructured information into trusted, reusable, and AI-ready assets.

**Ontology, Taxonomy & Knowledge Graphs:** Develop and maintain the enterprise ontology, semantic model, metadata, taxonomy, and knowledge graph that provide shared context across business domains.

**Knowledge Platform Engineering:** Engineer knowledge ingestion, enrichment, retrieval, and lifecycle management capabilities for governed knowledge products.

**Knowledge Governance:** Build and enforce knowledge governance controls covering ownership, lineage, provenance, classification, permissions, auditability, and lifecycle policies.

**Policy-as-Code & Decisioning:** Implement policy-as-code and deterministic decisioning capabilities to deliver consistent, explainable, and compliant AI outcomes.

**AI Guardrails & Retrieval Controls:** Develop AI guardrails, retrieval controls, and policy-aware access mechanisms to ensure only authorised and trusted knowledge is exposed to LLMs and agents.

**AI & Agent Integration:** Integrate the knowledge platform with LLM gateways, agent frameworks, evaluation frameworks, and AI platform services to accelerate safe adoption of agentic AI solutions.

**Quality, Evaluation & Observability:** Establish quality, observability, evaluation, and feedback loops to continuously improve knowledge accuracy, trustworthiness, retrieval effectiveness, and business outcomes.

**Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work across engineering, CAIO, CDO, product teams, business SMEs, and knowledge owners to translate complex business knowledge, policies, processes, and controls into reusable enterprise knowledge products.

  

**Essential Skills:**

**Knowledge Management & Semantic Engineering:**

Deep expertise in knowledge graphs, ontology engineering, semantic modelling, taxonomy, and metadata management for enterprise-scale knowledge ecosystems.

Strong experience in unstructured data processing, document understanding, information extraction, entity resolution, and knowledge enrichment pipelines.

Strong stakeholder engagement and product-thinking skills with the ability to translate business knowledge, policies, processes, and controls into reusable enterprise knowledge products.

**RAG, GraphRAG & Retrieval:**

Hands-on expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, vector databases, search technologies, and retrieval optimisation for AI-powered knowledge systems.

Experience building enterprise search, retrieval, discovery, recommendation, or similar knowledge capabilities is desirable.

**Knowledge Graph & Semantic Technologies:**

Hands-on knowledge of semantic and graph technologies including RDF, OWL, SKOS, SPARQL, ontology engineering, taxonomy management, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, and graph modelling concepts.

**Enterprise Knowledge Platform Engineering:**

Proficiency in designing enterprise knowledge platforms with scalability, reliability, observability, security, and cloud-native architecture principles.

Knowledge of ingestion pipelines, enrichment, retrieval, lifecycle management, APIs, integration patterns, and enterprise platform engineering.

**Knowledge Governance & Responsible AI:**

Strong understanding of knowledge governance, data governance, lineage, provenance, access control, compliance, permissions, classification, and auditability frameworks.

Experience implementing AI guardrails, retrieval controls, policy-aware access, evaluation mechanisms, and governance controls for safe consumption of enterprise knowledge.

**GenAI & Agentic AI Integration:**

Experience integrating LLM gateways, agent frameworks, AI platforms, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and model orchestration services.

Familiarity with agentic AI architectures, multi-agent orchestration, MCP patterns, and tool-based reasoning systems is desirable.

**Policy-as-Code & Decisioning:**

Ability to implement policy-as-code, executable knowledge, rules engines, and deterministic decisioning patterns to support explainable and compliant AI outcomes.

Experience with BPMN, DMN, policy engines, and executable knowledge is desirable.

**Programming Languages & Tools:**

Strong programming experience with Python as the primary language, together with TypeScript/Node.js and SQL for platform engineering, APIs, data pipelines, and AI integrations.

Experience with cloud-based AI, knowledge management, semantic technologies, or knowledge graph platforms is desirable.

**Risk, Compliance & Enterprise Knowledge:**

Knowledge of risk, compliance, regulatory, and control frameworks within highly governed financial services environments is advantageous.

Understanding of process intelligence, process mining, business capability modelling, and decision modelling to capture and operationalise organisational knowledge is desirable.

**Collaboration & Engineering Capability:**

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Ability to work effectively across engineering, CAIO, CDO, and business stakeholders.

Clear communication and documentation skills with the ability to explain complex knowledge architecture, governance, and AI concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

Strong ownership mindset with a focus on automation, continuous improvement, scalability, and reusable engineering practices.

  

**Education Qualification:**

Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.

Relevant cloud or AI certifications, including AWS, AI/ML, or Generative AI certifications, are advantageous.

description:

We're looking for someone with 3+ years of software engineering experience (mid-level) or 6+ years (senior), with hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agent-based systems in production.
  
  
Technical Skills- Solid software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modelling, and clean, maintainable code.
- Experience building and running production systems in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containers, Kubernetes or similar, and infrastructure as code.
- Hands-on experience with distributed systems: queues, async workflows, concurrency, reliability, and failure handling.
- Practical experience building with LLMs: tool use, agents, prompt and context engineering, RAG, and evaluation.
- Familiarity with agent protocols and ecosystems (e.g., MCP) and with using AI coding tools day to day.
  
  
Leadership & Ownership- Comfort working independently and handling ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, scope it, and drive it to production.
- Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining trade-offs to both technical and non technical audiences.
- At the senior level, we also expect you to lead projects and set technical direction, mentor other engineers, define evaluation and quality standards, and influence architecture across teams.
  
  
Mindset & Collaboration- Growth mindset — curious, always learning, and open to feedback.
- Works closely with the engineers who use these tools every day; you help the whole organization build software better and faster.
  
  
Nice to Have- Experience with trace analysis or log mining to find and fix agent failure modes.
- Experience building internal platforms or SDKs that other teams adopted.
- Background in observability, CI/CD, or developer productivity tooling.
- Experience with model routing, cost optimization, or prompt caching.
- Open-source or public contributions in agent tooling or LLM infrastructure.
  
  
What to Expect- We value humility and collaboration — we're looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos.
- We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code — including tests, documentation, and long-term system quality.
  
  
#LI-RT

  

**Key Responsibilities**

The Impact You'll Make- Build and operate agent platforms: orchestration, tool and skill registries, plugin frameworks, and sandboxed execution.
- Develop coding agents and review agents that work well on real, large codebases, and integrate them into the existing SDLC (IDE, CI/CD, code review, issue tracking).
- Design context and memory management: retrieval (RAG), summarization and compression, session state, long-term memory, and repository-aware context.
- Build evaluation frameworks — both offline (benchmarks, regression suites) and online (production quality signals) — so we can measure whether agents are improving.

- Build developer tooling and internal SDKs that make it easy for other teams to build on and adopt the platform.
- Own observability for agent systems: tracing, cost and latency tracking, and quality monitoring.

title: Video & Data Core Network Operations Engineer - VOIS
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking a skilled Video & Data Core Network Operations Engineer to join our 24x7 Integrated Network Operations Centre (INOC) in Bangalore. This role is responsible for first-line monitoring, incident detection, fault analysis, troubleshooting, escalation and service restoration activities across Video, Data Core, Core Services and associated telecom network platforms. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining network availability, supporting service continuity and ensuring operational excellence through effective alarm monitoring, incident management and stakeholder coordination in a fast-paced telecom operations environment.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Monitor network alarms, events and service-impacting incidents across Video and Data Core platforms, ensuring timely detection in line with operational procedures and service level commitments.
* Detect, validate, register, update and track incidents accurately within approved ticketing systems.
* Perform first-level fault analysis, diagnosis and remote troubleshooting to support rapid service restoration and first-time resolution where possible.
* Correlate alarms and events to determine service impact, incident priority and the appropriate escalation path.
* Manage the incident lifecycle from detection through to closure, ensuring timely communication, documentation and ownership tracking.
* Escalate critical or unresolved incidents to resolver groups, vendors, suppliers or field support teams in accordance with established escalation procedures.
* Coordinate with internal teams, external partners and support functions to support investigation, troubleshooting and restoration activities.
* Monitor and support Voice, Data Core, Charging, SMS and Core Services platforms across 2G, 3G, LTE, 5G and 5G Standalone network environments.
* Support technologies including SMSC, Voicemail, SGSN, MME, S/PGW, ePDG, PCRF, AMF, SMF, PCF, NRF, UDM, AUSF, EIR, HLR/HSS, STP, MSC, MGW, CSCF, MTAS and USSD.
* Participate in planned maintenance activities, alarm testing, health checks and post-change monitoring.
* Maintain accurate shift reports, operational updates and handover documentation covering critical incidents and pending actions.
* Ensure compliance with operational procedures, security requirements and business continuity standards.
* Support network inventory verification activities and raise discrepancies where identified.
* Work in rotational shifts, including weekends, public holidays and night shifts, to support continuous network operations.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related technical discipline.
* BE/B.Tech in Electronics and Telecommunications preferred.
* 4-7 years of experience within telecommunications operations, network operations centres or service operations environments.
* Good understanding of GSM, UMTS, LTE, 5G and Core Network architectures.
* Knowledge of SMS, Voice, Charging, Data Core and Core Services technologies and platforms.
* Experience in alarm monitoring, event correlation, incident handling and first-level troubleshooting.
* Understanding of ITIL Incident Management practices, including incident logging, prioritisation, escalation, communication and closure.
* Ability to assess service impact and make informed decisions in time-sensitive operational situations.
* Effective communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate with resolver teams, suppliers, vendors and operational stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate incident documentation.
* Good written and spoken English communication skills.
* Ability to perform effectively in a shift-based operational environment.

**Not a Perfect Fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

* Opportunity to work within a highly critical telecom network operations environment supporting global services.
* Exposure to advanced Video, Data Core, Voice, Charging and 5G technologies.
* Experience collaborating with international stakeholders, vendors and technology partners.
* Participation in large-scale service assurance, incident management and operational transformation activities.
* Hands-on involvement with network monitoring platforms, troubleshooting tools and operational processes.
* Opportunity to contribute directly to customer experience and network service availability.
* Exposure to virtualised and containerised telecom network solutions.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

* Advanced telecom network operations and service assurance practices.
* Incident and major incident management within mission-critical environments.
* Alarm correlation, fault diagnosis and service impact assessment methodologies.
* Operations and maintenance of 4G LTE, 5G and 5G Standalone Core technologies.
* Stakeholder management and operational communication in complex technical environments.
* Vendor management, escalation governance and service restoration coordination.
* ITIL-aligned operational service management capabilities.
* Exposure to virtualisation, cloud-native and container-based telecom technologies.

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

With us, you can be truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

title: Senior Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

AI Infrastructure Engineer (Mid / Senior)
  
  
Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid – 3 days a week in office)
  
  
About Us
  
Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. Together with our Bengaluru engineering team, we are building finance, accounting, payroll and expense management solutions that simplifies how businesses track and reconcile spending.
  
Thousands of finance teams globally use our product to streamline expense management, integrate seamlessly with leading accounting platforms, and are recognized for its clean design, usability, and speed.
  
We're investing heavily in AI — building the platform that lets AI agents and assistants do real engineering work, reliably and at scale. This team designs and runs the infrastructure behind our coding agents, review agents, and internal AI assistants: the orchestration, context and memory systems, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that make them better over time.
  
  
What We're Looking For
  
We're looking for someone with 3+ years of software engineering experience (mid-level) or 6+ years (senior), with hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agent-based systems in production.
  
  
Technical Skills- Solid software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modelling, and clean, maintainable code.
- Experience building and running production systems in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containers, Kubernetes or similar, and infrastructure as code.
- Hands-on experience with distributed systems: queues, async workflows, concurrency, reliability, and failure handling.
- Practical experience building with LLMs: tool use, agents, prompt and context engineering, RAG, and evaluation.
- Familiarity with agent protocols and ecosystems (e.g., MCP) and with using AI coding tools day to day.
  
  
Leadership & Ownership- Comfort working independently and handling ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, scope it, and drive it to production.
- Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining trade-offs to both technical and non technical audiences.
- At the senior level, we also expect you to lead projects and set technical direction, mentor other engineers, define evaluation and quality standards, and influence architecture across teams.
  
  
Mindset & Collaboration- Growth mindset — curious, always learning, and open to feedback.
- Works closely with the engineers who use these tools every day; you help the whole organization build software better and faster.
  
  
Nice to Have- Experience with trace analysis or log mining to find and fix agent failure modes.
- Experience building internal platforms or SDKs that other teams adopted.
- Background in observability, CI/CD, or developer productivity tooling.
- Experience with model routing, cost optimization, or prompt caching.
- Open-source or public contributions in agent tooling or LLM infrastructure.
  
  
What to Expect- We value humility and collaboration — we're looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos.
- We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code — including tests, documentation, and long-term system quality.
  
  
#LI-RT

  

**Key Responsibilities**

The Impact You'll Make- Build and operate agent platforms: orchestration, tool and skill registries, plugin frameworks, and sandboxed execution.
- Develop coding agents and review agents that work well on real, large codebases, and integrate them into the existing SDLC (IDE, CI/CD, code review, issue tracking).
- Design context and memory management: retrieval (RAG), summarization and compression, session state, long-term memory, and repository-aware context.
- Build evaluation frameworks — both offline (benchmarks, regression suites) and online (production quality signals) — so we can measure whether agents are improving.
- Create feedback loops: capture and mine traces, find failure patterns, and turn them into better prompts, tools, skills, and evals.
- Build developer tooling and internal SDKs that make it easy for other teams to build on and adopt the platform.
- Own observability for agent systems: tracing, cost and latency tracking, and quality monitoring.
- Work with engineers and stakeholders to identify high-value workflows, ship quickly, and iterate on real usage data.
  
  
#LI-RT

* Debug efficiently

* Conduct routine performance analysis and optimize software

* Collaborate with your fellow team members, to benefit from their knowledge and different backgrounds, and bring your own assets to the team
Coordinate cross team/cross area development with other teams and developers  

  

**We are looking for...**

* Bachelors or master’s in computer science or Engineering (Software Development)
* Minimum 9 Years of relevant IT experience
* 3+ years of experience in Cloud
* Good knowledge on Cloud native technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, Quarkus, OpenShift, Micro services)
* Create scalable microservices of high performance, high availability, interoperability, and reliability

* Hands-on practical experience delivering system design, application development, testing, and operational stability.
* Review AI-Generated outputs for accuracy, security, compliance and production readiness.
* Participate to knowledge sharing. Monitor and improve component DevOps KPIs
* Proven experience of building services in cloud.
* Experience in leading group of developers and teams.
* Demonstrates high-level competency in maintaining technical and architectural documents using tools like Confluence or equivalent.

* Familiar to complete product development lifecycle including production support
* Able to deliver high quality results in a fast paced, changing environment with shifting priorities

* Contribute designs and technical proof of concepts and adhere to standards and guidance from architecture team members.
* Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages like Oracle, MySQL or NoSQL databases like Cassandra or MongoDB.

* Maintain timely reports on status of projects, potential technical problems, and any other relevant details.
* Build, improve and modernize CI/CD pipelines to favor velocity and reliability. Ensure built-in quality and security. Help improve software development processes & release workflows through automation.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

  

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.

  

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

title: Firmware Engineer
description:
Firmware Engineer

Full-Time | Bengaluru, Work from Office

Qualifying Degree: B.Tech | Experience: 4+ years

**Note:** Shortlisted candidates will complete a take-home assignment as part of the process.

**About Us**
------------

Our client is building the first precision health platform for pets , a sensor-driven, AI-powered ecosystem that decodes the health signals dogs give off every day, the ones most people miss, and turns them into insight you can act on.

It starts with EverBowl, a clinical-grade device that reads hydration, intake, body temperature, eating behavior, and the sound of a bite , building toward a single daily wellness score. Paired with the app and Protect+, our insurance-rewards membership, we're helping pet parents move from guesswork to knowing. Calm. Confident. In control.

We're not building another pet gadget. None of it works without firmware that never fails , sensors reading in sync, data flowing over BLE without loss, updates reaching every device in the field without bricking a single one. That's the problem this role exists to solve.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a firmware engineer to build and maintain reliable embedded systems for sensor-driven hardware, working closely with the Lead Firmware Engineer across sensor integration, connectivity, and power management.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Develop and maintain RTOS-based firmware for embedded devices, keeping real-time performance stable
* Implement drivers and communication logic for sensors over I2C, SPI, or UART, and support arbitration across shared buses
* Support BLE-based firmware development for reliable data transfer between devices and the cloud
* Contribute to firmware-level battery charging safety, thermal cutoff logic, and clock stability under real-world conditions
* Support OTA update mechanisms, including testing rollout and rollback behavior before release
* Debug hardware-firmware interaction issues using tools such as oscilloscopes and logic analyzers
* Write and maintain unit and hardware-in-the-loop tests to catch issues before they reach the field

**You Might Be a Fit If…**
--------------------------

* You have a B.Tech in Electronics, Computer Science, or related field
* You have 4+ years of embedded firmware experience
* You have a solid understanding of RTOS concepts and at least one communication protocol used in sensor-based systems (I2C, SPI, UART, or BLE)
* You're proficient in C and C++ for embedded and microcontroller-based systems
* You're comfortable reading datasheets and debugging at the hardware-firmware boundary
* **Bonus:** experience with battery charging circuits or power-path management
* **Bonus:** exposure to OTA update mechanisms for fleet-deployed embedded devices
* **Bonus:** experience working with thermal sensors, IMUs, or camera modules

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

* Build firmware for hardware that's actually out in the field, on real dogs , not just on a bench
* Learn directly from the Lead Firmware Engineer while owning real pieces of the system
* Take ownership early, with a direct line to the people building the rest of the product
* Join a small, fast-moving team building a category-defining, sensor-driven product

**To Apply**
------------

Share your background, along with any embedded systems or firmware you've built and shipped. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short assignment as part of our process.

title: IGA Engineer
description:
**About Chubb**

Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: http://www.chubb.com/

**About Chubb India**

At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we foster a startup mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape. We offer an environment where you will be part of an organisation that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.

**Position Details:**

**Job Title:** IGA Engineer

**Function/Department:** Security Engineering

**Location:** Hyderabad, Bangalore

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking an experienced Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) Engineer to design, develop, and configure robust identity management solutions on Chubb’s SailPoint IdentityNow (ISC) platform. In this role you will integrate the IGA platform with enterprise systems, build and maintain automated lifecycle processes, configure access certification campaigns, and contribute to the ongoing migration of applications from the legacy OIM platform to new platform. You will work closely with global IAM and project teams to translate business requirements into secure, scalable technical configurations that streamline access control across the organisation. This role follows a hybrid working model based in India.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Perform end-to-end IGA application onboarding and development on SailPoint ISC, including access request catalogue configuration, UI customisations, access policy design, role management, and custom rule development.
* Configure and maintain SailPoint ISC connectors — including Active Directory / Entra ID, SCIM, JDBC, REST, and web-service connectors — to support seamless user lifecycle management across enterprise applications.
* Develop and maintain BeanShell rules, Transform rules, and Provisioning Policies within SailPoint ISC to support custom lifecycle, aggregation, and provisioning logic.
* Design and support Identity Lifecycle Manager (LCM) processes — joiner, mover, leaver — ensuring automation aligns with HR and business-defined triggers.
* Configure and manage Access Certification (campaign) and Access Review processes to meet audit and compliance requirements.
* Integrate SailPoint ISC with enterprise platforms including Entra ID (Azure AD), PAM products, ServiceNow (ITSM), and other enterprise systems using REST APIs and SailPoint PAT-based authentication.
* Partner with project teams to understand business requirements, translate them into technical designs, and validate solutions end-to-end.
* Support the ongoing migration of applications from Oracle Identity Manager (OIM) to SailPoint ISC, reviewing legacy OIM connector configurations and re-engineering them for ISC.
* Build and maintain automated monitoring capabilities to support system health and security compliance.
* Troubleshoot platform issues, resolve defects, and ensure stable performance of the IGA platform.
* Collaborate with cross-functional global teams — IAM Engineering, onboarding teams, Application teams, Audit, and ServiceNow — to deliver secure, efficient, and scalable identity solutions.
* Support ongoing platform enhancements, continuous improvement initiatives, and technical debt remediation.

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience in Identity Governance and Administration engineering
* 6-12 years of hands-on IGA engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to deliver independently on assigned workstreams while collaborating effectively with global team members and stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityNow / ISC (required) — including Access Request, Lifecycle Manager, Certifications, Roles, Connectors, and the SailPoint ISC REST API. SailPoint IdentityNow Certified Engineer credential is strongly preferred.
* Experience with Oracle Identity Manager (OIM) is an advantage — knowledge of OIM connector types, adapter configuration, and reconciliation is valued in the context of OIM-to-ISC migration projects.
* Scripting proficiency in BeanShell and/or Java for IGA rule development within SailPoint ISC; REST API and JSON fluency for platform integrations and connector development.
* Experience working with Entra ID (Azure AD) and on-premises Active Directory, including connector configuration, group and role management, and lifecycle event handling.
* Experience with REST APIs and web services to enable system connectivity, automate identity-related processes, and support secure data exchange across enterprise applications.
* Experience integrating IGA platforms with ServiceNow for access request fulfilment and ticketing workflows is strongly preferred.
* Direct experience with SailPoint ISC connector types, including:
  + Active Directory / Entra ID Connector
  + SCIM 2.0 Connector
  + JDBC / Database Connector
  + Web Service / REST Connector
  + Virtual Appliance (VA) management
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills; ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams in a global, matrixed environment.
Experience working in agile/scrum delivery models within a global IAM team, including sprint planning, story estimation, and iterative release cycles.  

**Why Join Us?**

description:

**Your impact begins here**

As Principal Data Engineer, you will be the technical lead for the AIRE data engineering, design and delivery teams, helping strategize, build & enable the data foundations that Novo’s commercial, global manufacturing, supply chain and corporate functions would need. You will combine deep engineering expertise with business understanding to shape requirements, guide teams and vendors, and raise the bar for data quality, governance and engineering practices. Your work gives AI, analytics and business teams data they can trust and act on today.

  

**What you’ll bring**

You are a hands-on engineering leader, as comfortable reviewing code as shaping a strategic data foundational capability roadmap with business leaders. You will bring:

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture and data product development, designing and delivering large-scale, complex data initiatives.
* Strong hands-on expertise in AWS, Snowflake, dbt, Databricks, Python, SQL and GitHub Enterprise or Azure DevOps.
* Deep expertise in ETL/ELT design, data modelling, data warehousing and data lakes, and streaming technologies such as Kafka and Event Hubs.
* A strong DataOps and DevOps background, including Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker and Kubernetes, grounded in modern software development practices.
* Proven experience integrating data across platforms from multiple source-system types and formats, including open table formats and interoperability.
* A solid grounding in automated testing, data quality, metadata, lineage, MDM, catalogue and policy management, security and production reliability, including classifying and protecting data with native platform features.
* A demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, influence technical direction, partner with stakeholders and manage vendor delivery in cross-functional, matrix teams.
* Highly proficient English and the ability to communicate clearly with people at all levels, technical and non-technical.

**Useful, but not essential:**

Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another regulated industry.

  

**What you’ll do**

You will set the technical direction for how data is designed, built, governed and delivered, and make independent decisions on the right approaches. You will:

* Design enterprise-scale data architectures, data models, storage strategies and integration patterns, set standards for ingestion, transformation and consumption, and recommend the technologies that fit.
* Lead the development of robust batch and real-time ETL/ELT pipelines, ensuring high data quality, reliability and performance, and resolving complex engineering issues.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership across AWS, Snowflake, dbt and Databricks, run architecture and code reviews, mentor data engineers and set standards and SOPs that link engineering to business value.
* Implement data governance frameworks, ensure security, privacy and regulatory compliance, drive master data and data quality initiatives, define metadata, lineage and cataloguing strategies, and support risk assessments and audits.
* Build data foundations, feature stores and data products for AI, ML and self-service analytics, applying agentic development and AI-assisted engineering with appropriate validation and review.
* Optimise performance and cost, implement observability and alerting, and lead large-scale delivery, managing risks and dependencies and setting clear expectations for vendor designs, code, testing, documentation and operational readiness.
* Evaluate modern data stacks, semantic technologies and DataOps practices, using pragmatic prototypes to show where data creates measurable business impact.
  

**Who you’ll work with**

You will join the Bangalore office of Enterprise AI Reinvent & Engineering and be part of AI Data Solutions team, where colleagues work with stakeholders across the value chain to deliver enterprise specific Data & AI use cases, while enabling high quality and responsible ways of working.

You will work closely with the AI Reinvent & Engineering’s (AIRE) core data engineering & data architect team, respective domain teams within AIRE’s commercial, manufacturing, quality & corporate functions, collaborate with AIRE’s AI Engineering team and central Data & AI Foundation team, platform and enterprise architecture teams, and data owners, security and privacy specialists, as well as vendors and external consultants. You will also technically lead and represent AIRE Data Solutions in discussions on data-driven insights and business capabilities.

Together, you will clarify requirements, align designs, run architecture reviews, escalate risks and dependencies, and share knowledge across locations and time zones so priorities move forward with clarity and speed.

  

**What you can expect here**

You will be trusted to own technical decisions and to propose and execute new approaches to complex data challenges, while upholding data governance and ethical standards. With work spanning commercial, manufacturing, supply chain and corporate data, you will build a broad view of the Novo value chain.

You will be at the forefront of AI and technology, as Novo upskills its entire workforce to advance AI as a main driver for innovation for the benefit of people living with serious chronic diseases. title: Technical Lead – Data Engineering
description:
**Who are we?**  
  

Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.

We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.
  
Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.

We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
  
From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.

Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.

  

**Technical Lead – Data Engineering**

**Myntra Data Platform (MDP) | Bengaluru | 6+ Years**

**About the Role**
------------------

**Myntra Data Platform (MDP) powers the data foundation behind analytics, experimentation, personalization, ML and critical business decisions across Myntra.**

**We are looking for a hands-on Technical Lead – Data Engineering to build and evolve large-scale data processing, ETL and orchestration platforms, while helping shape the next generation of AI-native and agentic data engineering at Myntra.**

**This is a senior individual-contributor role requiring deep technical ownership—from architecture and production-quality code to performance optimization, troubleshooting and operational excellence.**

**The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep expertise in Spark, SQL, ETL, workflow orchestration, data modeling and modern lakehouse architectures.**

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Large-Scale Batch Processing**

* **Design, build and optimize large-scale batch processing systems using Apache Spark, PySpark and Spark SQL.**
* **Build production-grade pipelines handling high-volume transformations, joins and aggregations.**
* **Apply deep understanding of Spark DAGs, stages, shuffles, partitioning, joins, caching, memory and query plans.**
* **Diagnose data skew, shuffles, memory pressure, inefficient joins and partitioning issues.**
* **Optimize execution time, compute utilization and cost.**
* **Build reusable Spark libraries, frameworks and engineering patterns.**

### **ETL & Data Pipeline Engineering**

* **Build reliable ETL/ELT pipelines across ingestion, transformation, validation, enrichment and publishing.**
* **Develop reusable pipeline frameworks and abstractions rather than one-off solutions.**
* **Design for incremental processing, backfills, retries, idempotency, dependencies and failure recovery.**
* **Ensure correctness, freshness, scalability and maintainability.**
* **Own pipelines from architecture development deployment production operations.**

### **Workflow Orchestration**

* **Design and operate large-scale workflows using Apache Airflow, Dagster or equivalent platforms.**
* **Orchestrate complex dependencies across Spark, SQL and data-processing workloads.**
* **Build reusable operators, components and orchestration patterns.**
* **Improve scheduling, retries, backfills, dependency management and operational visibility.**
* **Build self-service capabilities for developing, deploying and operating data pipelines at scale.**

### **Databricks & Lakehouse Engineering**

* **Build and operate large-scale workloads on Databricks and Spark-based environments.**
* **Design lakehouse architectures using Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Parquet or equivalent technologies.**
* **Optimize partitioning, file sizing, compaction, metadata, Spark and SQL workloads for performance and cost.**
* **Build platform capabilities that simplify compute, storage and data consumption.**

### **SQL, dbt, Data Transformation & Data Modeling**

* **Develop and optimize complex production-grade SQL and Spark SQL transformations.**
* **Build modular transformation models using dbt or equivalent frameworks.**
* **Establish standards for SQL quality, testing, documentation and dependency management.**
* **Troubleshoot expensive queries using execution/query plans.**
* **Design scalable relational, dimensional and lakehouse data models.**
* **Apply fact/dimension modeling, star schemas, SCDs and incremental models where appropriate.**
* **Translate business and analytical requirements into reusable data models across raw, curated and consumption-ready layers.**

### **Agentic Data Engineering**

* **Build AI-native data engineering capabilities across the end-to-end pipeline lifecycle.**
* **Design AI-assisted workflows that translate requirements into data models, SQL/Spark transformations and executable pipelines.**
* **Build agents that understand schemas, metadata, lineage, business semantics and existing pipelines.**
* **Apply LLMs/agents to SQL and pipeline generation, code review, testing, documentation and optimization.**
* **Build intelligent Spark/SQL optimization and pipeline RCA using execution plans, job metrics, logs, dependencies and historical performance.**
* **Automate generation of data-quality checks, tests, documentation and lineage metadata.**
* **Build natural-language/semantic interfaces for data discovery and safe pipeline creation/modification.**
* **Integrate agents with Airflow/Dagster, dbt, Databricks, Spark and metadata/catalog platforms.**
* **Design human-in-the-loop controls, validation, guardrails and evaluations for AI-generated SQL, code and pipelines.**
* **Build reusable agent frameworks, tools and APIs, not isolated AI demos.**

### **Data Quality & Governance**

* **Embed data quality into pipelines with automated freshness, completeness, schema and consistency checks.**
* **Establish standards for metadata, ownership, lineage and discoverability.**
* **Integrate with Unity Catalog or equivalent governance/catalog platforms.**
* **Design controls for PII, access management, auditing and sensitive data.**
* **Ensure AI-generated and human-authored pipelines follow the same quality, security and governance standards.**

### **Reliability & Operational Excellence**

* **Own production health of critical pipelines and platform components.**
* **Monitor failures, SLAs, freshness, data quality, performance and cost.**
* **Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of complex incidents.**
* **Eliminate recurring operational problems through automation, platform improvements and intelligent tooling.**

### **Technical Leadership**

* **Remain deeply hands-on while providing technical direction.**
* **Lead architecture/design reviews and review Spark, Python and SQL implementations.**
* **Mentor engineers across Spark, ETL, SQL, data modeling and production engineering.**
* **Build reusable frameworks and engineering standards adopted across teams.**
* **Drive responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering.**
* **Lead complex cross-team initiatives and influence architecture without direct authority.**

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **6+ years of hands-on Data Engineering / Software Engineering experience building production data systems at scale.**
* **Deep expertise in Apache Spark / PySpark, Spark SQL and Spark internals.**
* **Strong programming skills in Python, Java or Scala.**
* **Advanced SQL, query optimization and performance-debugging skills.**
* **Strong experience building production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines.**
* **Experience with Airflow, Dagster or equivalent orchestration platforms.**
* **Experience with Databricks or comparable Spark-based platforms.**
* **Experience with dbt or SQLMesh**
* **Strong understanding of data modeling and lakehouse architecture.**
* **Experience with Parquet, Delta Lake and/or Apache Iceberg.**
* **Experience with data quality, metadata, lineage and governance.**
* **Strong production ownership—from design and implementation through operations and RCA.**
* **Demonstrated technical leadership through architecture, code reviews and mentoring.**

**Good to Have**
----------------

* **Experience building LLM-powered developer tools, AI agents or engineering automation.**
* **Understanding of LLMs, tool/function calling, RAG, structured generation and agentic workflows.**
* **Experience applying AI to SQL generation, data discovery, pipeline generation, debugging or optimization.**
* **Experience with metadata catalogs, semantic layers, lineage or knowledge graphs for AI context.**
* **Experience building evaluations and guardrails for AI-generated SQL/code.**
* **Experience building multi-tenant/self-service data platforms, frameworks or SDKs.**
* **Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure and Unity Catalog or similar governance platforms.**

**What Makes This Role Different**
----------------------------------

**You will build the engineering foundations that enable data engineering at Myntra scale — Spark processing, orchestration, ETL frameworks, data modeling, lakehouse architecture, governance and production reliability.**

**At the same time, you will help redefine data engineering for an agentic world — where agents understand data and dependencies, accelerate the journey from intent to production pipelines, automate repetitive engineering work, and operate within strong human-controlled guardrails.**

**We are looking for someone comfortable moving between Spark execution plans, Python, SQL, Airflow/Dagster DAGs, dbt models, metadata and platform architecture — and excited about making these workflows dramatically better with AI.**

**Build the data platform of today — and help define how data engineering will work tomorrow.**

Our mission is simple. End Cyber Risk. We're looking for an **Engineering Manager** to be part of making this happen.
  
  
**Position Overview and Objective**  
  
The Engineering Manager will contribute to our **Sensor Platform Delivery team** by leading the site reliability engineering (SRE), quality assurance (QA), lab infrastructure, and release rollout functions that take our network security sensor platform from a passing build to a healthy, verified state across thousands of sensors deployed in customer environments worldwide.

* Oversee the physical lab environment, including build servers, power distribution units (PDUs), and virtualized test fleets, keeping lab configuration aligned with production.

* Partner with infrastructure and security teams on container orchestration, database management, and core networking protocols, including TCP/IP and port mirroring, to support sensor telemetry and detection workflows.

* Mentor and grow a team of engineers, strengthening people management practices and cross functional partnership with solution engineering managers and solution architects.

* 10- 15 yrs of experience which should include 5+ years in software engineering, including 2 or more years managing engineering teams.
* Hands on experience with test infrastructure, lab environments, and CI/CD pipelines, including debugging across physical and virtualized systems.
* A track record in release engineering and platform reliability, with experience improving release confidence across distributed systems.
* Experience operating services on AWS, including container orchestration and managed database administration.
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP and port mirroring, and of security protocols relevant to network security appliances.
* Experience managing or partnering closely with QA and DevOps functions, and comfort working alongside solution engineers and solution architects.
* Strong written communication skills, with experience producing runbooks, postmortems, and release notes that on-call engineers depend on.

title: Senior Staff Engineer - AI
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

As a Senior AI Engineer , you will combine deep classical analytics craft, data engineering, with modern AI-native ways of working. You will design and deliver AI frameworks which can be scaled across the enterprise, and leverage LLMs, agents, and RAG to unlock measurable business KPIs. You will partner closely with FLIGHT DECK, publish AI workflows and agents, and help raise the AI capability of the analytics community around you as an emerging AI Coach.

**Job Description**
===================

**Company Overview**

Working at GE Aerospace means you are bringing your unique perspective, innovative spirit, drive, and curiosity to a collaborative and diverse team working to advance aerospace for future generations. If you have ideas, we will listen. Join us and see your ideas take flight!

**Site Overview**

Established in 2000, the John F. Welch Technology Center (JFWTC) in Bengaluru is our multidisciplinary research and engineering center. Engineers and scientists at JFWTC have contributed to hundreds of aviation patents, pioneering breakthroughs in engine technologies, advanced materials, and additive manufacturing.

**Role Overview:**

  

* Find, interpret, and merge data sources, ensure dataset consistency, create visualisations, and communicate insights simply — using AI-augmented tooling (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, LLM analytics assistants) to accelerate exploration and narrative generation.
* Prioritise, prototype, design, build, test, and deploy analytics models and AI agents in an agile methodology — including RAG on enterprise data, natural-language querying, and LLM-driven data quality and anomaly detection.
* Develop analytic/AI solutions from various source systems— augmented with AI-assisted profiling, entity resolution, and quality-check pipelines.
* Develop technical expertise in AI development for engineering applications— including next-generation 'ask-the-data' experiences powered by LLMs on top of the enterprise Data Fabric.
* Present project plans, technical roadmaps, risks, and recommendations to senior leaders — including AI/analytics adoption roadmaps tied to measurable business KPIs.
* Work closely with the Engineering teams and AI leadership to identify AI-enabled analytics use-cases (agents, copilots, conversational dashboards); translate AI-driven insights into business language for non-technical stakeholders.
* Serve as a technical specialist in the discipline — deep expertise in classical analytics and applied AI/ML for enterprise data.
* Partner closely with FLIGHT DECK and business-defined priorities to build, scale, and industrialise AI-powered analytics workflows, agents, and connectors — end-to-end to production adoption.
* Define and enforce enterprise-grade AI standards, guardrails, and best practices — responsible AI, evaluation, security, observability — so AI-powered insights are trustworthy and production-grade.
* Coach and enable AI Builders across the analytics community: teach AI Foundations, review agents/workflows, unblock architectural barriers, and align team practices with Data Fabric standards.
* Develop communication, training, and change-management deliverables to increase adoption of analytics and AI capabilities; establish a community of practice around AI-augmented analytics.

**Ideal Candidate:**

  

* Ideal candidate should have experience in SQL/Python fundamentals plus fluency in AI-augmented development — using AI as a productivity multiplier without compromising data correctness, lineage, or governance.

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's in Engineering/Technology/Aerospace or "STEM" Majors with a minimum of 8 years of experience.
* Strong oral and written communication skills; strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
* Demonstrated ability to lead programs and projects — document, plan, market, and execute end-to-end; established project-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse and resolve problems — including framing ambiguous business questions as AI/analytics problems and back.
* Strong SQL/Python fundamentals plus fluency in AI-augmented development — using AI as a productivity multiplier without compromising data correctness, lineage, or governance.
* Hands-on with modern AI development tooling: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, LLM orchestration frameworks, agent frameworks, vector databases, and RAG patterns applied to enterprise data.
* Deep experience building secure and scalable enterprise AI-analytics solutions — deploying connectors, agents, and artifacts that enable others to scale AI adoption.
* Cloud proficiency (AWS, GCP, Azure) with data-engineering fundamentals and cybersecurity awareness.
* Coaching mindset (aligned with the AI Coach persona) — comfortable teaching AI Foundations and lifting the AI capability of analysts and engineers around you; can support ~6–8 AI Builders.
* Continuous learner who keeps pace with external AI/analytics capabilities and brings insights back to shape enterprise standards and Data Fabric alignment.
* Formal AI/ML certifications a plus — AWS Certified ML, GCP Professional ML Engineer, Azure AI Engineer, Databricks ML.

At GE Aerospace, we have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. Here, you will have the opportunity to work on really cool things with really smart and collaborative people. Together, we will mobilize a new era of growth in aerospace and defense. Where others stop, we accelerate.

SRE at Goldman Sachs combines software and systems engineering to build run, and maintain high performant, distributed, fault tolerant systems. As a SRE Engineer you will be filling a mission-critical role ensuring that our systems are healthy, monitored, automated, and designed to scale. You will collaborate with engineering teams to continually improve our production services, facilitating fast delivery of new services, and reducing downtime. SRE utilizes automation, tools and solid engineering principles to optimize existing systems, build infrastructure and eliminate operational work. We are looking for passionate, curious, driven engineers who thrive on solving operational problems and improving efficiency and would like to apply their skills to Compliance Engineering SRE.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Proactive management of our production services by measuring and monitoring availability, capacity and overall system health.
* Shaping software before go-live through activities such as system design consulting, capacity planning and launch reviews.
* Scaling and evolving systems by pushing for changes that improve capacity and reliability.
* Practicing sustainable incident management in a blameless postmortem culture.
* Identifying and building improvements to system behavior, control and monitoring tools.
* Defining and maintaining Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) to quantify and manage service reliability.
* Engineering solutions to reduce "toil" through advanced automation and self-healing system capabilities.
* Conducting capacity modeling and performance tuning to ensure systems meet future demand.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

**Technical Skills:**

* Experience in one or more of the following: Java, Python and Perl.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly express ideas and arguments.
* Solid analytical and problem-solving skills with appreciation of technical risk.
* Experience with automated testing and SDLC concepts, developing applications in a Linux environment, and sound knowledge of algorithms, data structures and software design.
* Systematic problem-solving approach and a sense of ownership and drive.
* Ability to debug and optimize code and to automate routine tasks.
* Proficiency with Observability stacks, including distributed tracing, logging, and metrics (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or OpenTelemetry).
* Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration technologies, specifically Docker and Kubernetes (K8s).
* Knowledge of networking protocols and load balancing strategies in a distributed systems environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field that involves programming.
