* Experience with Chaos Engineering principles and fault-injection testing to verify system resilience.
* Familiarity with cloud-native architecture and managed services (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Understanding of Error Budgeting and its application in balancing feature velocity with system stability.

**Interpersonal Skills:**

* Passionate about solving operational problems and constant improvement via automation.

title: Support Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**

Our customers are at the forefront of some of the most interesting data in the world, using SingleStore to push the boundaries every day. To do this well, they leverage the expertise of our Support Engineering Team, composed of technical subject matter experts on the frontline of critical customer issues.

This Support Engineering role skews far more towards engineering than typical technical support as you will need to delve into database internals and memory allocators, investigate Linux and host-related configurations, and diagnose SQL query behaviour, all in the name of resolving complex database issues. Our Support Engineers are constantly learning a wide range of customer systems and technical concepts and are thrilled by the new and exciting challenges that they encounter on a regular basis.

To accurately identify the source and solution of an issue, this team will take the time to learn about the customer's business and systems while helping to improve their fundamental SingleStore and database operational knowledge. This often requires additional research and time spent on learning new technologies and tools outside of SingleStore while also being deeply engaged with multiple departments including development teams, query performance engineering, product management, infrastructure SREs, etc.

**Required Hours**

* The hours required are from 11:30 AM IST - 8:30 PM IST (9 hours) for 5 days
* Participate in our on-call rotation that may include weekends and holidays.

**Role and Responsibilities**

* Provide email and live technical support to our enterprise customers, acting as the first line of defense for complex technical issues, bug diagnosis, or resolving critical outages.
* Identify and reproduce product issues, perform QA, and submit formal bug reports or feature requests to the appropriate Engineering team.
* Collaborate closely with software developers, sales engineers, and technical account managers to keep all teams up to date with current issues a customer may be facing.
* Work to streamline and improve various Support and Engineering processes and tools, author new internal run-books or public documentation, and help the team continually improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Ensure customers have a positive support experience during every interaction.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 4+ years of advanced customer-facing technical support experience.
* Experience with MySQL or MySQL-like (MariaDB, Aurora, etc) database and SQL Query Optimization.
* A solid Kubernetes and sysadmin skill set. Also, comfortable testing software and finding its limits, hands-on with Linux, checking utilization of system I/O, measuring network throughput, and are comfortable navigating large log files.
* Experience with a scripting or coding language. Whether it's Python, Bash, or Go, you should have a go-to solution for quick and dirty problem-solving and be able to navigate through our code base.
* Familiarity with distributed systems and AWS/GCP. You understand how organizations deploy and maintain distributed applications and services across multiple machines Bonus points for knowing how to analyze them for performance bottlenecks and remove single points of failure.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Have the ability to explain technical concepts to a wide range of end-users.

SingleStore delivers the cloud-native database with the speed and scale to power the world's data-intensive applications. With a distributed SQL database that introduces simplicity to your data architecture by unifying transactions and analytics, SingleStore empowers digital leaders to deliver exceptional, real-time data experiences to their customers. SingleStore is venture-backed and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Sunnyvale, Raleigh, Seattle, Boston, London, Lisbon, Bangalore, Dublin and Kyiv.

Consistent with our commitment to diversity & inclusion, we value individuals with the ability to work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people.

*To all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to SingleStore employees. SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.*

SingleStore values individuals for their unique skills and experiences, and we're proud to offer roles in a variety of locations across the United States. Salary is based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location, and is just one part of our total compensation and benefits package. Certain roles are also eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases and annual bonuses.

*For candidates residing in California, please see our* *California Recruitment Privacy Notice**. For candidates residing in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland, please see our* *EEA, UK, and Swiss Recruitment Privacy Notice.*

title: Staff Technical Support Engineer
description:
### **Our Purpose**

  

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

### **About Us**

  

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

### **What Are We Looking For?**

We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Staff Technical Support Engineer, you will be tasked with providing responsive, high-quality technical assistance to customers across our global customer base, investigating and resolving technical issues across Windows, macOS, Linux, cloud, networking, and security environments while communicating clearly with customers throughout the troubleshooting process. Technical Support sits on the front line of SentinelOne's commitment to customer outcomes, where every interaction is an opportunity to solve a customer problem, build confidence in SentinelOne, and create knowledge that makes the next customer experience even better. This role is about more than responding to tickets, as great Support Engineers combine technical curiosity, disciplined troubleshooting, customer empathy, strong documentation, and a desire to continuously increase what can be solved at the frontline.

### **What Will You Do?**

Primary responsibilities include:

* Provide customer support through phone, email, chat, and other Support channels, communicating clearly, proactively, and professionally throughout the customer experience.
* Troubleshoot technical issues across SentinelOne products and supported operating environments, gathering the technical information, logs, reproduction steps, and environmental context required to diagnose issues effectively.
* Perform performance tracing and system-level diagnostics, kernel debugging (Mac, Linux), and memory dump and crash analysis.
* Reproduce issues by building scripts, automation, and test environments.
* Own customer cases from initial investigation through resolution or appropriate escalation, meeting established response and resolution service levels and documenting troubleshooting activity and customer interactions clearly and consistently.
* Apply existing knowledge, documentation, diagnostics, and tooling before escalating issues.
* Collaborate with senior Support engineers, escalation specialists, and more specialized technical teams on complex technical problems that require deeper investigation, and with Support, Product, Problem Management, and Principal Engineers on large-scale investigations.
* Identify recurring issues and repeatable solutions, and contribute knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, videos, and other reusable resources to the collective knowledge of the Support organization.
* Provide structured feedback when product usability or supportability improvements could reduce customer effort.
* Continuously expand your technical knowledge of SentinelOne products, operating systems, cybersecurity, and troubleshooting methodologies.

### **What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?**

Ideal candidates will have:

* Strong customer orientation and desire to solve technical problems, with strong collaboration skills and a willingness to learn from others.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to systematically investigate technical issues and clearly document findings.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to manage multiple customer issues while maintaining quality and urgency.
* Working knowledge of Windows, macOS, and/or Linux, and an understanding of networking and basic security concepts.
* Mastery of networking protocols including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, IPsec VPNs, SSL/TLS, and Web proxy, and proficiency in network and API troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark, MTR, and Curl.
* The ability to deliver timely, high-quality customer resolutions; maintain strong SLA performance and high customer satisfaction; demonstrate strong case ownership and communication; increase first-line resolution whenever technically appropriate; produce clear, complete, and technically accurate case documentation; reduce avoidable escalations; contribute reusable knowledge that improves Support at scale; and continuously expand technical proficiency.
* Previous technical support or customer-facing technical experience is highly desirable.
* Experience with endpoint security or enterprise security products, or troubleshooting endpoint or server environments, is highly desirable, as is familiarity with cloud platforms or SaaS technologies.
* Scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar tools is highly desirable.
* Cybersecurity education, certifications, or professional experience is highly desirable.

### **Why SentinelOne?**

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

**Equity & Rewards**

* Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

**Time Off & Wellbeing**

* Competitive leave benefits
* Gender-neutral parental leave

**Insurance & Financial Security**

* Medical and insurance benefits
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

**Work Perks & Flexibility**

* Global home office allowance
* Internet allowance
* LinkedIn Learning license
* Social Connect program
* Food allowance (Bangalore office)
* Meal vouchers (Sodexo)

**Wellness & Lifestyle**

* Health & wellness benefit

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.

title: Staff Engineer - Cross Border, Mercari India
description:
About Us

Mercari is a Japan-based C2C marketplace company founded in 2013 with the mission to "Create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell." From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission.

Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U.S. We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management.

For our services to be utilized by people worldwide; however, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us. This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence. With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company.

About Mercari India

Established in Bengaluru in 2022, Mercari India serves as a crucial technology hub for the Mercari Group. Leveraging the rich and diverse tech talent in India, we primarily collaborate closely with our development hub in Japan to drive engineering development for Mercari's applications. Having grown to an organization of approximately 100+ members over about four years since its inception, Mercari India aims to evolve into an even stronger engineering organization that spearheads technological innovation for the entire group. This will be achieved by further enhancing our engineering capabilities and promoting AI initiatives that reflect India's cutting-edge technology and knowledge.

About XB (Cross Border)

Mercari has operated localised marketplaces in Japan and the United States for years. The XB (Cross Border) team recently launched a new global app, already live in Hong Kong, Taiwan and the United States, with the ambition to expand into over 100 countries in the coming years. Behind that expansion is one engineering goal: build a global app platform that lets existing and future product services run consistently across every region, without the fragmentation that comes from excessive localisation.

Our Culture

To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organization and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives.

Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values:

* Go Bold
* All for One
* Be a Pro
* Move Fast

Our organization is also shaped by our four foundations:

* Sustainability
* Diversity & Inclusion
* Trust & Openness
* Well-being for Performance

Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organization.

We invite you to read the "Mercari Culture Doc," which summarizes the behaviors and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognized, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari's culture.

Work Responsibilities

* Shape technical direction for XB (cross-border) backend systems that let buyers in the US, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Europe buy from Japanese sellers on Mercari and Mercari Shops.
* Lead cross-team design across the cross-border buying journey: discovery and search, item detail, pricing and landed cost, checkout and payments, and post-purchase. Set clear service boundaries and API contracts, including BFF patterns for iOS, Android and Web.
* Design and build maintainable Go services, staying hands-on in the hardest parts. Use coding agents and AI-assisted review to raise both speed and quality, and set the pattern others follow.
* Build for multi-region from day one, so one global app platform serves every market consistently, without fragmenting per country.
* Own reliability for systems that span JP marketplace services, partner APIs, payments and third-party providers. Set the standards for safe rollout, observability and incident learning, increasingly using AI-assisted automation to cut toil.
* Make 2 to 4 teams materially faster by unblocking complex design problems and simplifying the platform, increasingly by applying AI across the whole development workflow.
* Partner with PdMs and engineers in India and Japan to turn ambiguous, cross-functional problems into plans teams can execute.
* Mentor senior engineers and grow technical leaders, including how they work alongside AI agents in day-to-day delivery.

**Bold Challenges**

XB is turning Japan's marketplace into a global one. Every purchase crosses languages, currencies, regulations and logistics, and depends on systems owned by many teams in Japan. This role is for someone who can reason across that whole chain, make deliberate trade-offs between speed and correctness, and give teams a technical direction they can ship against while new markets keep launching.

You will thrive here if you Go Bold by challenging architectural constraints with evidence, practise All for One by building alignment across India and Japan rather than optimizing for one team, and Be a Pro by taking responsibility for the quality and operability of your decisions. The challenge is to build technical direction that other engineers can act on while remaining close enough to implementation to test assumptions and learn from production.

**AI-native approach:** you will be at the frontline of how XB engineering changes as engineers and autonomous agents share the work. That means helping define how we design, review, ship and operate software with AI, and the standards that keep quality and reliability high as velocity goes up.

 **Requirements**  
Must-have

* 10 to 12 years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated leadership of complex backend initiatives spanning multiple teams.
* Deep experience building and running distributed systems in cloud-native environments (GCP, Kubernetes).
* Strong backend skills in Go (or proven ability to be productive in Go quickly), including API design and testing.
* Proven delivery of large, customer-visible product surfaces, not only internal services.
* Strong system design, data modeling and production debugging, with experience running systems at 99.95% availability.
* Ability to influence architecture across multiple teams without formal authority.
* Hands-on experience applying AI/LLMs to improve engineering productivity, such as coding agents, AI-assisted review, testing or debugging.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining architecture decisions and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Good-to-have

* Cross-border e-commerce, payments, multi-currency or multi-region systems.
* Search, personalization or data platforms (e.g., Elasticsearch, event streams, ML pipelines).
* BFF API design and familiarity with React or mobile clients.
* Integrating with third-party partners or external APIs at scale.
* Driving platformization or tech simplification.
* Experience developing AI agents, or building AI-powered developer tooling for other engineers.

Can-learn

* Mercari's JP marketplace domain and internal platforms.
* Cross-border specifics like duties, tax, logistics and region rules.

  
**Benefits**

Working Conditions

* **Employment Status:** Full-time
* **Office:** Bangalore
* **Hybrid workstyle**
* + We believe in high performance and professionalism. We work from the office for 2 days/week and work from home 3 days/week.
  + To build a strong & highly-engaged organization in India, we highly encourage everyone to work from our Bangalore office, especially during the initial office setup phase
  + We will continue to review and update the policy to address future organizational needs

Media

Owned Media

* Mercari Engineering Portal
* Mercari Engineering Blog: Backend
* Mercan, introduces the people that make Mercari
* https://about.in.mercari.com/category/news/
* https://about.in.mercari.com/life/

Learn about XB and the Global App

* Building one global app platform (XB tech blog)

Related Articles

* Mercari Careers
* Culture Doc, the internal document that summarizes the behaviors and mindset shared by Mercari and its members

description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking a Video & Data Core NOC Engineer to join our INOC team in Bangalore, supporting Vodafone’s Video and Data Core services within a 24x7 Network Operations Centre environment. This role is ideal for individuals with experience in telecom network operations who are passionate about ensuring network availability, monitoring service performance, identifying incidents, and supporting timely restoration activities. The successful candidate will contribute to the operational excellence of Voice, Data Core and charging platforms across 2G, 3G, LTE and 5G technologies while working closely with operational teams, suppliers and stakeholders.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Monitor Video and Data Core network alarms, events and service-impacting incidents across NOC platforms in a 24x7 operational environment.
* Perform first-level fault identification, incident validation, alarm correlation and initial troubleshooting activities.
* Manage incident handling activities including detection, impact assessment, prioritisation, tracking, escalation and closure.
* Raise, update and maintain trouble tickets with accurate documentation, impact analysis, actions taken and escalation status.
* Escalate unresolved incidents to L2/L3 teams, resolver groups, suppliers or vendors in accordance with agreed SLAs and operational procedures.
* Conduct routine shift activities, operational checks and network health monitoring.
* Support planned maintenance activities, post-change monitoring and service verification exercises.
* Operate and support Voice and Data Core networks and charging platforms across 2G, 3G, LTE and 5G SA technologies, including native, VNF and containerised environments.
* Follow Vodafone operational procedures, security standards, governance requirements and incident management processes.
* Coordinate with internal support teams, field technicians, suppliers and external stakeholders to support service restoration activities.
* Review active alarms, incidents and pending tickets to ensure timely follow-up and resolution.
* Support inventory validation activities and report any discrepancies to relevant teams.
* Ensure compliance with site access procedures and operational controls during incident handling and resolution activities.
* Contribute towards achieving agreed operational KPIs and SLAs.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Science or a related technical discipline.
* BE/B.Tech in Electronics and Telecommunications preferred.
* 2 to 5 years of experience in telecommunications network operations, preferably within a NOC or operational support environment.
* Understanding of GSM, UMTS, LTE and 5G Core technologies.
* Knowledge of Voice, Data Core and charging platforms.
* Familiarity with ITIL-based incident management, fault handling, ticket management and escalation processes.
* Basic understanding of virtualisation technologies, VNF/CNF architectures and containerised network solutions.
* Ability to monitor alarms, correlate events, identify service impacts and perform first-level troubleshooting.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Effective stakeholder management and collaboration skills when working with internal teams, suppliers and external partners.
* Ability to perform effectively during major incidents and time-sensitive operational situations.
* Good written and spoken English with the ability to prepare clear technical updates and incident reports.
* Willingness to work rotational shifts, including weekends, nights, public holidays and overtime when required.
* Secondary education completed.

**Not a Perfect Fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

* Opportunity to work within a global telecom environment supporting critical Video and Data Core services.
* Exposure to advanced 2G, 3G, LTE and 5G Core network technologies.
* Experience working with virtualised and containerised telecom network platforms.
* Participation in major incident management and service restoration activities.
* Collaboration with international operational teams, suppliers and technical specialists.
* Development of operational expertise within a high-availability network environment.
* Exposure to industry-standard NOC operations, service management processes and network monitoring platforms.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

* Advanced Network Operations Centre practices and operational governance.
* Incident lifecycle management aligned with ITIL methodologies.
* Telecom core network troubleshooting and fault isolation techniques.
* Alarm monitoring, event correlation and service impact analysis.
* Escalation management and cross-functional operational coordination.
* Voice, Data Core and charging platform operations.
* Exposure to virtualisation, VNF/CNF technologies and containerised network architectures.
* Technical reporting, stakeholder communication and operational documentation.
* Network maintenance support and post-implementation monitoring practices.
* Service assurance and KPI/SLA performance management.

**Experience**: 3-5 Years

**Location**: Mumbai / Bengaluru

**Mandatory Skills**: (Any one from below Firewalls and Cloud WAF product) Fortinet Firewalls Checkpoint Firewalls Ubika WAF

  

**Role Summary**:

The Firewall Specialist is responsible for the administration, operation, troubleshooting, and optimization of enterprise network security infrastructure comprising Fortinet Firewalls, Check Point Firewalls, and Ubika Web Application Firewall (WAF).

The engineer will provide Level-2 support for security incidents, firewall policy changes, VPN management, WAF rule tuning, and problem resolution while ensuring compliance with security standards and service level agreements.

The role requires strong expertise in firewall security technologies, threat prevention, access controls, VPN technologies, and web application security.

  

**Key Responsibilities**:

* Firewall Operations & Administration: Manage and maintain Fortinet FortiGate and Check Point firewall environments. Implement, modify, and optimize firewall security policies, NAT rules, routing policies, and object groups.

* Perform rule reviews, policy recertification, and firewall cleanup activities.

* Manage firewall high-availability clusters and security gateways.

* Support Internet, Extranet, and DMZ security architectures.

* Perform firmware upgrades, patching, and vulnerability remediation.

* Validate firewall configurations against security baselines and best practices. Incident & Problem Management: Provide L2 support for firewall and network security incidents.

* Investigate connectivity, routing, VPN, and security policy issues.

* Analyze firewall logs and security events for root cause determination.

* Coordinate with L3 engineers, vendors, and infrastructure teams during major incidents.

* Participate in post-incident reviews and recommend corrective actions.

  

**Ubika WAF Administration**:

* Manage Ubika WAF policies and application protection configurations.

* Implement and tune WAF security rules to minimize false positives.

* Monitor and investigate WAF-generated alerts and attacks.

* Support secure publication of web applications.

* Configure URL filtering, access control, bot protection, and application security policies.

* Conduct WAF policy reviews and security assessments.

  

**Security Monitoring & Compliance:**

* Review security events generated by firewalls and WAF platforms.

* Support audit and compliance requirements.

* Generate operational and compliance reports.

* Assist in vulnerability management and remediation activities.

* Ensure adherence to organizational security standards and change management processes.

  

**Change & Release Management**:

* Execute firewall and WAF changes through approved change management processes.

* Prepare implementation, rollback, and validation plans.

* Participate in CAB discussions when required.

* Validate successful completion of security changes.

  

**Documentation & Governance**:

* Maintain network security diagrams, policies, and operational runbooks.

* Document troubleshooting procedures and known error records.

* Create knowledge articles and operational handover documents.

Provide technical support during audits and governance reviews.

* Have cutover planning experience, including mock runs, rollback plans, and go/no-go criteria.

* Experience with Azure Blob Storage, Key Vault, Azure Monitor/Log Analytics, dbt, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric is good to have.

description:

Bengaluru

Business Expansion

**About CodeRabbit**
--------------------

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

  

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

You'll own the quality of the data that underpins every routing rule, territory, forecast and ARR number at CodeRabbit. You'll start by working the requests our GTM and Finance teams send to RevOps every day, and you'll turn each kind of request into a written runbook. Then you'll build the Data Quality Agent: an AI agent that handles most of those requests itself, routes the risky ones to a human for approval, and keeps a full record of everything it does. You'll join Business Systems, a small team that builds with agentic tools every day, and you'll work on the same engineering harness our engineers use to ship Salesforce and internal tool changes.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the tier-1 data queue for internal GTM systems data support: account ownership changes, account creation, merges, parent-child hierarchies, lead conversion, and linking billing subscriptions to the right Salesforce account.
* Resolve requests within the team's response standard and leave a record any teammate can pick up.
* Write and maintain a runbook for every recurring request type: the trigger, the checks, the steps, the edge cases, and when to escalate.
* Design, build and run the Data Quality Agent with Code Rabbit Coding Agent and our engineering harness, starting in shadow mode and earning its autonomy one workflow type at a time.
* Define the agent's approval tiers: what it can fix on its own, what it proposes for human approval, and what it always escalates.
* Run duplicate detection and merge cohorts across accounts, contacts and leads, and keep account hierarchies accurate as customers grow, merge and reorganize.
* Close enrichment gaps (firmographics, domains, HQ location, parent company) using our enrichment tools and the data warehouse.
* Track the request queue and data health with clear metrics: volume by request type, time to resolve, agent accuracy, and how often humans override the agent.
* Find the root cause behind repeat requests and bring proposals to the engineers so the fix lands upstream.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3+ years in CRM data operations, sales operations, RevOps or data quality at a B2B SaaS company.
* Hands-on Salesforce experience: the Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity data model, ownership and sharing basics, reports, and bulk data tools.
* Strong SQL. You can answer your own questions from the warehouse without waiting on an analyst.
* You have used AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to automate real work, and you can show us something you built: a prompt chain, a script, an agent, or an automation that saved hours.
* You write clear, step-by-step documentation that someone else can follow without asking you questions.
* Careful judgment with production data. You know which changes are easy to undo and which are not, and you treat them differently.
* Comfortable working across time zones with stakeholders in the US and Europe.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with dedupe and merge tools such as Traction Complete, DemandTools, Cloudingo or Salesforce duplicate rules.
* Python or JavaScript scripting, Git, and comfort working in a code repository.
* Experience with enrichment and prospecting data tools such as Clay, ZoomInfo or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
* Exposure to billing systems such as Chargebee, and how subscriptions can map to CRM data.
* Experience with BigQuery, dbt or another cloud data warehouse.
* Experience designing human-in-the-loop workflows: approval steps, confidence thresholds, audit logs and evaluations.
* Familiarity with developer-tools or technical B2B SaaS go-to-market (GTM).

**Our Values**
--------------

  

* **Collaborative Humans**: Prioritizing collective intelligence

* **Fearless Innovators**: Turning obstacles into growth opportunities

* **Persistent, Passionate Developers**: Thriving on complex, long-term challenges

* **Impact-Driven Creators**: Crafting intuitive tools for developers

* **Rapid Learners and Un-learners**: Adapting quickly in our fast-paced technological world

**What We Offer**
=================

  

* Work on cutting-edge technology with real-world impact

* Collaborative and innovative environment

* Competitive salary, equity, and benefits

* Professional development opportunities

To apply, submit your resume and relevant project samples or GitHub profiles. CodeRabbit is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

Role

Why UKG:

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Core Mission
  
  
The Enterprise Applied AI Solution Specialist is a hands-on engineer who builds and deploys practical AI solutions that improve internal workflows and employee productivity. The role focuses on implementing agentic and Generative AI features using established patterns, grounded in enterprise knowledge and data.
  
  
This individual partners closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into usable, reliable capabilities while operating within enterprise constraints such as security, governance, and user trust. The position is ideal for a builder who ships, iterates quickly, and continuously improves solution quality through feedback and measurement.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
This is a delivery-focused role combining hands-on implementation with light product ownership and operational discipline.
  
  
1. Applied Solution Delivery & Iteration (65% of time)
  
Build and enhance AI-powered features (e.g., copilots, summarization, classification, routing, Q&A) aligned to defined business workflows.
  
Partner with business users to clarify requirements, run demos, capture feedback, and iterate toward measurable outcomes.
  
Support pilot launches, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to smooth adoption through user training and clear documentation.
  
  
2. Knowledge-Based Agents & Conversational Design (25% of time)
  
Develop agents grounded in the company’s internal knowledge base, using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns and retrieval quality improvements.
  
Design conversational flows for internal functions (e.g., HR helpdesk), including intent handling, escalation paths, and handoff to human support when needed.
  
Implement simple agentic or predictive models for operational use cases (e.g., predicting customer support ticket volume) under guidance from senior engineers.
  
  
3. Product Execution, Quality & Documentation (10% of time)
  
Manage the feature backlog for an AI product area: write user stories, define acceptance criteria, and coordinate UAT.
  
Contribute to evaluation and regression testing using approved checklists; help monitor quality, latency, and cost for deployed features.
  
Create and maintain documentation (how-to guides, runbooks, and user enablement materials) to support long-term sustainability.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
3+ years of experience in software engineering or applied solutions development (or equivalent practical experience).
  
Proficiency in Python and API-based integration; working knowledge of SQL and data access patterns.
  
Working familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  
Exposure to agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar) and the ability to implement tool/function calling patterns.
  
Basic understanding of enterprise security, privacy, and data governance requirements; ability to follow established guardrails and escalate risks early.
  
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  
Ideal Candidate Profile: Who Thrives in This Role
  
Builders Over Theorists: You enjoy shipping working software and iterating based on user feedback.
  
User-Centered Mindset: You like sitting with users, mapping workflows, and improving day-to-day productivity.
  
Pragmatic Technologist: You choose simple, reliable approaches and adopt new techniques when they clearly improve outcomes.
  
Quality-Driven: You care about correctness, safety, and operational reliability, and you follow established production standards.
  
Continuous Learner: You stay current on rapidly evolving GenAI capabilities and apply them responsibly.
  
Generous Collaborator: You document clearly, communicate proactively, and work well across teams.

Company Overview:

UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. description:
**Company Overview:**  
Euphoric Thought Technologies is a technology-driven organization focused on building scalable, high-performance data ecosystems that power modern digital enterprises. Operating at the intersection of big data and cloud infrastructure, the company provides robust platforms that enable businesses to process complex information in real-time. With a culture rooted in engineering excellence and technical innovation, Euphoric Thought Technologies supports a diverse portfolio of clients, ensuring their data architecture remains resilient, secure, and highly available as they scale globally.

**Role Overview:**  
As a Senior Database Architect, you will serve as the primary technical authority for the design, implementation, and optimization of our core data platforms. You will work closely with engineering leadership, product managers, and infrastructure teams to translate complex business requirements into high-performing database solutions. Your work will directly influence the reliability and efficiency of our systems, ensuring that our data architecture can handle massive throughput while maintaining strict integrity standards. title: Applications Engineering, Sr Engineer (FPGA, RTL Design & Emulation)
description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India


**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18858 **Date posted** 09/16/2026
### **We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent the last few years deep in FPGA design and implementation, and you have learned that the real work begins when a customer's design does not compile the way they expected or when partitioning across multiple FPGAs creates timing issues no one saw coming. You are the engineer who stays on the call until the problem is solved, not because you have to, but because leaving something half\-fixed bothers you.


You are comfortable reading Verilog or SystemVerilog that someone else wrote, understanding what they were trying to do, and figuring out why the synthesis tool is choking on it. You know your way around FPGA architecture well enough to explain why a design that worked fine in simulation is failing in hardware, and you can do it in a way that does not make the customer feel like they missed something obvious.


Working with customers energizes you. You like the variety of problems, the pressure of real deadlines, and the satisfaction of helping someone get unstuck. You do not need everything documented perfectly to move forward. You ask the right questions, dig into log files, reproduce issues locally, and escalate to R\&D when needed with enough context that they can actually help.


At Synopsys, you will work with some of the most complex emulation and prototyping workflows in the industry, supporting global customers who depend on Zebu and Protocompiler to verify chips that power everything from automotive systems to data centers.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Provide technical support to global customers using Synopsys Zebu Emulation and Protocompiler Prototyping software, troubleshooting issues across partitioning, synthesis, place and route, and hardware debug
* Work directly with customers to migrate their designs to new software releases, ensuring compatibility and resolving any regressions or performance issues that surface
* Deploy new software features on live customer designs, helping them adopt capabilities like advanced partitioning algorithms, new debug modes, or updated FPGA target support
* Deliver technical training sessions to customers, ranging from basic tool usage to advanced workflows for multi\-FPGA partitioning and hardware\-software co\-verification
* Collaborate with Synopsys HAV R\&D teams to report customer issues, provide reproducible test cases, and advocate for product improvements based on real\-world usage patterns
* Support pre\-sales evaluations by running customer designs through the Synopsys emulation and prototyping flow, demonstrating performance and identifying potential adoption blockers
* Travel occasionally to customer sites for onsite support, training, or critical issue resolution

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable customers to bring up complex SoC designs on emulation and prototyping platforms faster, reducing their verification cycle time by weeks or months
* Improve product quality by surfacing real customer pain points to R\&D with enough technical detail that fixes can be prioritized and implemented effectively
* Build customer confidence in Synopsys HAV solutions through responsive, expert\-level support that helps them solve problems they could not solve on their own
* Expand adoption of new software features by showing customers how to use them on their actual designs, not just in demos
* Reduce escalations and support load over time by delivering training that helps customers become more self\-sufficient with the toolchain
* Strengthen customer relationships by being the engineer they trust to pick up the phone when something is broken and production timelines are at risk
* Contribute to the technical knowledge base and internal best practices that make the entire support organization more effective

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelors in Electronics Engineering with 2\-3 years of experience, or Master's in Electronics Engineering with 1\-2 years, specifically in emulation or prototyping environments
* Hands\-on experience with logic design and implementation using FPGAs, including synthesis, place and route, and timing closure
* Strong working knowledge of Verilog, System Verilog, or VHDL, including the ability to read, debug, and modify RTL written by others
* Practical experience with FPGA architecture and back\-end implementation flows, including understanding of resource utilization, clock domain crossing, and design partitioning
* Exposure to Xilinx or Altera synthesis tools is a plus, as is familiarity with Synopsys Prototyping or Emulation hardware and software
* Experience with interface protocols like PCIe, AXI, UART, or I2C is a plus, particularly in the context of hardware\-software integration
* Scripting experience in Python, Tcl, or shell is desirable for automating workflows and analyzing log files

### **Who You Are**

* You can take a vague customer complaint like "the compile is failing" and turn it into a specific, reproducible issue with enough detail that R\&D can act on it
* You stay calm when a customer is frustrated or under pressure, and you focus on solving the problem rather than defending the tool
* You are comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple customer issues in parallel without losing track of who needs what by when
* You do not mind digging through synthesis logs, waveform dumps, or FPGA utilization reports to find the root cause of a problem
* You can explain a complex technical tradeoff, like why a design needs to be repartitioned or why certain optimizations are not possible, in a way that makes sense to someone who is not an FPGA expert
* You are open to occasional travel for customer support, training, or onsite troubleshooting when remote support is not enough

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


You will join Synopsys Technical Sales Group (TSG) as part of the Hardware Assisted Verification (HAV) team, working alongside expert\-level field engineers who support customers globally on Zebu Emulation and Protocompiler Prototyping solutions. The team works closely with R\&D and directly with customers at all stages of the emulation and prototyping cycle, from pre\-sales evaluation through post\-deployment support. You will collaborate with engineers across geographies and gain exposure to Synopsys HAV hardware platforms as part of your technical development.


At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

As part of JCI’s ongoing and exciting digital transformation strategy, as a Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer you will act as a technical lead and subject matter expert across our global Enterprise Security estate. You will work with the wider global network and IT teams, business partners and managed service vendors to design, engineer and operate the physical and logical Enterprise Security infrastructure (Zscaler Secure Service Edge, firewalls, remote access platforms, cloud proxies, microsegmentation (Zscaler and Guardicore), cloud security \& perimeter security devices etc.) portfolio in Johnson Controls. Our Network infrastructure consists of a large global footprint of more than one thousand sites supporting over one hundred thousand employees ranging from datacenters, manufacturing plants, sales branches, and customer contact centers with exposure to a wide range of exciting network technologies and vendors such as Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA, DLP, AI Security and Microsegmentation), Fortinet, Zscaler ZT Branch Connector, Akamai Guardicore, Imperva WAF, Forescout, Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS and many more partners.

  

The role will be working as part of a global high\-performance team focused on continuous network security infrastructure delivery and upgrades, maintenance and operational activities, delivery of security configurations and services, incident and change management, network security design and compliance, equipment ordering, scheduling, security device life cycle management, operational handover, vendor management and network security infrastructure asset management.

* Serve as senior engineer and design authority for the Zscaler platform – ZIA, ZPA, Inline DLP, AI Security (Secure AI Access), Digital Experience (ZDX) and Zscaler Microsegmentation

**Required**

* Strong knowledge of the Fortinet security suite (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer) and experience testing and implementing security\-related changes in a production environment.
* Experience working with 3rd party vendors and managed network service providers.
* Great organisational skills.
* Strong experience of working on SIEM tools to analyze logs and correlate events.

**About Carrier**

  

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting\-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life\-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world\-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

* **About the role****:**

Designs, builds, and evolves enterprise data and AI capabilities that enable reliable, secure, and scalable digital solutions across the organization. Oversees data platforms, pipelines, analytics, and intelligent technologies to ensure high\-quality, accessible, and well\-governed data that supports operational and strategic decision\-making. Applies advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and automation to improve efficiency, accuracy, and business performance while enabling scalable and data\-driven ways of working. Establishes and enforces governance frameworks, standards, and responsible AI practices to maintain data integrity, compliance, consistency, and trusted use of enterprise technologies. Partners closely with business and technology teams to translate evolving business needs into robust data and AI solutions that drive innovation, operational maturity, and long\-term enterprise value. **JOB RESPONSIBILITY:**


1\. Platform Architecture \& Technical Ownership

* Own the overall architecture of the enterprise data platform based on a Lakehouse paradigm, covering storage, compute, metadata, governance, and observability.
* Define and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and architectural standards applicable across AWS and GCP.
* Act as the final technical authority for platform‑level architectural decisions, trade‑offs, and exceptions.
* Ensure architectural choices support scalability, resilience, security, cost efficiency, and operational excellence.


2\. Lakehouse \& Open‑Standards Strategy

* Design the platform around open data standards to ensure portability and long‑term flexibility.
* Standardize on open table formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg or equivalent) and open file formats (e.g., Parquet) as the foundation of the Lakehouse.
* Enforce separation of storage and compute, enabling multiple analytics and processing engines without vendor lock‑in.
* Define principles for schema evolution, ACID guarantees, time travel, and multi‑engine interoperability.


3\. Multi‑Cloud Platform Design (AWS \& GCP)

* Architect the Lakehouse platform to run on AWS and GCP, with cloud‑specific implementations mapped to a common logical architecture.
* Define standards and patterns for:
* Cloud‑native storage and processing services
* Environment isolation (dev / test / prod)
* Networking and identity models
* Security, encryption, and access controls
* Establish cloud‑agnostic abstractions and guardrails so data products behave consistently across clouds.
* Ensure platform design aligns with enterprise security, compliance, and cost‑management requirements.


4\. Platform Development \& Engineering Enablement

* Partner with Platform Engineers and Data Engineers to translate architecture into reusable platform capabilities, frameworks, and templates.
* Define configuration‑driven and template‑based approaches to accelerate onboarding and reduce bespoke development.
* Review and guide detailed solution designs to ensure alignment with architectural standards.
* Enable self‑service platform usage while preserving governance and operational controls.


5\. Governance, Metadata \& Lineage Architecture

* Define the governance architecture for the Lakehouse, including metadata management, lineage, access control, and auditability.
* Ensure support for open metadata and lineage standards (e.g., OpenLineage‑style event models).
* Embed data quality, ownership, discoverability, and compliance as first‑class architectural concerns.
* Align platform design with enterprise data governance and regulatory expectations.


6\. Operational Excellence \& Non‑Functional Architecture

* Architect for high availability, observability, and operational simplicity.
* Define platform‑level SLAs, SLOs, and operational readiness criteria.
* Incorporate FinOps principles into architectural decisions to optimize performance and cost.
* Ensure the platform supports Day‑2 operations, incident management, and continuous improvement.


7\. Stakeholder Leadership \& Architecture Governance

* Serve as the primary architecture interface between engineering teams, security, governance, and business stakeholders.
* Clearly communicate architectural vision and decisions through architecture documents, standards, and review forums.
* Lead architecture reviews, roadmap planning, and technology evaluations.
* Mentor senior engineers and architects, raising overall platform and architecture maturity.


Required Qualifications

* 16\+ years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, or data architecture roles.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise‑scale data platforms.
* Strong experience designing and governing Lakehouse architectures.
* Hands‑on architectural experience with AWS and/or GCP, with the ability to design for both.
* Deep understanding of open data standards, including open table formats, file formats, metadata, and lineage.
* Experience defining reference architectures, guardrails, and engineering standards.
* Strong ability to balance long‑term architectural vision with near‑term delivery needs.


Preferred / Optional Qualifications

* Experience with Microsoft Azure data and analytics services (optional, not required).
* Experience designing multi‑cloud or cloud‑agnostic data platforms.
* Familiarity with multiple analytics and query engines across cloud ecosystems.
* Experience with enterprise data governance frameworks and metadata platforms.
* Exposure to AI/ML platform integration on Lakehouse architectures.
* Prior experience leading large‑scale platform modernization or migration initiatives **Benefits**

title: Senior Analyst - Data Engineering
description:
**Designation : Developer**


**Level :L2**


**Location : Bangalore**

  

  

**Experience :**


Total Experience: 3–6\+ years in Full Stack or Backend Software Development.


Language Proficiency: Strong working experience with Go (Golang) for backend services (or solid backend expertise in another language with demonstrated Go capability); strong proficiency in TypeScript or modern JavaScript.


API Architecture: Proven track record of designing, building, and consuming scalable REST or gRPC APIs.


Database \& Cloud: Hands\-on experience writing complex SQL queries and deploying containerized services on cloud infrastructure (preferably GCP).


**Job Role** :


Seeking a Full Stack / Backend Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable cloud services and modern web/client interfaces. In this role, you will develop robust backend APIs, integrate distributed cloud databases, and build lightweight client\-side components and browser\-based tools.


You will work across the software development lifecycle, Go services and TypeScript client logic to querying enterprise SQL databases (including distributed relational systems like Cloud Spanner) and deploying containerized microservices to modern serverless environments (Cloud Run).


**Responsibilities** :  

  



Backend \& API Development: Design, implement, and maintain secure, high\-throughput RESTful and/or gRPC APIs using Go (Golang) and/or Python.


Frontend \& Client Integration: Develop and maintain client\-side modules using TypeScript / JavaScript; build or enhance browser\-based tools (such as Chrome Extensions) to streamline user workflows.


Database Design \& Query Optimization: Write efficient, production\-grade SQL queries, design schemas, and handle data migrations with a focus on distributed relational databases (Cloud Spanner).


Cloud \& Serverless Deployment: Deploy, manage, and scale containerized applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) leveraging Cloud Run and container workflows via Artifact Registry.


System Reliability \& DevOps: Package services with Docker, automate routine deployment workflows with shell scripting (Bash), and maintain CI/CD pipelines.


Collaboration \& Code Quality: Participate in design reviews, maintain code documentation, and write unit and integration tests to ensure enterprise\-grade stability and security.

  

  

**Required skills** :


A. TypeScript / JavaScript \& Client\-Side Development


TypeScript \& Modern JS: Strong command of TypeScript (ES6\+) and modern JavaScript syntax, asynchronous programming (Promises, Async/Await), and modular architecture.


Browser \& Extension Development (Optional / Plus): Familiarity with Chrome Extension architecture (Manifest V3, background service workers, content scripts, extension messaging APIs, storage).


UI \& Integration: Experience integrating client\-side interfaces with backend services via fetch/Axios and managing state cleanly.


B. Backend Engineering \& API Design


Go (Golang): Solid understanding of Go fundamentals, goroutines, channels, standard library (net/http), and popular frameworks/routers (e.g., Gin, Chi, or standard Go idioms).


Python (Secondary / Plus): Working knowledge of Python for backend scripting, services, or automation (FastAPI, Flask).


API Development: Deep understanding of RESTful API design patterns, JSON data serialization, authentication protocols (OAuth2, JWT), error handling, and API rate limiting.


C. Database \& Data Layer (SQL \& Cloud Spanner)


Hands\-on SQL: Proficient in relational database design, indexing strategies, ACID transactions, data normalization, and complex joins.


Cloud Spanner: Familiarity or hands\-on experience working with distributed relational databases, particularly Google Cloud Spanner (schema design, query performance tuning, primary keys, interleaved tables).


D. Cloud Infrastructure (GCP) \& DevOps


GCP Services: Hands\-on familiarity with core Google Cloud Platform products, notably Cloud Run (serverless container orchestration) and Artifact Registry (container image management).


Containerization: Experience writing optimized Dockerfiles, building multi\-stage container images, and debugging container runtimes.


Shell Scripting: Proficient in Linux environments with Bash / Shell scripting for automation, build scripts, and environment configuration.

title: Manager, Quality Engineering
description:
At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.
  

  

For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off\-the\-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.
  

  

Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.


**Title** : Manager, Quality Engineering


**Reporting to** : Sr Director, Quality Engineering


**Location** : Bangalore, India


**Department** : Quality Engineering


**About Quickbase**

At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.


For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off\-the\-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we're building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.


Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We're a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.


**About the Role**

As a Quality Engineering Manager, you will own the quality strategy for a significant product domain while leading a talented team of Quality Engineers supporting multiple engineering teams. Through your partnership with other Quality Engineering (QE) leaders, you’ll help shape and evolve our quality tooling and practices and continue to build a culture where quality is a shared responsibility.


Our teams support quality efforts across multiple product domains, invest heavily in automation, and embrace AI\-assisted development. This role requires technical judgement, strong people leadership, and the ability to build trust across teams.


Success in this role is measured by the quality of the software your team helps deliver, the growth of the quality engineers you lead, and your ability to influence how quality is built into the software development lifecycle.


**What You'll Do**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers supporting multiple engineering teams and product initiatives.
* Own the quality strategy for a product domain by partnering closely with other leaders, tech leads, and product managers to improve software quality, delivery predictability, and customer outcomes.
* Provides technical and architectural leadership in test automation, frameworks, CI/CD, and testing standards.
* Partner with QE leadership to define and evolve scalable quality practices and AI\-assisted testing solutions, translate those into clear team priorities and goals, and drive consistent adoption to improve quality outcomes
* Balance competing priorities across multiple engineering teams, helping stakeholders understand tradeoffs while ensuring the highest\-value work receives appropriate quality investment.

Coach and mentor through clear, actionable feedback * \- developing technical and leadership capabilities, clarifying promotion expectations, and supporting career growth.
* Lead teams through ambiguity, changing priorities, and organizational change while maintaining focus, engagement, and delivery excellence.

Influence engineering teams to build quality earlier in the software development lifecycle through collaboration, data, and thoughtful decision\-making.  
* 

**About You**

You believe quality engineering is much more than finding defects — it's a shared engineering responsibility woven into how software gets built. You also lead by helping others do their best work, and you measure your own success by theirs.


You will be successful in this role if you:


* Build trust quickly with your team and other leaders and teams in the organization.
* Lead with curiosity, active listening, empathy, and thoughtful communication.
* Make informed decisions in an environment where priorities can change or information is incomplete.
* Balance customer needs, quality, delivery timelines, and business priorities when making tradeoffs
* Create an inclusive, collaborative environment where individuals feel empowered to learn, experiment, and continuously improve.
* Believe your success is a reflection of the success, engagement, and growth of your team.

**Experience We Think You'll Need**

* Demonstrated success managing and developing a high\-performing Quality Engineering team.
* Experience with or working knowledge of AI\-assisted software development; including AI assisted test generation, model evaluation, and skills/playbooks.
* Experience developing and scaling quality processes that drive greater efficiency and support organizational growth.
* Experience leading and working with distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones.
* Understanding of fundamental quality engineering strategies and practices.
* Demonstrated ability to influence decisions on teams without direct authority.

**Why Quickbase?**

At Quickbase, Quality Engineering is a strategic partner in how software is built and this role carries real scope: you’ll help shape and evolve our quality strategy not just execute someone else's plan.


Quality Engineering is also at an inflection point. We're actively building what AI\-assisted quality engineering looks like in practice, and this role has direct influence over how that evolves — not adopting a playbook someone else already wrote.


You'll do this alongside the rest of the QE leadership team \- sharing practices, tackling problems together, and growing together. You won't be leading in isolation.


If you want a role where your decisions shape how quality is built across a growing organization, and you want to help define what quality engineering looks like in an AI\-driven future, we'd love to talk.

  

  

**Important Notices**  

**Recorded Interviews.** Quickbase uses an interview recording tool to record and transcribe interviews for evaluation purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. By participating in an interview, you consent to this recording and transcription.
  

**Interview Integrity.** AI is part of how we work at Quickbase — we expect you to use it too. Your application and interviews should still reflect you and your own thinking. We'll tell you when AI is encouraged throughout the selection process. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles.
  

**How We Review Applications** We use AI throughout our hiring process to help review, screen, schedule interviews, and assess applications. These tools support our team's review; they do not replace it, and every hiring decision is made by a person.

  

  

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Quickbase is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply – even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

* Office Transportation
* On\-Call Weekend Allowance
* Weekend Working Allowance

Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss \& Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We’re a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.


At Levi Strauss \& Co, we are changing the apparel business and redefining the way denim is made. We are taking one of the world's most iconic brands into the next century. You will create machine learning\-powered denim finishes, using block\-chain for our factory workers' wellbeing, and building algorithms to better meet the needs of our consumers and improve our supply chain. Be a pioneer in the fashion industry by joining our global Data, Analytics \& AI “startup with assets.” Here, you will have the chance to build exciting solutions to improve our Americas business. At the same time, you will be part of a bigger, across\-continents, data community. You are someone who can use programming and analytics technologies such as SQL/NoSQL, Python to validate products, data pipelines and data deliverables. If you have experience in automation, quality engineering of data\-centric applications, especially with retail domain and excited about using your experience to catapult into hyper\-growth, this job is for you.

**Summary of the Role:**


Join our Data \& AI Platform Engineering organisation and lead the charge in transforming the fashion industry. As a Data Engineer, you will develop groundbreaking solutions that support our global business forward while being part of a dynamic, cross\-continental data community.


You will be lead an individual track within the Supply Chain \& Planning Data Domain team. This track owns delivery, from requirements analysis and solution design through development, testing, deployment, and production support. You will work on a cloud native and modern data platform, building data pipelines to building data models and transformations to delivering data products and dashboards to our partners. You will provide technical expertise and operational support to meet the data needs for our businesses. From migrating existing workloads to building advanced cloud solutions, you will help shape and accomplish strategies to increase agility, improve security, reduce costs, and meet use targets.


You bring technical leadership and deep data engineering expertise. They also have hands\-on experience with event\-driven architectures and real\-time data processing technologies, such as Kafka, Google Pub/Sub, and streaming data pipelines. You will collaborate with partners, architects, analysts, data scientists, and engineering teams across multiple geographies to deliver high\-quality, reliable, and scalable data solutions.


We ask that you have partner management skills, along with the flexibility to overlap with U.S. time zones for a few hours each day to support global collaboration and project execution.

**About the Role:**

* Lead an individual track within the Supply Chain \& Planning Data Domain, driving delivery of strategic data programmes. .
* Architect scalable batch and real\-time data pipelines supporting enterprise\-wide data products and analytics solutions.
* Develop data models, transformations, and data products that meet business and operational requirements.
* Develop event\-driven and streaming data solutions using technologies such as Kafka, Google Pub/Sub, Spark Streaming, or similar platforms.
* Collaborate with partners to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions and delivery plans.
* Establish and enforce data quality, governance, observability, and monitoring frameworks to ensure trusted and reliable data products.
* Perform root cause analysis, troubleshoot data issues, and implement preventive measures to improve platform stability and performance.
* Improve data processing solutions for scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
* Partner with teams including Data Scientists, Analysts, Software Engineers, Architects, and SREs to deliver high\-value outcomes.


Champion modern software engineering practices including Agile delivery, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and DevOps principles.
* Support global project delivery by maintaining flexibility to collaborate with teams across regions, including regular overlap with U.S. business hours.

**About You:**

* 12\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, or related disciplines, with experience delivering large\-scale data solutions.
* Experience with data warehousing concepts, dimensional modelling, data lakehouse architectures, and Extract Transform Load best practices.
* Expertise in SQL and Python for large\-scale data processing and transformation.
* Hands\-on experience with modern big data technologies such as Spark, Flink, Hive, and distributed data processing frameworks.
* Experience designing and implementing event\-driven architectures, streaming platforms, and real\-time data pipelines using technologies such as Kafka, Google Pub/Sub, Spark Streaming, or similar solutions.
* Experience working with one or more major cloud platforms. Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is good to have.
* Hands\-on experience with data transformation frameworks such as dbt, PySpark, Dataflow, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience building and maintaining data products, APIs, datasets consumed by business and reporting applications.
* Familiarity with data visualisation and analytics tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern software development practices.
* Mentor engineers and guide engineering excellence within a team.
* Flexible to work with globally distributed teams and provide regular overlap with U.S. time zones to support project delivery and partner engagement.
* Experience applying data to solve complex business problems and deliver measurable value.
* B.E. in Computer Science is good to have.

**Benefits:**

  

We put a lot of thought into our programs to provide you with a benefits package that matters. Whether it is for medical care, taking time off, improving your health or planning for retirement, we've got you covered.


Here's a small snapshot:

* Complimentary preventive health check\-up for you \& your spouse
* OPD coverage
* Best in class leave plan including paternity \& family care leaves
* Counselling sessions to prioritize mental well\-being
* Exclusive discount vouchers on Levi’s products
